Description: >-
  Serverless workflow using AWS Step Functions that publishes custom events to a
  dedicated Amazon EventBridge event bus, together with an EventBridge rule on
  that bus that forwards every event to an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group for
  testing and debugging.

Parameters:
  EventSource:
    Type: String
    Default: com.example.custom.workflow
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: Value used for the source field of custom events published by the Step Functions workflow.

  EventDetailType:
    Type: String
    Default: CustomWorkflowEvent
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    Description: Value used for the detail-type field of custom events published by the Step Functions workflow.

  DebugLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Number of days that events forwarded to CloudWatch Logs are retained.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653

Resources:
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-custom-events"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-custom-events"

  DebugLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/events/${AWS::StackName}-custom-events"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref DebugLogRetentionInDays

  EventBridgeToCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows Amazon EventBridge to write matched events to the debug CloudWatch Logs log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WriteEventsToCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowCreatingLogStreamsAndWritingEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "${DebugLogGroup.Arn}:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-eventbridge-to-cwlogs"

  ForwardAllEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      Description: Forwards every event published to the custom event bus to the debug CloudWatch Logs log group.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - prefix: ""
      Targets:
        - Id: DebugCloudWatchLogs
          Arn: !GetAtt DebugLogGroup.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeToCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn

  WorkflowRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Step Functions workflow that publishes custom events to the EventBridge event bus.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowStepFunctionsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PublishEventsToCustomEventBus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowPutEventsOnEventBus
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-workflow-role"

  WorkflowStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt WorkflowRole.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Publishes a custom event to the dedicated EventBridge event bus.
        StartAt: PublishCustomEvent
        States:
          PublishCustomEvent:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::events:putEvents
            Parameters:
              Entries:
                - EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
                  Source: !Ref EventSource
                  DetailType: !Ref EventDetailType
                  Detail:
                    message: Custom event published by the Step Functions workflow.
                    stackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
                    executionId.$: $$.Execution.Id
                    executionName.$: $$.Execution.Name
                    stateMachineId.$: $$.StateMachine.Id
            ResultPath: $.publishResult
            End: true

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine that publishes custom events.
    Value: !Ref WorkflowStateMachine

  StateMachineName:
    Description: Name of the Step Functions state machine that publishes custom events.
    Value: !GetAtt WorkflowStateMachine.Name

  EventBusName:
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge event bus that receives the custom events.
    Value: !Ref CustomEventBus

  EventBusArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom EventBridge event bus that receives the custom events.
    Value: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  ForwardingRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule that forwards all events on the custom bus to CloudWatch Logs.
    Value: !GetAtt ForwardAllEventsRule.Arn

  DebugLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives every event for testing and debugging.
    Value: !Ref DebugLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  DynamoDB table for web session management (dva-lab-02-07-sessions).
  Provisioned billing mode with Application Auto Scaling on ReadCapacityUnits
  and WriteCapacityUnits (target 70% utilization, min 5, max 40) and
  Point-in-Time Recovery enabled.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: dva-lab-02-07-sessions
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+'
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table used to store web sessions.

  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 40
    Description: Initial provisioned read capacity units for the table.

  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 40
    Description: Initial provisioned write capacity units for the table.

  MinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Minimum provisioned capacity units maintained by auto scaling.

  MaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 40
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Maximum provisioned capacity units allowed by auto scaling.

  TargetUtilization:
    Type: Number
    Default: 70
    MinValue: 20
    MaxValue: 90
    Description: Target utilization percentage for the auto scaling policies.

Resources:

  SessionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: session_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: session_id
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
        WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expires_at
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref TableName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: WebSessionStorage

  AutoScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-autoscaling-role'
      Description: IAM role that allows Application Auto Scaling to scale the sessions DynamoDB table.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowApplicationAutoScalingAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'application-autoscaling.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSApplicationAutoscalingDynamoDBTablePolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-autoscaling-role'

  SessionsTableReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn:
      - SessionsTable
      - AutoScalingRole
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${SessionsTable}'
      ScalableDimension: 'dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits'
      MinCapacity: !Ref MinCapacity
      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxCapacity
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn

  SessionsTableWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn:
      - SessionsTable
      - AutoScalingRole
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${SessionsTable}'
      ScalableDimension: 'dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits'
      MinCapacity: !Ref MinCapacity
      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxCapacity
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn

  SessionsTableReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${TableName}-read-target-tracking'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref SessionsTableReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        DisableScaleIn: false

  SessionsTableWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${TableName}-write-target-tracking'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref SessionsTableWriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        DisableScaleIn: false

Outputs:
  SessionsTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB sessions table.
    Value: !Ref SessionsTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SessionsTableName'

  SessionsTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB sessions table.
    Value: !GetAtt SessionsTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SessionsTableArn'

  TtlAttributeName:
    Description: Attribute name configured as the DynamoDB TTL attribute.
    Value: expires_at

  ReadScalingPolicyName:
    Description: Name of the read capacity target tracking scaling policy.
    Value: !Ref SessionsTableReadScalingPolicy

  WriteScalingPolicyName:
    Description: Name of the write capacity target tracking scaling policy.
    Value: !Ref SessionsTableWriteScalingPolicy

  AutoScalingRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by Application Auto Scaling for the sessions table.
    Value: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Core event-driven architecture for the Retail Demo Store - custom EventBridge event bus (retaildemostore-bus), disabled catch-all rule to CloudWatch Logs (120-day retention), event archive (120-day retention), schema discoverer, and SSM parameter exposing the bus name.

Resources:

  # Custom EventBridge event bus used by all Retail Demo Store services
  RetailDemoStoreEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: retaildemostore-bus

  # Log group that receives all events from the catch-all rule
  EventBusLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/events/retaildemostore-bus
      RetentionInDays: 120

  # Catch-all rule (disabled by default) that forwards every event on the bus to CloudWatch Logs
  CatchAllRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: retaildemostore-catch-all
      Description: Catch-all rule that forwards all events on the retaildemostore-bus to CloudWatch Logs (disabled by default)
      EventBusName: !Ref RetailDemoStoreEventBus
      State: DISABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - prefix: ''
      Targets:
        - Id: retaildemostore-eventbus-logs
          Arn: !GetAtt EventBusLogGroup.Arn

  # Resource policy allowing EventBridge to write events into the log group
  EventBusLogGroupPolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: retaildemostore-eventbus-logging
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Sid": "AllowEventBridgeToLogEvents",
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {
                "Service": "events.amazonaws.com"
              },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:PutLogEvents"
              ],
              "Resource": "${EventBusLogGroup.Arn}:*",
              "Condition": {
                "ArnEquals": {
                  "aws:SourceArn": "${CatchAllRule.Arn}"
                }
              }
            }
          ]
        }

  # Archive of all events published to the bus, retained for 120 days
  RetailDemoStoreEventArchive:
    Type: AWS::Events::Archive
    Properties:
      ArchiveName: retaildemostore-bus-archive
      Description: Archive of all events published to the retaildemostore-bus event bus
      SourceArn: !GetAtt RetailDemoStoreEventBus.Arn
      RetentionDays: 120

  # Schema discoverer that automatically discovers schemas for events on the bus
  RetailDemoStoreSchemaDiscoverer:
    Type: AWS::EventSchemas::Discoverer
    Properties:
      Description: Schema discoverer for the retaildemostore-bus event bus
      SourceArn: !GetAtt RetailDemoStoreEventBus.Arn
      CrossAccount: false

  # SSM parameter consumed by downstream Retail Demo Store services
  EventBusNameParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: RetailDemoStore-eventbus
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref RetailDemoStoreEventBus
      Description: Name of the EventBridge custom event bus used by the Retail Demo Store

Outputs:

  EventBusName:
    Description: Name of the Retail Demo Store EventBridge custom event bus
    Value: !Ref RetailDemoStoreEventBus
    Export:
      Name: retaildemostore-bus

  EventBusArn:
    Description: ARN of the Retail Demo Store EventBridge custom event bus
    Value: !GetAtt RetailDemoStoreEventBus.Arn

  EventBusLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives all events from the catch-all rule
    Value: !Ref EventBusLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Idempotency store for hybrid (polling and event-driven) deduplication workflows.
  Creates an Amazon DynamoDB table with a composite primary key (partition key + sort key),
  Time-to-Live enabled with a configurable retention period (default 7 days), Point-in-Time
  Recovery enabled by default, and an IAM managed policy granting AWS Lambda functions and
  AWS Step Functions state machines read/write access to the table.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Project Configuration
        Parameters:
          - ProjectPrefix
      - Label:
          default: Idempotency Store Key Schema
        Parameters:
          - PartitionKeyName
          - SortKeyName
      - Label:
          default: Expiration (Time to Live)
        Parameters:
          - TtlAttributeName
          - TtlInDays
      - Label:
          default: Table Capacity and Protection
        Parameters:
          - BillingMode
          - ReadCapacityUnits
          - WriteCapacityUnits
          - EnablePointInTimeRecovery
          - EnableDeletionProtection
    ParameterLabels:
      ProjectPrefix:
        default: Project Prefix
      PartitionKeyName:
        default: Partition Key Attribute Name
      SortKeyName:
        default: Sort Key Attribute Name
      TtlAttributeName:
        default: TTL Attribute Name
      TtlInDays:
        default: TTL Retention (Days)
      BillingMode:
        default: DynamoDB Billing Mode
      ReadCapacityUnits:
        default: Read Capacity Units (Provisioned mode only)
      WriteCapacityUnits:
        default: Write Capacity Units (Provisioned mode only)
      EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
        default: Enable Point-in-Time Recovery
      EnableDeletionProtection:
        default: Enable Table Deletion Protection

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    MinLength: 2
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a lowercase letter or number and may contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    Description: Project prefix used to name all resources created by this template.

  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: DeduplicationKey
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only letters, numbers, underscore, period, or hyphen.
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB partition key (HASH) attribute, typically the file or correlation identifier used to detect duplicates.

  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ExecutionReference
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only letters, numbers, underscore, period, or hyphen.
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB sort key (RANGE) attribute, typically the workflow execution, poll cycle, or event identifier.

  TtlAttributeName:
    Type: String
    Default: ExpiresAt
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only letters, numbers, underscore, period, or hyphen.
    Description: Name of the attribute that stores the expiration time as an epoch timestamp in seconds; DynamoDB deletes expired items automatically.

  TtlInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3650
    Description: Default retention period in days used by producers to compute the value written to the TTL attribute (default 7 days).

  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PAY_PER_REQUEST
    AllowedValues:
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
      - PROVISIONED
    Description: DynamoDB billing mode. PAY_PER_REQUEST (on-demand) is recommended for spiky idempotency workloads.

  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 40000
    Description: Provisioned read capacity units. Used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED.

  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 40000
    Description: Provisioned write capacity units. Used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED.

  EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Enable DynamoDB Point-in-Time Recovery (35-day continuous backups). Enabled by default.

  EnableDeletionProtection:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Enable DynamoDB table deletion protection. Must be disabled before the table can be deleted; disabled by default.

Conditions:
  IsProvisionedBillingMode: !Equals
    - !Ref BillingMode
    - PROVISIONED
  IsPointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !Equals
    - !Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery
    - "true"
  IsDeletionProtectionEnabled: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableDeletionProtection
    - "true"

Resources:
  IdempotencyStoreTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-store"
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisionedBillingMode
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: !Ref TtlAttributeName
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If
          - IsPointInTimeRecoveryEnabled
          - true
          - false
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      DeletionProtectionEnabled: !If
        - IsDeletionProtectionEnabled
        - true
        - false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-store"
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectPrefix
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: IdempotencyStore
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: AWS CloudFormation

  IdempotencyStoreAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-store-access"
      Path: /
      Description: !Sub "Read/write access to the ${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-store DynamoDB table for AWS Lambda functions and AWS Step Functions state machines."
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: IdempotencyStoreItemReadWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:Scan
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWrite

Description: Cognito User Pool and Identity Pool for Kibana access to Amazon Elasticsearch Service

Resources:
  KibanaUsersUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: KibanaUsers
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8

  KibanaUsersUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: KibanaUsersClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref KibanaUsersUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  KibanaIDPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: KibanaIDPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref KibanaUsersUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !Sub cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${KibanaUsersUserPool}
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true

  AuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref KibanaIDPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ElasticsearchHttpAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: es:ESHttp*
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:es:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:domain/*

  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref KibanaIDPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': unauthenticated

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:

        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn

  UserPoolId:

    Value: !Ref KibanaUsersUserPool

      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: Cognito Identity Pool ID
    Value: !Ref KibanaIDPool

      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-IdentityPoolId
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool Client ID
    Value: !Ref KibanaUsersUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Creates a DynamoDB table (partition key "id", on-demand capacity) and a Step Functions
  standard workflow that inserts an item using the "id" from the execution input plus a
  formatted description, then retrieves the same item and returns only the retrieved item
  as the final output.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-table
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 3-255 characters and contain only letters, numbers, hyphen, underscore, or period.
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table that the workflow writes to and reads from.

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref TableName

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role used by the Step Functions workflow to access the DynamoDB table.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowStepFunctionsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBItemAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowPutAndGetItem
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Puts an item into DynamoDB and then retrieves it by id",
          "StartAt": "PutItem",
          "States": {
            "PutItem": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:putItem",
              "Parameters": {
                "TableName": "${DynamoDBTable}",
                "Item": {
                  "id": {
                    "S.$": "$.id"
                  },
                  "description": {
                    "S.$": "States.Format('Item {} created by the Step Functions workflow', $.id)"
                  }
                }
              },
              "ResultPath": null,
              "Next": "GetItem"
            },
            "GetItem": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:getItem",
              "Parameters": {
                "TableName": "${DynamoDBTable}",
                "Key": {
                  "id": {
                    "S.$": "$.id"
                  }
                }
              },
              "OutputPath": "$.Item",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-workflow"

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions standard workflow state machine.
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table created by the stack.
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
  StateMachineExecutionRoleArn:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Chaos engineering workflow using AWS Step Functions to test ECS service resilience. The workflow terminates an EC2 instance, waits 300 seconds, checks ECS service health, and publishes an SNS alert if the service is unhealthy.'

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC ID where the EC2 instance and ECS service will be created.

  SubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: List of subnet IDs (public subnets recommended) for the EC2 instance and the ECS Fargate service.

  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.micro
    AllowedValues:
      - t3.nano
      - t3.micro
      - t3.small
      - t3.medium
    Description: EC2 instance type for the chaos test target instance.

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:latest
    Description: Container image for the ECS service under test.

  EcsDesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Desired number of tasks for the ECS service.

  LatestAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/amzn2-ami-hvm-x86_64-gp2
    Description: SSM parameter path for the latest Amazon Linux 2 AMI.

Resources:

  AlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: ECS Chaos Engineering Alerts
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-health-alerts'

  TerminateLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TerminateInstancePermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
                Resource: '*'

  HealthCheckLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: HealthCheckPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                  - ecs:DescribeClusters
                  - ecs:ListServices
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref AlertTopic

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeChaosLambdas
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TerminateInstanceFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt HealthCheckFunction.Arn

  EcsTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy'

  TerminateInstanceFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-terminate-instance'
      Description: Terminates the specified EC2 instance as part of the chaos test.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt TerminateLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
              instance_id = event.get('instanceId')
              if not instance_id:
                  raise ValueError('instanceId is required in the event payload')
              response = ec2.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
              terminating = response['TerminatingInstances'][0]
              return {
                  'instanceId': instance_id,
                  'previousState': terminating['PreviousState']['Name'],
                  'currentState': terminating['CurrentState']['Name']
              }

  HealthCheckFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-health-check'
      Description: Checks the ECS service health and publishes an SNS alert if the service is unhealthy.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt HealthCheckLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              ecs = boto3.client('ecs')
              sns = boto3.client('sns')

              cluster_name = event.get('clusterName')
              service_name = event.get('serviceName')
              topic_arn = event.get('topicArn')

              if not cluster_name or not service_name:
                  raise ValueError('clusterName and serviceName are required in the event payload')

              response = ecs.describe_services(
                  cluster=cluster_name,
                  services=[service_name]
              )
              services = response.get('services', [])
              if not services:
                  raise ValueError('ECS service not found: {}'.format(service_name))

              service = services[0]
              running_count = service.get('runningCount', 0)
              desired_count = service.get('desiredCount', 0)
              status = service.get('status', 'UNKNOWN')
              healthy = desired_count > 0 and running_count >= desired_count and status == 'ACTIVE'

              result = {
                  'clusterName': cluster_name,
                  'serviceName': service_name,
                  'runningCount': running_count,
                  'desiredCount': desired_count,
                  'status': status,
                  'healthy': healthy
              }

              if not healthy and topic_arn:
                  message = (
                      'ECS service {service} in cluster {cluster} is UNHEALTHY. '
                      'Running tasks: {running}, Desired tasks: {desired}, Status: {status}.'
                  ).format(
                      service=service_name,
                      cluster=cluster_name,
                      running=running_count,
                      desired=desired_count,
                      status=status
                  )
                  sns.publish(
                      TopicArn=topic_arn,
                      Subject='ECS Service Health Alert',
                      Message=message
                  )
                  result['alertSent'] = True
              else:
                  result['alertSent'] = False

              return result

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-cluster'

  EcsTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-task'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: chaos-app
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp

  EcsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the ECS Fargate chaos service.
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      ServiceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-service'
      TaskDefinition: !Ref EcsTaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref EcsDesiredCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: ENABLED
          Subnets: !Ref SubnetIds
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref EcsSecurityGroup
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 30

  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the chaos test EC2 instance.
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  ChaosTestInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Select [0, !Ref SubnetIds]
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-test-instance'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ChaosEngineeringTestTarget

  ChaosStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-workflow'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Chaos engineering workflow: terminate EC2, wait 300s, check ECS health",
          "StartAt": "PrepareTestInput",
          "States": {
            "PrepareTestInput": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": {
                "instanceId": "${ChaosTestInstance}",
                "clusterName": "${EcsCluster}",
                "serviceName": "${EcsService}",
                "topicArn": "${AlertTopic}"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$",
              "Next": "TerminateInstance"
            },
            "TerminateInstance": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${TerminateInstanceFunction.Arn}",
              "Next": "WaitForRecovery"
            },
            "WaitForRecovery": {
              "Type": "Wait",
              "Seconds": 300,
              "Next": "CheckEcsHealth"
            },
            "CheckEcsHealth": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${HealthCheckFunction.Arn}",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the chaos engineering Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !Ref ChaosStateMachine

  AlertTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic used for ECS health alerts.
    Value: !Ref AlertTopic

  EcsClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster under test.
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster

  EcsServiceName:
    Description: Name of the ECS service under test.
    Value: !Ref EcsService

  ChaosTestInstanceId:
    Description: Instance ID of the EC2 chaos test target.
    Value: !Ref ChaosTestInstance

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to create a custom SSM inventory collection mechanism for tracking database and caching processes on Windows and Linux EC2 instances.

Parameters:
  LinuxProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: 'CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached'
    Description: Comma-separated list of Linux process keywords to search for.
  WindowsProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: 'sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached'
    Description: Comma-separated list of Windows process keywords to search for.
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: 'rate(30 days)'
    Description: Schedule expression for the SSM association (e.g., rate(30 days) or cron expression).

Resources:
  CustomInventoryProcessesDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Command
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '2.2'
        description: Collect custom inventory of database and caching processes
        parameters:
          LinuxKeywords:
            type: String
            description: Comma-separated list of Linux process keywords
            default: ''
          WindowsKeywords:
            type: String
            description: Comma-separated list of Windows process keywords
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runShellScript
            name: LinuxProcessInventory
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Linux
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - |
                  #!/bin/bash
                  INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)
                  KEYWORDS="{{ LinuxKeywords }}"
                  IFS=',' read -ra KEYWORD_ARRAY <<< "$KEYWORDS"
                  INVENTORY_DIR="/var/lib/amazon/ssm/$(hostname)/inventory/custom"
                  mkdir -p "$INVENTORY_DIR"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Amazon DataZone domain (default name cookbookChapter11) with the SalesPublisher
  producer project and the MarketingConsumer consumer project, the IAM roles required
  for domain execution, data access (AWS Glue, Amazon Redshift and AWS Secrets
  Manager) and environment provisioning, and the DefaultDataWarehouse environment
  blueprint enabled in the current region.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: cookbookChapter11
    Description: Name of the Amazon DataZone domain.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w][\w-]{0,63}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must start with an alphanumeric character or underscore and can contain only
      alphanumeric characters, underscores and hyphens, up to 64 characters.

  DomainDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: Amazon DataZone domain for the data producer and data consumer teams.
    Description: Description of the Amazon DataZone domain.
    MaxLength: 2048

  SalesPublisherProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: SalesPublisher
    Description: Name of the Amazon DataZone project used by the data producer team.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64

  MarketingConsumerProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: MarketingConsumer
    Description: Name of the Amazon DataZone project used by the data consumer team.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64

  EnvironmentBlueprintIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: DefaultDataWarehouse
    Description: Identifier of the environment blueprint to enable in the domain.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumed by Amazon DataZone to perform domain level operations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DataZoneDomainExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by Amazon DataZone to perform domain level operations.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DataZoneAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - datazone.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataZoneDomainExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DataZoneDomainPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - datazone:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudFormationPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AssumeEnvironmentRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt DataZoneDataAccessRole.Arn
                  - !GetAtt DataZoneEnvironmentProvisioningRole.Arn
              - Sid: KmsPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ResourceAccessManagerPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ram:AcceptResourceShareInvitation
                  - ram:GetResourceShareInvitations
                  - ram:GetResourceShares
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: AmazonDataZone

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role used by Amazon DataZone to access data sources and data assets
  # (AWS Glue Data Catalog, Amazon Redshift, AWS Secrets Manager)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DataZoneDataAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role used by Amazon DataZone to access Glue Data Catalog, Amazon Redshift and
        AWS Secrets Manager resources on behalf of the domain.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DataZoneAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - datazone.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataZoneDataAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: GlueDataCatalogAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:BatchGetPartition
                  - glue:CreateDatabase
                  - glue:CreateTable
                  - glue:DeleteDatabase
                  - glue:DeleteTable
                  - glue:GetCatalogImportStatus
                  - glue:GetConnection
                  - glue:GetConnections
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:GetPartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:GetTags
                  - glue:GetUserDefinedFunction
                  - glue:GetUserDefinedFunctions
                  - glue:PassConnection
                  - glue:UpdateDatabase
                  - glue:UpdateTable
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: RedshiftAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - redshift:DescribeClusterSubnetGroups
                  - redshift:DescribeClusters
                  - redshift:GetClusterCredentials
                  - redshift:GetClusterCredentialsWithIAM
                  - redshift-data:DescribeStatement
                  - redshift-data:DescribeTable
                  - redshift-data:ExecuteStatement
                  - redshift-data:GetStatementResult
                  - redshift-data:ListDatabases
                  - redshift-data:ListSchemas
                  - redshift-data:ListTables
                  - redshift-serverless:GetCredentials
                  - redshift-serverless:GetWorkgroup
                  - redshift-serverless:ListWorkgroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SecretsManagerAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3DataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: AmazonDataZone

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role used by Amazon DataZone to provision environments (CloudFormation)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DataZoneEnvironmentProvisioningRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role used by Amazon DataZone to provision environment resources.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DataZoneAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - datazone.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataZoneEnvironmentProvisioningPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudFormationProvisioning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:TagResource
                  - cloudformation:UntagResource
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassRoleToCloudFormation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: DataLakeStorageAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: GlueCatalogProvisioning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:CreateDatabase
                  - glue:CreateTable
                  - glue:DeleteDatabase
                  - glue:DeleteTable
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:TagResource
                  - glue:UntagResource
                  - glue:UpdateDatabase
                  - glue:UpdateTable
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: KmsPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: AmazonDataZone

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Amazon DataZone domain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DataZoneDomain:
    Type: AWS::DataZone::Domain
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Description: !Ref DomainDescription
      DomainExecutionRole: !GetAtt DataZoneDomainExecutionRole.Arn
      SingleSignOn:
        Type: DISABLED
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref DomainName
        - Key: Application
          Value: AmazonDataZone

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DataZone projects: producer (SalesPublisher) and consumer (MarketingConsumer)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SalesPublisherProject:
    Type: AWS::DataZone::Project
    Properties:
      DomainIdentifier: !GetAtt DataZoneDomain.Id
      Name: !Ref SalesPublisherProjectName
      Description: Amazon DataZone project for the data producer (sales) team.

  MarketingConsumerProject:
    Type: AWS::DataZone::Project
    Properties:
      DomainIdentifier: !GetAtt DataZoneDomain.Id
      Name: !Ref MarketingConsumerProjectName
      Description: Amazon DataZone project for the data consumer (marketing) team.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Enable the DefaultDataWarehouse blueprint in the current region
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DefaultDataWarehouseBlueprintConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::DataZone::EnvironmentBlueprintConfiguration
    Properties:
      DomainIdentifier: !GetAtt DataZoneDomain.Id
      EnvironmentBlueprintIdentifier: !Ref EnvironmentBlueprintIdentifier
      EnabledRegions:
        - !Ref AWS::Region
      ProvisioningRoleArn: !GetAtt DataZoneEnvironmentProvisioningRole.Arn
      ManageAccessRoleArn: !GetAtt DataZoneDataAccessRole.Arn

Outputs:
  DataZoneDomainId:
    Description: Identifier of the Amazon DataZone domain.
    Value: !GetAtt DataZoneDomain.Id
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DataZoneDomainId'

  DataZoneDomainArn:
    Description: ARN of the Amazon DataZone domain.
    Value: !GetAtt DataZoneDomain.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DataZoneDomainArn'

  DataZonePortalUrl:
    Description: URL of the Amazon DataZone portal for the domain.
    Value: !GetAtt DataZoneDomain.PortalUrl
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DataZonePortalUrl'

  SalesPublisherProjectId:
    Description: Identifier of the SalesPublisher Amazon DataZone project.
    Value: !Ref SalesPublisherProject
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SalesPublisherProjectId'

  MarketingConsumerProjectId:
    Description: Identifier of the MarketingConsumer Amazon DataZone project.
    Value: !Ref MarketingConsumerProject
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MarketingConsumerProjectId'

  DomainExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Amazon DataZone domain execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt DataZoneDomainExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DomainExecutionRoleArn'

  DataAccessRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Amazon DataZone data access role.
    Value: !GetAtt DataZoneDataAccessRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DataAccessRoleArn'

  EnvironmentProvisioningRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Amazon DataZone environment provisioning role.
    Value: !GetAtt DataZoneEnvironmentProvisioningRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EnvironmentProvisioningRoleArn'

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

        Version: "2012-10-17"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates a scheduled Lambda function to clean up expired items from a DynamoDB table named 'throttle' (or specified by TableName). The schedule can be disabled by setting ScheduleExpression to an empty string.

Parameters:
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: 'rate(1 hour)'
    Description: Schedule expression for the cleanup Lambda. Set to an empty string to disable the schedule.
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: throttle
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table to clean up.
  RangeKeyAttribute:
    Type: String
    Default: expiresAt
    Description: Name of the range (sort) key attribute used to determine expired items.
  RangeKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - N
      - S
    Description: Type of the range key attribute. Use N for numeric epoch timestamps, S for ISO8601 strings.

Conditions:
  ScheduleEnabled: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref ScheduleExpression
      - ''

Resources:
  CleanupLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      RetentionInDays: 30

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${TableName}

  DynamoDBCleanupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: CleanupLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      Description: Cleans up expired items from the DynamoDB table.
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref TableName
          RANGE_KEY_NAME: !Ref RangeKeyAttribute
          RANGE_KEY_TYPE: !Ref RangeKeyType
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import time
          import boto3
          from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Attr

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
              range_key_name = os.environ['RANGE_KEY_NAME']
              range_key_type = os.environ.get('RANGE_KEY_TYPE', 'N')

              dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
              table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

              now = int(time.time())
              if range_key_type == 'S':
                  now_value = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now))
              else:
                  now_value = now

              scan_kwargs = {
                  'FilterExpression': Attr(range_key_name).lt(now_value)
              }

              deleted = 0
              with table.batch_writer() as batch:
                  while True:
                      response = table.scan(**scan_kwargs)
                      items = response.get('Items', [])
                      for item in items:
                          key = {key_attr['AttributeName']: item[key_attr['AttributeName']] for key_attr in table.key_schema}
                          batch.delete_item(Key=key)
                          deleted += 1
                      if 'LastEvaluatedKey' not in response:
                          break
                      scan_kwargs['ExclusiveStartKey'] = response['LastEvaluatedKey']
              return {'deleted': deleted}

  CleanupScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: ScheduleEnabled
    Properties:
      Description: Triggers the DynamoDB cleanup Lambda on a schedule.
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt DynamoDBCleanupFunction.Arn
          Id: DynamoDBCleanupTarget

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: ScheduleEnabled
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt CleanupScheduleRule.Arn

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBCleanupFunction
    Description: Name of the cleanup Lambda function.
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBCleanupFunction.Arn
    Description: ARN of the cleanup Lambda function.
  LogGroupName:
    Value: !Ref CleanupLogGroup
    Description: CloudWatch Log Group for the cleanup Lambda.
  ScheduleRuleArn:
    Condition: ScheduleEnabled
    Value: !GetAtt CleanupScheduleRule.Arn
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge schedule rule (if enabled).
  LambdaRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for the cleanup Lambda.

Description: ECS Fargate task definition for a containerized application, with supporting ECS task role, task execution role, and CloudWatch log group.

    MaxLength: 255

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TaskRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

        - PolicyName: root
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssmmessages:CreateControlChannel
                  - ssmmessages:CreateDataChannel
                  - ssmmessages:OpenControlChannel
                  - ssmmessages:OpenDataChannel
                Resource: "*"

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TaskExecutionRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy"

              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region

Description: AWS IoT SiteWise asset models for wind farm demo

Resources:
  WindTurbineAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: WindTurbine
      AssetModelDescription: Asset model for a wind turbine
      AssetModelProperties:
        - Name: TurbineModel
          DataType: STRING
          Type: Attribute
          LogicalId: TurbineModel
        - Name: TurbineCapacity
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type: Attribute
          LogicalId: TurbineCapacity
        - Name: WindSpeed
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type: Measurement
          Unit: m/s
          LogicalId: WindSpeed
        - Name: Torque
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type: Measurement
          Unit: Nm
          LogicalId: Torque
        - Name: Power
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type: Measurement
          Unit: kW
          LogicalId: Power
        - Name: OverdriveState
          DataType: INTEGER
          Type: Transform
          Expression: "if(gt(Torque, 3), 1, 0)"
          LogicalId: OverdriveState
        - Name: AverageWindSpeed
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type: Metric
          Unit: m/s
          Expression: "avg(WindSpeed)"
          Window:
            Tumbling:
              Interval: 5m
          LogicalId: AverageWindSpeed
        - Name: OverdriveStateTime
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type: Metric
          Unit: seconds
          Expression: "sum(OverdriveState)"
          Window:
            Tumbling:
              Interval: 5m
          LogicalId: OverdriveStateTime
        - Name: AveragePower
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type: Metric
          Unit: kW
          Expression: "avg(Power)"
          Window:
            Tumbling:
              Interval: 5m
          LogicalId: AveragePower

  WindFarmAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: WindFarm
      AssetModelDescription: Asset model for a wind farm
      AssetModelProperties:
        - Name: FarmName
          DataType: STRING
          Type: Attribute
          LogicalId: FarmName
        - Name: FarmCapacity
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type: Attribute
          LogicalId: FarmCapacity
        - Name: TotalAveragePower
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type: Metric
          Unit: kW
          Expression: "sum(Turbines.AveragePower)"
          Window:
            Tumbling:
              Interval: 5m
          LogicalId: TotalAveragePower
        - Name: TotalOverdriveStateTime
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type: Metric
          Unit: seconds
          Expression: "sum(Turbines.OverdriveStateTime)"
          Window:
            Tumbling:
              Interval: 5m
          LogicalId: TotalOverdriveStateTime
        - Name: AverageWindSpeed
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type: Metric
          Unit: m/s
          Expression: "avg(Turbines.AverageWindSpeed)"
          Window:
            Tumbling:
              Interval: 5m
          LogicalId: AverageWindSpeed

    Description: ID of the Wind Farm Asset Model
    Value: !Ref WindFarmAssetModel

    Description: ID of the hierarchy associating Wind Farm to Turbines
    Value: "TurbinesHierarchy"

Description: >-
  Creates two Amazon Cognito Identity Pools with unauthenticated identity support
  (one for Lambda-based access and one for Step Functions workflow-based access),
  the IAM roles assumed by unauthenticated identities, the inline policies granting
  the required Lambda, DynamoDB, SES and Step Functions permissions, and the role
  attachments that bind each role back to its corresponding identity pool.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: test
    Description: Short environment name used as a prefix for exported values and logical naming.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9\-]+'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  LambdaIdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: lambda-identity-pool
    Description: Name of the Cognito Identity Pool used for Lambda-based access.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9 _+=,.@\-]+'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, spaces and _+=,.@- symbols.

  StepFunctionsIdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: stepfunctions-identity-pool
    Description: Name of the Cognito Identity Pool used for Step Functions workflow-based access.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9 _+=,.@\-]+'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, spaces and _+=,.@- symbols.

  LambdaIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref LambdaIdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      AllowClassicFlow: false
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref LambdaIdentityPoolName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: LambdaAccess

  StepFunctionsIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref StepFunctionsIdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      AllowClassicFlow: false
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref StepFunctionsIdentityPoolName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: StepFunctionsAccess

  LambdaUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by unauthenticated Cognito identities for the Lambda-facing identity pool.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

Description: PCI compliance remediation SSM Automation documents and prerequisite IAM role.

Resources:
  PCIAutomationAssumeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'pciautomationassumerole${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PCIAutomationRemediationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
                Resource: '*'

  DefaultSecurityGroupRestrictDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DependsOn: PCIAutomationAssumeRole
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'PCI-DefaultSecurityGroupRestrict-${AWS::Region}'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Restricts the default security group by revoking all ingress and egress rules.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/pciautomationassumerole${AWS::Region}'
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the security group to restrict.
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeAllRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                def handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    sg_id = events['SecurityGroupId']
                    sg = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[sg_id])['SecurityGroups'][0]
                    if sg.get('IpPermissions'):
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(GroupId=sg_id, IpPermissions=sg['IpPermissions'])
                    if sg.get('IpPermissionsEgress'):
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(GroupId=sg_id, IpPermissions=sg['IpPermissionsEgress'])
                    return {'Status': 'Success'}
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
            isEnd: true

  DeleteUnusedSecurityGroupsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DependsOn: PCIAutomationAssumeRole
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'PCI-DeleteUnusedSecurityGroups-${AWS::Region}'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Deletes unused security groups (those with no network interfaces).
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/pciautomationassumerole${AWS::Region}'
          SecurityGroupIds:
            type: String
            description: Comma-separated list of security group IDs to check and delete if unused.
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteUnusedSGs
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                def handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    sg_ids = events['SecurityGroupIds']
                    if isinstance(sg_ids, str):
                        sg_ids = [s.strip() for s in sg_ids.split(',') if s.strip()]
                    deleted = []
                    skipped = []
                    for sg_id in sg_ids:
                        try:
                            sg = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[sg_id])['SecurityGroups'][0]
                            if not sg.get('NetworkInterfaces'):
                                ec2.delete_security_group(GroupId=sg_id)
                                deleted.append(sg_id)
                            else:
                                skipped.append(sg_id)
                        except Exception as e:
                            skipped.append(sg_id)
                    return {'Deleted': deleted, 'Skipped': skipped}
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupIds: '{{ SecurityGroupIds }}'
            isEnd: true

  ReleaseUnassociatedEIPsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DependsOn: PCIAutomationAssumeRole
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'PCI-ReleaseUnassociatedEIPs-${AWS::Region}'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Releases unassociated Elastic IP addresses using their allocation IDs.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/pciautomationassumerole${AWS::Region}'
          AllocationIds:
            type: String
            description: Comma-separated list of Elastic IP allocation IDs to release.
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseEIPs
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                def handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    alloc_ids = events['AllocationIds']
                    if isinstance(alloc_ids, str):
                        alloc_ids = [a.strip() for a in alloc_ids.split(',') if a.strip()]
                    released = []
                    failed = []
                    for alloc_id in alloc_ids:
                        try:
                            ec2.release_address(AllocationId=alloc_id)
                            released.append(alloc_id)
                        except Exception as e:
                            failed.append(alloc_id)
                    return {'Released': released, 'Failed': failed}
              InputPayload:
                AllocationIds: '{{ AllocationIds }}'
            isEnd: true

  UpdateASGHealthCheckDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DependsOn: PCIAutomationAssumeRole
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'PCI-UpdateASGHealthCheck-${AWS::Region}'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Updates an Auto Scaling group's health check type to ELB with a grace period of 300 seconds.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/pciautomationassumerole${AWS::Region}'
          AutoScalingGroupName:
            type: String
            description: The name of the Auto Scaling group to update.
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateASGHealthCheck
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                def handler(events, context):
                    autoscaling = boto3.client('autoscaling')
                    asg_name = events['AutoScalingGroupName']
                    autoscaling.update_auto_scaling_group(
                        AutoScalingGroupName=asg_name,
                        HealthCheckType='ELB',
                        HealthCheckGracePeriod=300
                    )
                    return {'Status': 'Success', 'AutoScalingGroupName': asg_name}
              InputPayload:
                AutoScalingGroupName: '{{ AutoScalingGroupName }}'
            isEnd: true
