AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Mirror CodeCommit repositories to a target replica region using CodeBuild and EventBridge.

Parameters:
  TargetReplicaRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Target AWS region for CodeCommit repository replicas.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-\d$'
  SourceBranch:
    Type: String
    Default: mainline
    Description: Branch to mirror from source repositories.

Resources:
  CodeBuildServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeCommitMirrorAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:GitPull
                  - codecommit:GitPush
                  - codecommit:GetRepository
                  - codecommit:GetBranch
                  - codecommit:ListBranches
                  - codecommit:GetCommit
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline
        - PolicyName: CodeBuildLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/codebuild/${AWS::StackName}-mirror-codecommit-repos:*
        - PolicyName: S3DefaultEncryptionKeyAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/aws/s3

  CodeBuildProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-mirror-codecommit-repos
      Description: Mirror CodeCommit repositories to target replica region
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildServiceRole.Arn
      Source:
        Type: NO_SOURCE
        BuildSpec: |
          version: 0.2
          phases:
            install:
              commands:
                - pip3 install --upgrade pip
                - pip3 install git-remote-codecommit
            pre_build:
              commands:
                - git config --global user.email "codebuild@example.com"
                - git config --global user.name "CodeBuild Mirror"
            build:
              commands:
                - |
                  for repo in card-service rule-service ecs-pipeline; do
                    echo "Mirroring $repo from $AWS_DEFAULT_REGION to $TARGET_REGION"
                    rm -rf /tmp/$repo
                    git clone --branch "$SOURCE_BRANCH" codecommit::$AWS_DEFAULT_REGION://$repo /tmp/$repo
                    cd /tmp/$repo
                    git remote add replica codecommit::$TARGET_REGION://$repo
                    git push --force replica "$SOURCE_BRANCH"
                    cd -

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Secure S3 bucket infrastructure with primary, access log, and replica buckets, replication, and logging.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: testanu
    Description: Application name used as a prefix for S3 bucket names.
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be lowercase alphanumeric with optional hyphens, start and end with alphanumeric.

Resources:
  AccessLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AppName}-access-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  AccessLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogsDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:PutObjectAcl
            Resource: !Sub "${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"

  ReplicaBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DependsOn: AccessLogBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: !Sub "logs/${AppName}/replica/"

  ReplicaBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ReplicaBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${ReplicaBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogsDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:PutObjectAcl
            Resource: !Sub "${ReplicaBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  ReplicationPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Policy for S3 replication role
      Path: /
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketVersioning
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObjectVersionForReplication
              - s3:GetObjectVersionAcl
              - s3:GetObjectVersionTagging
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ReplicateObject
              - s3:ReplicateDelete
              - s3:ReplicateTags
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*"

  ReplicationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: Role for S3 same-region replication
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReplicationPolicy

  PrimaryBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DependsOn:
      - AccessLogBucketPolicy
      - ReplicaBucket
      - ReplicationRole
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: !Sub "logs/${AppName}/primary/"
      ReplicationConfiguration:
        Role: !GetAtt ReplicationRole.Arn
        Rules:
          - Id: ReplicateAll
            Status: Enabled
            Destination:
              Bucket: !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
              StorageClass: STANDARD
            DeleteMarkerReplication:
              Status: Disabled

  PrimaryBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PrimaryBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt PrimaryBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${PrimaryBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogsDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:PutObjectAcl
            Resource: !Sub "${PrimaryBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

Outputs:
  PrimaryBucketName:
    Description: Name of the primary S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref PrimaryBucket
  ReplicaBucketName:
    Description: Name of the replica S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref ReplicaBucket
  AccessLogBucketName:
    Description: Name of the access log S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref AccessLogBucket
  ReplicationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 replication IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt ReplicationRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Automation infrastructure for Aurora Global Database failover using SSM Automation, Lambda, and Route 53 ARC.

Parameters:
  PrimaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Primary AWS region for the Aurora Global Database.
  SecondaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: Secondary AWS region for the Aurora Global Database.
  SecretId:
    Type: String
    Default: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSecret
    Description: Secrets Manager secret ID to update with the new writer endpoint.

Resources:
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rds:*
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:*
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:*
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - ssm:*
                Resource: '*'

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TriggerFailoverLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:ListAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:DescribeDocument
                  - ssm:GetDocument
                  - ssm:ListDocuments
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn

  AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Aurora Global Database failover automation
        parameters:
          PrimaryRegion:
            type: String
            default: us-east-1
            description: Primary AWS region
          SecondaryRegion:
            type: String
            default: us-west-2
            description: Secondary AWS region
          SecretId:
            type: String
            default: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSecret
            description: Secrets Manager secret ID to update with the new writer endpoint
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role that SSM Automation assumes
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        mainSteps:
          - name: determineActiveRegion
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import os

                def handler(event, context):
                    primary = event['PrimaryRegion']
                    secondary = event['SecondaryRegion']
                    active_region = primary
                    inactive_region = secondary
                    active_arn = ''
                    inactive_arn = ''
                    for region in [primary, secondary]:
                        try:
                            config = boto3.client('route53-recovery-control-config', region_name=region)
                            clusters = config.list_clusters().get('Clusters', [])
                            for cluster in clusters:
                                panels = config.list_control_panels(ClusterArn=cluster['ClusterArn']).get('ControlPanels', [])
                                for panel in panels:
                                    routing_controls = config.list_routing_controls(ControlPanelArn=panel['ControlPanelArn']).get('RoutingControls', [])
                                    for rc in routing_controls:
                                        arn = rc['RoutingControlArn']
                                        data = boto3.client('route53-recovery-cluster', region_name=region)
                                        state = data.get_routing_control_state(RoutingControlArn=arn).get('RoutingControlState')
                                        if state == 'On':
                                            active_region = region
                                            inactive_region = secondary if region == primary else primary
                                            active_arn = arn
                                            other_region = secondary if region == primary else primary
                                            try:
                                                other_config = boto3.client('route53-recovery-control-config', region_name=other_region)
                                                other_clusters = other_config.list_clusters().get('Clusters', [])
                                                for oc in other_clusters:
                                                    other_panels = other_config.list_control_panels(ClusterArn=oc['ClusterArn']).get('ControlPanels', [])
                                                    for op in other_panels:
                                                        other_rcs = other_config.list_routing_controls(ControlPanelArn=op['ControlPanelArn']).get('RoutingControls', [])
                                                        if other_rcs:
                                                            inactive_arn = other_rcs[0]['RoutingControlArn']
                                                            break
                                                    if inactive_arn:
                                                        break
                                                if inactive_arn:
                                                    break
                                            except Exception:
                                                pass
                                            return {
                                                'activeRegion': active_region,
                                                'inactiveRegion': inactive_region,
                                                'activeRoutingControlArn': active_arn,
                                                'inactiveRoutingControlArn': inactive_arn
                                            }
                        except Exception:
                            continue
                    return {
                        'activeRegion': active_region,
                        'inactiveRegion': inactive_region,
                        'activeRoutingControlArn': active_arn,
                        'inactiveRoutingControlArn': inactive_arn
                    }
              InputPayload:
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: ActiveRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.activeRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: InactiveRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.inactiveRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: ActiveRoutingControlArn
                Selector: $.Payload.activeRoutingControlArn
                Type: String
              - Name: InactiveRoutingControlArn
                Selector: $.Payload.inactiveRoutingControlArn
                Type: String

          - name: performGlobalClusterFailover
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import time

                def handler(event, context):
                    active_region = event['ActiveRegion']
                    inactive_region = event['InactiveRegion']
                    rds = boto3.client('rds', region_name=active_region)
                    global_clusters = rds.describe_global_clusters().get('GlobalClusters', [])
                    if not global_clusters:
                        raise Exception('No Aurora global clusters found')
                    gc = global_clusters[0]
                    target_arn = None
                    for member in gc.get('GlobalClusterMembers', []):
                        member_region = member['DBClusterArn'].split(':')[3]
                        if member_region == inactive_region:
                            target_arn = member['DBClusterArn']
                            break
                    if not target_arn:
                        raise Exception('No DB cluster found in inactive region ' + inactive_region)
                    target_id = target_arn.split(':')[-1]
                    rds.failover_global_cluster(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=gc['GlobalClusterIdentifier'],
                        TargetDbClusterIdentifier=target_id
                    )
                    time.sleep(60)
                    target_rds = boto3.client('rds', region_name=inactive_region)
                    clusters = target_rds.describe_db_clusters(DBClusterIdentifier=target_id).get('DBClusters', [])
                    endpoint = clusters[0]['Endpoint'] if clusters else ''
                    return {
                        'newWriterEndpoint': endpoint,
                        'activeRegion': inactive_region,
                        'inactiveRegion': active_region
                    }
              InputPayload:
                ActiveRegion: '{{ determineActiveRegion.ActiveRegion }}'
                InactiveRegion: '{{ determineActiveRegion.InactiveRegion }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: NewWriterEndpoint
                Selector: $.Payload.newWriterEndpoint
                Type: String
              - Name: ActiveRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.activeRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: InactiveRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.inactiveRegion
                Type: String

          - name: flipRoutingControlsAndUpdateSecret
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import json

                def handler(event, context):
                    new_active_region = event['NewActiveRegion']
                    old_active_region = event['OldActiveRegion']
                    new_active_arn = event['NewActiveRoutingControlArn']
                    old_active_arn = event['OldActiveRoutingControlArn']
                    new_endpoint = event['NewWriterEndpoint']
                    secret_id = event['SecretId']
                    if old_active_arn:
                        old_data = boto3.client('route53-recovery-cluster', region_name=old_active_region)
                        old_data.update_routing_control_state(RoutingControlArn=old_active_arn, RoutingControlState='Off')
                    if new_active_arn:
                        new_data = boto3.client('route53-recovery-cluster', region_name=new_active_region)
                        new_data.update_routing_control_state(RoutingControlArn=new_active_arn, RoutingControlState='On')
                    secrets = boto3.client('secretsmanager', region_name=new_active_region)
                    secret_value = json.dumps({'writerEndpoint': new_endpoint})
                    try:
                        secrets.put_secret_value(SecretId=secret_id, SecretString=secret_value)
                    except secrets.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                        secrets.create_secret(Name=secret_id, SecretString=secret_value)
                    return {'status': 'success', 'writerEndpoint': new_endpoint}
              InputPayload:
                NewActiveRegion: '{{ performGlobalClusterFailover.ActiveRegion }}'
                OldActiveRegion: '{{ performGlobalClusterFailover.InactiveRegion }}'
                NewActiveRoutingControlArn: '{{ determineActiveRegion.InactiveRoutingControlArn }}'
                OldActiveRoutingControlArn: '{{ determineActiveRegion.ActiveRoutingControlArn }}'
                NewWriterEndpoint: '{{ performGlobalClusterFailover.NewWriterEndpoint }}'
                SecretId: '{{ SecretId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: Status
                Selector: $.Payload.status
                Type: String

  TriggerFailover:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: TriggerFailover
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          PRIMARY_REGION: !Ref PrimaryRegion
          SECONDARY_REGION: !Ref SecondaryRegion
          SECRET_ID: !Ref SecretId
          DOCUMENT_NAME: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
          SSM_AUTOMATION_ROLE_ARN: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              primary = event.get('PrimaryRegion', os.environ.get('PRIMARY_REGION', 'us-east-1'))
              secondary = event.get('SecondaryRegion', os.environ.get('SECONDARY_REGION', 'us-west-2'))
              secret_id = event.get('SecretId', os.environ.get('SECRET_ID', 'AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSecret'))
              doc_name = os.environ.get('DOCUMENT_NAME', 'AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument')
              role_arn = os.environ['SSM_AUTOMATION_ROLE_ARN']
              ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
              response = ssm.start_automation_execution(
                  DocumentName=doc_name,
                  Parameters={
                      'PrimaryRegion': [primary],
                      'SecondaryRegion': [secondary],
                      'SecretId': [secret_id],
                      'AutomationAssumeRole': [role_arn]
                  }
              )
              return {
                  'AutomationExecutionId': response['AutomationExecutionId']
              }

Outputs:
  SSMAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SSM Automation role
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
  LambdaExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
  SSMDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Automation document
    Value: !Ref AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
  TriggerFailoverFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the Lambda function
    Value: !Ref TriggerFailover
  TriggerFailoverFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt TriggerFailover.Arn

Description: Kinesis data stream with Cognito unauthenticated access for testing

Resources:
  KinesisStream:
    Type: AWS::Kinesis::Stream
    Properties:
      Name: my-stream-kinesis
      ShardCount: 1
      RetentionPeriodHours: 24

  CognitoIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: my-stream-kinesis-identity-pool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true

  CognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com

            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": unauthenticated

    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: KinesisPutRecordsPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoUnauthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kinesis:PutRecord
              - kinesis:PutRecords
            Resource: !GetAtt KinesisStream.Arn

  CognitoIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt CognitoUnauthRole.Arn

Outputs:
  IdentityPoolId:

    Value: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Creates six IAM roles that allow Amazon EventBridge to forward CloudWatch, CloudFormation, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Slack, and Auto Scaling events to corresponding centralized event buses in a central logging AWS account.'

    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    MinLength: 12

    Type: String
    Default: OrgEventBridge
    Description: 'Prefix for the EventBridge forwarder IAM role names. The AWS Region is included to keep role names unique across regional stacks.'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@_-]+$'
  CloudWatchEventBusName:
    Type: String
    Default: central-cloudwatch-events
    Description: 'Name of the central EventBridge event bus for CloudWatch events.'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$'
  CloudFormationEventBusName:
    Type: String
    Default: central-cloudformation-events
    Description: 'Name of the central EventBridge event bus for CloudFormation events.'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256

  CloudTrailEventBusName:

    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$'

    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: 'Environment tag value.'
  Owner:
    Type: String
    Default: security-operations
    Description: 'Owner tag value.'
  CostCenter:
    Type: String

  Application:

  GuardDutyEventForwarderRoleArn:

  SlackEventForwarderRoleArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the IAM role EventBridge uses to publish Slack notification events to the central logging account.'
    Value: !GetAtt SlackEventForwarderRole.Arn
  AutoScalingEventForwarderRoleArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the IAM role EventBridge uses to publish Auto Scaling events to the central logging account.'
    Value: !GetAtt AutoScalingEventForwarderRole.Arn

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: Environment

        - Key: Owner

        - Key: CostCenter
          Value: !Ref CostCenter
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application
        - Key: DataClassification
          Value: !Ref DataClassification
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: !Ref ManagedBy
        - Key: EventSource

  GuardDutyEventForwarderRole:

    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark aligned VPC Flow Logs automation. Deploys a
  CloudWatch Logs log group with long-term retention, the IAM roles required for
  VPC Flow Log delivery and for AWS Systems Manager Automation execution, and two
  Systems Manager Automation documents: one that enables VPC Flow Logs with
  rejected traffic capture directly on a VPC, and one that routes the same
  remediation through AWS Systems Manager Change Manager as a formal change
  request before it is executed.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: cis-vpc-flowlogs
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-_]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter or number and contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.
    Description: Prefix used to name the IAM roles and Systems Manager Automation documents created by this template.

  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/vpc/flowlogs
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 512
    AllowedPattern: '^[\.\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CloudWatch Logs log group name.
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the VPC Flow Log records.

  FlowLogsRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3653
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: Number of days that VPC Flow Log records are retained in CloudWatch Logs. The default of 3653 days (10 years) supports long-term compliance retention.

  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: REJECT
    AllowedValues:
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
      - ALL
    Description: Type of traffic captured by the VPC Flow Log. REJECT captures rejected traffic as recommended by the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark.

  FlowLogMaxAggregationInterval:
    Type: String
    Default: '600'
    AllowedValues:
      - '60'
      - '600'
    Description: Maximum interval, in seconds, during which flow log data is aggregated before it is published to CloudWatch Logs.

  ChangeManagerAutoApprove:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether change requests created by the Change Manager wrapper runbook are auto-approved. Set to false to require formal change approval.

Resources:

  VpcFlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogsRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroupName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: ComplianceControl
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations-VPCFlowLogging

  VpcFlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by VPC Flow Logs to publish records to CloudWatch Logs and by Systems Manager Automation to manage EC2 VPC Flow Log resources.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsAndSystemsManager
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsDeliveryAndManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogRecordsToCloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${VpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: ManageVpcFlowLogResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassFlowLogsRoleToEc2
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-automation-execution-role'
      Description: Execution role assumed by the Systems Manager Automation documents to enable VPC Flow Logs and to submit Change Manager change requests.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSystemsManagerAutomation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsAutomationExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageVpcFlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageFlowLogsLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                  - logs:TagResource
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${VpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: RunAutomationAndChangeRequests
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:StartChangeRequestExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationStepExecutions
                  - ssm:StopAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetDocument
                  - ssm:DescribeDocument
                  - ssm:ListDocuments
                  - ssm:ListDocumentVersions
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassRolesToEc2AndAutomation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsRole.Arn
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${NamePrefix}-automation-execution-role'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-automation-execution-role'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  EnableVpcFlowLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DependsOn:
      - VpcFlowLogsLogGroup
      - VpcFlowLogsRole
      - AutomationExecutionRole
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-EnableVpcFlowLogs'
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content: !Sub
        - |
          schemaVersion: '0.3'
          description: >-
            Enables a CloudWatch Logs VPC Flow Log that captures rejected traffic for the
            specified VPC, aligning the account with the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
            control for VPC flow logging.
          assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
          parameters:
            VpcId:
              type: String
              description: The ID of the VPC for which VPC Flow Logs are enabled.
            LogGroupName:
              type: String
              description: The CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the VPC Flow Log records.
              default: '${LogGroupName}'
            DeliverLogsPermissionArn:
              type: String
              description: The ARN of the IAM role that VPC Flow Logs assumes to publish records to CloudWatch Logs.
              default: '${DeliverLogsPermissionArn}'
            TrafficType:
              type: String
              description: The type of traffic that the flow log captures.
              default: '${TrafficType}'
              allowedValues:
                - ACCEPT
                - REJECT
                - ALL
            MaxAggregationInterval:
              type: Integer
              description: The maximum interval, in seconds, during which flow log data is aggregated before it is published.
              default: ${MaxAggregationInterval}
              allowedValues:
                - 60
                - 600
            AutomationAssumeRole:
              type: String
              description: The ARN of the IAM role that the automation assumes while it runs its steps.
              default: '${AutomationAssumeRole}'
          mainSteps:
            - name: EnableVpcFlowLogs
              action: aws:executeScript
              description: Creates a CloudWatch Logs VPC Flow Log for the specified VPC when one is not already active.
              inputs:
                Runtime: python3.11
                Handler: handler
                InputPayload:
                  VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                  LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
                  DeliverLogsPermissionArn: '{{ DeliverLogsPermissionArn }}'
                  TrafficType: '{{ TrafficType }}'
                  MaxAggregationInterval: '{{ MaxAggregationInterval }}'
                Script: |-
                  import boto3

                  def handler(events, context):
                      vpc_id = events['VpcId']
                      log_group_name = events['LogGroupName']
                      deliver_logs_permission_arn = events['DeliverLogsPermissionArn']
                      traffic_type = events.get('TrafficType') or 'REJECT'
                      max_aggregation_interval = int(events.get('MaxAggregationInterval') or 600)

                      ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                      existing = ec2.describe_flow_logs(
                          Filters=[
                              {'Name': 'resource-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]},
                              {'Name': 'log-destination-type', 'Values': ['cloud-watch-logs']}
                          ]
                      ).get('FlowLogs', [])

                      active_flow_logs = [f for f in existing if f.get('FlowLogStatus') == 'ACTIVE']
                      if active_flow_logs:
                          return {
                              'Status': 'AlreadyEnabled',
                              'Message': 'An active CloudWatch Logs flow log already exists for VPC ' + vpc_id,
                              'FlowLogIds': [f['FlowLogId'] for f in active_flow_logs],
                              'LogGroupName': log_group_name
                          }

                      response = ec2.create_flow_logs(
                          ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                          ResourceType='VPC',
                          TrafficType=traffic_type,
                          LogDestinationType='cloud-watch-logs',
                          LogGroupName=log_group_name,
                          DeliverLogsPermissionArn=deliver_logs_permission_arn,
                          MaxAggregationInterval=max_aggregation_interval,
                          TagSpecifications=[
                              {
                                  'ResourceType': 'vpc-flow-log',
                                  'Tags': [
                                      {'Key': 'Name', 'Value': 'vpc-flow-logs-' + vpc_id},
                                      {'Key': 'CIS-Control', 'Value': 'VPCFlowLogging'}
                                  ]
                              }
                          ]
                      )

                      return {
                          'Status': 'Created',
                          'Message': 'Enabled VPC Flow Logs with ' + traffic_type + ' traffic capture for ' + vpc_id,
                          'FlowLogIds': response.get('FlowLogIds', []),
                          'LogGroupName': log_group_name
                      }
        - LogGroupName: !Ref VpcFlowLogsLogGroup
          DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsRole.Arn
          TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogTrafficType
          MaxAggregationInterval: !Ref FlowLogMaxAggregationInterval
          AutomationAssumeRole: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-EnableVpcFlowLogs'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  EnableVpcFlowLogsViaChangeManagerDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DependsOn:
      - EnableVpcFlowLogsDocument
      - VpcFlowLogsRole
      - AutomationExecutionRole
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-EnableVpcFlowLogsViaChangeManager'
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content: !Sub
        - |
          schemaVersion: '0.3'
          description: >-
            Submits an AWS Systems Manager Change Manager change request that runs the VPC
            Flow Log enablement runbook for the specified VPC, so that the remediation is
            subject to formal change approval before it is executed.
          assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
          parameters:
            VpcId:
              type: String
              description: The ID of the VPC for which VPC Flow Logs are enabled.
            LogGroupName:
              type: String
              description: The CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the VPC Flow Log records.
              default: '${LogGroupName}'
            DeliverLogsPermissionArn:
              type: String
              description: The ARN of the IAM role that VPC Flow Logs assumes to publish records to CloudWatch Logs.
              default: '${DeliverLogsPermissionArn}'
            TrafficType:
              type: String
              description: The type of traffic that the flow log captures.
              default: '${TrafficType}'
              allowedValues:
                - ACCEPT
                - REJECT
                - ALL
            MaxAggregationInterval:
              type: Integer
              description: The maximum interval, in seconds, during which flow log data is aggregated before it is published.
              default: ${MaxAggregationInterval}
              allowedValues:
                - 60
                - 600
            ChangeRequestAutoApprove:
              type: String
              description: Whether the change request is auto-approved. Set to false to require change approval.
              default: '${ChangeRequestAutoApprove}'
              allowedValues:
                - 'true'
                - 'false'
            ScheduledStartOffsetMinutes:
              type: Integer
              description: Number of minutes from the current time at which the change request is scheduled to run.
              default: 60
            AutomationAssumeRole:
              type: String
              description: The ARN of the IAM role that the automation assumes while it runs its steps.
              default: '${AutomationAssumeRole}'
          mainSteps:
            - name: SubmitEnableVpcFlowLogsChangeRequest
              action: aws:executeScript
              description: Submits a Change Manager change request that runs the VPC Flow Log enablement runbook.
              inputs:
                Runtime: python3.11
                Handler: handler
                InputPayload:
                  VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                  LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
                  DeliverLogsPermissionArn: '{{ DeliverLogsPermissionArn }}'
                  TrafficType: '{{ TrafficType }}'
                  MaxAggregationInterval: '{{ MaxAggregationInterval }}'

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          route53 = boto3.client('route53')

          def send_response(event, context, status, data=None, physical_resource_id=None, reason=None):
              response_body = {
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': reason or 'See CloudWatch Log Stream: {}'.format(context.log_stream_name),
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': data or {}
              }
              response_json = json.dumps(response_body)
              logger.info('Sending response: %s', response_json)
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  event['ResponseURL'],
                  data=response_json.encode('utf-8'),
                  headers={'Content-Type': '', 'Content-Length': str(len(response_json))},
                  method='PUT'
              )
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
                      logger.info('CloudFormation response status: %s', response.status)
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error('Failed to send response: %s', e)

          def get_nameserver_data(name_servers):
              data = {}
              for i in range(1, 5):
                  data['NameServer{}'.format(i)] = ''
                  data['NameServer{}IPv4'.format(i)] = ''
                  data['NameServer{}IPv6'.format(i)] = ''
              for index, nameserver in enumerate(name_servers[:4], start=1):
                  data['NameServer{}'.format(index)] = nameserver
                  try:
                      ipv4_infos = socket.getaddrinfo(nameserver, None, socket.AF_INET)
                      if ipv4_infos:
                          data['NameServer{}IPv4'.format(index)] = ipv4_infos[0][4][0]
                  except Exception as e:

                  try:

                      if ipv6_infos:
                          data['NameServer{}IPv6'.format(index)] = ipv6_infos[0][4][0]
                  except Exception as e:
                      logger.warning('IPv6 lookup failed for %s: %s', nameserver, e)

          def create_delegation_set(event):
              caller_reference = event['RequestId']
              response = route53.create_reusable_delegation_set(CallerReference=caller_reference)

              delegation_set_id = delegation_set['Id']
              data = get_nameserver_data(delegation_set['NameServers'])
              data['DelegationSetId'] = delegation_set_id
              return delegation_set_id, data

          def describe_delegation_set(delegation_set_id):
              response = route53.get_reusable_delegation_set(Id=delegation_set_id)
              delegation_set = response['DelegationSet']
              data = get_nameserver_data(delegation_set['NameServers'])
              data['DelegationSetId'] = delegation_set['Id']
              return data

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info('Received event: %s', json.dumps(event))
              try:
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  physical_resource_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      delegation_set_id, data = create_delegation_set(event)
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', data, delegation_set_id)
                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      if physical_resource_id and physical_resource_id.startswith('/delegationset/'):
                          try:
                              data = describe_delegation_set(physical_resource_id)
                              send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', data, physical_resource_id)
                          except route53.exceptions.NoSuchDelegationSet:
                              delegation_set_id, data = create_delegation_set(event)
                              send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', data, delegation_set_id)
                      else:
                          delegation_set_id, data = create_delegation_set(event)
                          send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', data, delegation_set_id)
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      if physical_resource_id and physical_resource_id.startswith('/delegationset/'):
                          try:
                              route53.delete_reusable_delegation_set(Id=physical_resource_id)
                              logger.info('Deleted delegation set %s', physical_resource_id)
                          except route53.exceptions.NoSuchDelegationSet:
                              logger.info('Delegation set %s already deleted', physical_resource_id)
                          except Exception as e:
                              logger.exception('Failed to delete delegation set %s', physical_resource_id)
                              send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', reason=str(e), physical_resource_id=physical_resource_id)
                              return
                      else:
                          logger.info('No valid delegation set ID found for deletion')
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_resource_id or 'deleted')
                  else:
                      send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', reason='Unsupported request type: {}'.format(request_type), physical_resource_id=physical_resource_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.exception('Unhandled error')
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', reason=str(e), physical_resource_id=event.get('PhysicalResourceId', context.log_stream_name))

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless content moderation API using Amazon Rekognition with API Gateway and Lambda.

Parameters:
  MinConfidence:
    Type: Number
    Default: 60
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 100
    Description: Minimum confidence threshold for Rekognition DetectModerationLabels.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3653
    Description: Number of days to retain Lambda CloudWatch Logs.

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-invokeContentModeration-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeContentModerationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
              - Sid: RekognitionDetectModerationLabels
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-invokeContentModeration-role'

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/invokeContentModeration'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  InvokeContentModerationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: invokeContentModeration
      Description: Fetches an image URL and returns Rekognition moderation labels.
      Runtime: python3.11
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Environment:
        Variables:
          MIN_CONFIDENCE: !Ref MinConfidence
          MAX_SIZE_BYTES: '5242880'
          ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS: '.jpg,.jpeg,.png'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import urllib.error
          import urllib.request
          from urllib.parse import urlparse

          import boto3

          rekognition = boto3.client("rekognition")

          MAX_SIZE_BYTES = int(os.environ.get("MAX_SIZE_BYTES", "5242880"))
          MIN_CONFIDENCE = float(os.environ.get("MIN_CONFIDENCE", "60"))
          ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = tuple(
              ext.strip().lower()
              for ext in os.environ.get("ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS", ".jpg,.jpeg,.png").split(",")
              if ext.strip()
          )


          def _response(status_code, payload):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status_code,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps(payload),
              }


          def _parse_body(event):
              body = event.get("body")
              if body is None:
                  return None
              if event.get("isBase64Encoded"):
                  import base64
                  body = base64.b64decode(body).decode("utf-8")
              if isinstance(body, (bytes, bytearray)):
                  body = body.decode("utf-8")
              if isinstance(body, str):
                  body = json.loads(body)
              return body


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = _parse_body(event)
              except (ValueError, TypeError):
                  return _response(400, {"error": "Invalid JSON body"})

              if not isinstance(body, dict):
                  return _response(400, {"error": "Request body must be a JSON object"})

              image_url = body.get("url")
              if not image_url or not isinstance(image_url, str):
                  return _response(400, {"error": "Missing required field: url"})

              path = urlparse(image_url).path.lower()
              if not path.endswith(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS):
                  return _response(
                      400,
                      {
                          "error": "Unsupported image format. Allowed formats: jpg, jpeg, png",
                      },
                  )

              try:
                  request = urllib.request.Request(
                      image_url, headers={"User-Agent": "ContentModerationBot/1.0"}
                  )
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
                      image_bytes = response.read(MAX_SIZE_BYTES + 1)
              except urllib.error.HTTPError as http_err:
                  if http_err.code == 404:
                      return _response(404, {"error": "Image not found"})
                  return _response(
                      400, {"error": "Failed to fetch image: HTTP %s" % http_err.code}
                  )
              except urllib.error.URLError:
                  return _response(400, {"error": "Failed to fetch image: invalid URL"})
              except Exception:
                  return _response(400, {"error": "Failed to fetch image"})

              if len(image_bytes) > MAX_SIZE_BYTES:
                  return _response(413, {"error": "Image exceeds the 5MB size limit"})

              try:
                  result = rekognition.detect_moderation_labels(
                      Image={"Bytes": image_bytes},
                      MinConfidence=MIN_CONFIDENCE,
                  )
              except Exception as exc:
                  return _response(
                      500, {"error": "Rekognition error: %s" % str(exc)}
                  )

              labels = result.get("ModerationLabels", [])
              return _response(
                  200,
                  {
                      "moderationLabels": labels,
                      "minConfidence": MIN_CONFIDENCE,
                  },
              )

  ContentModerationApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: ContentModeration
      Description: REST API to moderate image content using Amazon Rekognition.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:

        - Key: Name

  ModerateResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:

  ModerateMethod:

      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${InvokeContentModerationFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ModerateMethod
    Properties:

      Description: Deployment for the ContentModeration API.

  ProdStage:

    Properties:

      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      Description: Production stage for the ContentModeration API.

      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ContentModerationApi}/*/POST/moderate'

Outputs:
  ApiEndpointUrl:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Creates an hourly scheduled workflow that automatically closes AWS Organizations
  accounts tagged with organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED. An Amazon EventBridge
  rule invokes an EXPRESS AWS Step Functions state machine that paginates through the
  accounts tagged for closure, describes each account, closes it with the Organizations
  CloseAccount API when the account status is ACTIVE, and re-tags the account with
  organizations:account-closure=ACKNOWLEDGED. All execution data is logged to a
  CloudWatch Logs log group with 365-day retention.

Parameters:
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: "rate(1 hour)"
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: >-
      EventBridge schedule expression that triggers the account closure workflow.
      The default runs the workflow once every hour.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3653
    Description: >-
      Number of days that Step Functions execution data is retained in CloudWatch Logs.

Resources:

  AccountClosureLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-account-closure"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  AccountClosureStateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Execution role for the Step Functions workflow that closes AWS Organizations
        accounts tagged for closure.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowStepFunctionsServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AccountClosureLeastPrivilegePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListAccountsTaggedForClosure
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - resourcegroupstaggingapi:GetResources
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: DescribeAndCloseOrganizationAccounts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:CloseAccount
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: TagAccountsAcknowledged
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:TagResource
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::*:account/*"
              - Sid: WriteExecutionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "${AccountClosureLogGroup.Arn}:*"
              - Sid: ManageStateMachineLogDeliveries
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: "*"

  AccountClosureStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AccountClosureStateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !Sub "${AccountClosureLogGroup.Arn}:*"
      Definition:
        Comment: >-
          Closes AWS Organizations accounts tagged organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED.
        StartAt: ListTaggedAccountsFirstPage
        States:
          ListTaggedAccountsFirstPage:
            Type: Task
            Comment: Retrieve the first page of accounts tagged for closure.
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:resourcegroupstaggingapi:getResources
            Parameters:
              ResourceTypeFilters:
                - organizations:account
              TagFilters:
                - Key: "organizations:account-closure"
                  Values:
                    - REQUESTED
            ResultPath: $.Page
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - ResourceGroupstaggingapi.ThrottlingException
                  - ResourceGroupstaggingapi.TooManyRequestsException
                  - ResourceGroupstaggingapi.InternalServiceException
                IntervalSeconds: 5
                MaxAttempts: 8
                BackoffRate: 2
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.ALL
                ResultPath: $.Error
                Next: WorkflowFailed
            Next: CheckForAccountsInPage
          ListTaggedAccountsNextPage:
            Type: Task
            Comment: Retrieve subsequent pages of accounts tagged for closure.
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:resourcegroupstaggingapi:getResources
            Parameters:
              ResourceTypeFilters:
                - organizations:account
              TagFilters:
                - Key: "organizations:account-closure"
                  Values:
                    - REQUESTED
              PaginationToken.$: $.Page.PaginationToken
            ResultPath: $.Page
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - ResourceGroupstaggingapi.ThrottlingException
                  - ResourceGroupstaggingapi.TooManyRequestsException
                  - ResourceGroupstaggingapi.InternalServiceException
                IntervalSeconds: 5
                MaxAttempts: 8
                BackoffRate: 2
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.ALL
                ResultPath: $.Error
                Next: WorkflowFailed
            Next: CheckForAccountsInPage
          CheckForAccountsInPage:
            Type: Choice
            Comment: Only enter the Map state when the page contains accounts.
            Choices:
              - Variable: $.Page.ResourceTagMappingList
                IsPresent: true
                Next: ProcessTaggedAccounts
            Default: CheckForMorePages
          ProcessTaggedAccounts:
            Type: Map
            Comment: >-
              Describe each tagged account and close it when its status is ACTIVE.
            ItemsPath: $.Page.ResourceTagMappingList
            MaxConcurrency: 1
            ResultPath: $.ProcessedAccounts
            ItemProcessor:
              ProcessorConfig:
                Mode: INLINE
              StartAt: DescribeAccount
              States:
                DescribeAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Comment: Describe the account to determine whether it can be closed.
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: "States.ArrayGetItem(States.StringSplit($.ResourceARN, '/'), 2)"
                  ResultPath: $.DescribeResult
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.ThrottlingException
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                        - Organizations.ServiceException
                        - Organizations.AccountNotFoundException
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      MaxAttempts: 8
                      BackoffRate: 2
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.Error
                      Next: ItemFailed
                  Next: IsAccountActive
                IsAccountActive:
                  Type: Choice
                  Choices:
                    - Variable: $.DescribeResult.Account.Status
                      StringEquals: ACTIVE
                      Next: CloseAccount
                  Default: ItemSkipped
                CloseAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Comment: Close the ACTIVE account using the Organizations CloseAccount API.
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:closeAccount
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: "States.ArrayGetItem(States.StringSplit($.ResourceARN, '/'), 2)"
                  ResultPath: $.CloseResult
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.ThrottlingException
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                        - Organizations.ConstraintViolationException
                        - Organizations.ServiceException
                      IntervalSeconds: 10
                      MaxAttempts: 8
                      BackoffRate: 2
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.Error
                      Next: ItemFailed
                  Next: AcknowledgeAccountClosure
                AcknowledgeAccountClosure:
                  Type: Task
                  Comment: Mark the account closure request as ACKNOWLEDGED.
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:tagResource
                  Parameters:
                    ResourceId.$: "States.ArrayGetItem(States.StringSplit($.ResourceARN, '/'), 2)"
                    Tags:
                      - Key: "organizations:account-closure"
                        Value: ACKNOWLEDGED
                  ResultPath: $.TagResult
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.ThrottlingException
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                        - Organizations.ServiceException
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      MaxAttempts: 8
                      BackoffRate: 2
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.Error
                      Next: ItemFailed
                  Next: ItemCompleted
                ItemCompleted:
                  Type: Pass
                  Comment: Account was closed and tagged ACKNOWLEDGED.
                  End: true
                ItemSkipped:
                  Type: Pass
                  Comment: Account is not ACTIVE, so no closure action was taken.
                  End: true
                ItemFailed:
                  Type: Pass
                  Comment: Account processing failed; the item result records the error.
                  End: true
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.ALL
                ResultPath: $.Error
                Next: WorkflowFailed
            Next: CheckForMorePages
          CheckForMorePages:
            Type: Choice
            Comment: Continue with the next page when a pagination token is returned.
            Choices:
              - Variable: $.Page.PaginationToken
                IsPresent: true
                Next: ListTaggedAccountsNextPage
            Default: WorkflowSucceeded
          WorkflowSucceeded:
            Type: Succeed
          WorkflowFailed:
            Type: Fail
            Error: AccountClosureWorkflowFailed
            Cause: >-
              The account closure workflow failed. Review the CloudWatch log group for
              the execution history and error details.

  AccountClosureScheduleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role that allows the EventBridge scheduled rule to start the account closure
        state machine.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: StudyBuddy Cognito user pool and authentication infrastructure

Parameters:
  FrontendDomainName:
    Type: String
    Description: Frontend domain name for Cognito app client callback and logout URLs (e.g., app.example.com)
  GoogleClientId:
    Type: String
    Description: Google OAuth client ID
  GoogleClientSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Google OAuth client secret

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  PostAuthenticationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: StudyBuddyPostAuthentication
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: nodejs18.x
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            console.log('PostAuthentication event:', JSON.stringify(event));
            return event;
          };

  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: StudyBuddyPostConfirmation
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: nodejs18.x
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            console.log('PostConfirmation event:', JSON.stringify(event));
            return event;
          };

  PreSignUpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: StudyBuddyPreSignUp
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: nodejs18.x
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            console.log('PreSignUp event:', JSON.stringify(event));
            return event;
          };

  GoogleOAuthSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "StudyBuddyGoogleOAuth-${AWS::StackName}"
      Description: Google OAuth credentials for StudyBuddy Cognito identity provider
      SecretString: !Sub '{"client_id":"${GoogleClientId}","client_secret":"${GoogleClientSecret}"}'

  StudyBuddyUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: StudyBuddyUserPool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
        PreSignUp: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn

  StudyBuddyUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub "studybuddy-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool

  GoogleIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ProviderName: Google
      ProviderType: Google
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        given_name: given_name
        family_name: family_name
        username: sub
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref GoogleClientId
        client_secret: !Ref GoogleClientSecret
        authorize_scopes: "profile email openid"

  StudyBuddyAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: GoogleIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ClientName: StudyBuddyWebClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${FrontendDomainName}/callback"
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${FrontendDomainName}/logout"
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - Google
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
