AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Two self-contained VPCs for Users and Fog layers with private S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, EventBridge, STS, and Lambda connectivity through VPC endpoints.
Resources:
  UsersVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.50.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Users-VPC

  FogVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.60.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Fog-VPC

  UsersSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.50.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Users-Subnet

  FogSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.60.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Fog-Subnet

  UsersRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Users-RouteTable

  FogRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Fog-RouteTable

  UsersSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref UsersSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref UsersRouteTable

  FogSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref FogSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref FogRouteTable

  UsersEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from Users VPC to interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt UsersVPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Users-Endpoint-SG

  FogEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from Fog VPC to interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt FogVPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Fog-Endpoint-SG

  UsersVpcEndpointS3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref UsersRouteTable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Users-S3-Endpoint

  FogVpcEndpointS3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref FogRouteTable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Fog-S3-Endpoint

  UsersVpcEndpointKMS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref UsersSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref UsersEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Users-KMS-Endpoint

  FogVpcEndpointKMS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Fog-KMS-Endpoint

  FogVpcEndpointSecretsManager:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Fog-SecretsManager-Endpoint

  FogVpcEndpointEvents:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.events"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Fog-EventBridge-Endpoint

  FogVpcEndpointSTS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Fog-STS-Endpoint

  FogVpcEndpointLambda:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.lambda"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Fog-Lambda-Endpoint

Outputs:
  UsersVpcId:
    Description: Users VPC ID
    Value: !Ref UsersVPC
  FogVpcId:
    Description: Fog VPC ID
    Value: !Ref FogVPC
  UsersSubnetId:
    Description: Users Subnet ID
    Value: !Ref UsersSubnet

    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'

          - Value: !Ref ExcludedIamUser2

            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'S3.2'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'S3.3'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'S3.5'
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: 'Suppressed by automation: S3 bucket is intentionally public and has been reviewed.'
              UpdatedBy: 'SecurityHubAutomationRule'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >
  bac-mcp-tool - CloudFormation/SAM template provisioning the MCP tool Lambda
  function used to test an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway operated by an AWS
  operations agent. It creates the Lambda function (Python 3.12, X-Ray active
  tracing, extended timeout and memory), its least-privilege execution role
  (Bedrock foundation model invocation, Cost Explorer cost/usage queries, S3
  object operations and CloudWatch Logs), a dedicated IAM role that the Amazon
  Bedrock AgentCore Gateway service can assume to invoke the function (scoped to
  gateways in the same AWS account), and a CloudWatch log group with a two-week
  retention period.

Parameters:
  McpToolFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: bac-mcp-tool
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    Description: Name of the MCP tool Lambda function.
  McpToolFunctionTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 900
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Timeout (seconds) for the MCP tool Lambda function.
  McpToolFunctionMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2048
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: Memory size (MB) for the MCP tool Lambda function.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention period (days) for the function log group.

Resources:
  McpToolFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    DependsOn:
      - McpToolLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref McpToolFunctionName
      Description: MCP tool used to test the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for the AWS operations agent
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      InlineCode: |
        import json
        import logging
        import os

        logger = logging.getLogger()
        logger.setLevel(os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"))


        def handler(event, context):
            """Minimal MCP tool handler used to exercise the AgentCore Gateway."""
            logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event, default=str))
            return {
                "statusCode": 200,
                "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                "body": json.dumps({"tool": "bac-mcp-tool", "status": "ok"}),
            }
      Timeout: !Ref McpToolFunctionTimeout
      MemorySize: !Ref McpToolFunctionMemorySize
      Tracing: Active
      Role: !GetAtt McpToolExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
          MCP_TOOL_NAME: !Ref McpToolFunctionName
      Tags:
        Application: bac-mcp-tool
        ManagedBy: AWS-SAM

  McpToolLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${McpToolFunctionName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  McpToolExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the bac-mcp-tool MCP Lambda function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFunctionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt McpToolLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${McpToolLogGroup.Arn}:*'
        - PolicyName: BedrockFoundationModelInvocation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeFoundationModels
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                  - bedrock:Converse
                  - bedrock:ConverseStream

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  EC2 Image Builder pipeline that builds a CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023
  ARM64 (Graviton) AMI pre-configured for AWS Elastic Beanstalk compatibility.
  The pipeline runs daily, runs image tests and enhanced metadata collection,
  produces a 50 GB root EBS volume AMI, distributes the AMI to the current Region
  with launch permissions shared to an AWS Organization and to dev and prod
  accounts, and automatically deletes images and snapshots older than six months.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Parent Image
        Parameters:
          - ParentImage
      - Label:
          default: AMI Launch Permissions
        Parameters:
          - OrganizationId
          - DevAccountId
          - ProdAccountId
    ParameterLabels:
      ParentImage:
        default: CIS hardened parent image
      OrganizationId:
        default: AWS Organizations ID
      DevAccountId:
        default: Development account ID
      ProdAccountId:
        default: Production account ID

Parameters:
  ParentImage:
    Type: String
    Default: 'cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/x.x.x'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 1024
    Description: >-
      Parent image reference used by the Image Builder image recipe. This must be
      the CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 (Graviton) image.
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'o-xxxxxxxxxx'
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{8,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Organizations ID, for example o-abcdef1234.
    Description: >-
      AWS Organizations ID whose accounts are granted launch permissions for the
      built AMI. Deploy this stack from the management account of that
      organization so the organization ARN can be built from the stack account ID.
  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '111111111111'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12 digit AWS account ID, for example 111111111111.
    Description: AWS account ID of the development environment that may launch the AMI.
  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '222222222222'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12 digit AWS account ID, for example 222222222222.
    Description: AWS account ID of the production environment that may launch the AMI.

Resources:
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 Image Builder build instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-role'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infrastructure-config'
      Description: >-
        Build infrastructure for the CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64
        Elastic Beanstalk image.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - c7g.large
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      SystemsManagerAgent:
        UninstallAfterBuild: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infrastructure-config'

  ElasticBeanstalkComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-al2023-arm64-component'
      Description: >-
        Pre-configures a CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 image so it
        can be used by an AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: '1.0.0'
      ChangeDescription: Initial version of the Elastic Beanstalk compatibility component.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-al2023-arm64-component'
      Data: !Sub |
        name: ${AWS::StackName}-eb-al2023-arm64-component
        description: >-
          Creates the Elastic Beanstalk webapp user, application directories and
          prerequisite packages required for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: CreateElasticBeanstalkUserAndDirectories
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - groupadd --force webapp
                    - id -u webapp >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --system --gid webapp --home-dir /var/app --shell /sbin/nologin --comment "Elastic Beanstalk webapp user" webapp
                    - mkdir -p /var/app/current /var/app/ondeck /var/app/staging
                    - mkdir -p /etc/elasticbeanstalk /opt/elasticbeanstalk /opt/elasticbeanstalk/bin /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks
                    - mkdir -p /var/log/eb-engine /var/log/eb-hooks /var/log/eb-commandprocessor
                    - chown -R webapp:webapp /var/app
                    - chmod -R 0755 /var/app
                    - chown root:root /etc/elasticbeanstalk /opt/elasticbeanstalk /var/log/eb-engine /var/log/eb-hooks /var/log/eb-commandprocessor
                    - chmod 0755 /etc/elasticbeanstalk /opt/elasticbeanstalk /var/log/eb-engine /var/log/eb-hooks /var/log/eb-commandprocessor
              - name: ConfigureElasticBeanstalkSudoAccess
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - printf 'webapp ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL\n' > /etc/sudoers.d/webapp
                    - chown root:root /etc/sudoers.d/webapp
                    - chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/webapp
              - name: InstallElasticBeanstalkPrerequisitePackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - dnf -y install amazon-ssm-agent tar gzip unzip rsync procps shadow-utils sudo
                    - systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateElasticBeanstalkConfiguration
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - id webapp
                    - test -d /var/app/current
                    - test -d /opt/elasticbeanstalk
                    - test -d /etc/elasticbeanstalk
                    - test -f /etc/sudoers.d/webapp
                    - systemctl is-enabled amazon-ssm-agent

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-al2023-arm64-recipe'
      Description: >-
        CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 image pre-configured for
        Elastic Beanstalk with a 50 GB encrypted gp3 root volume.
      Version: '1.0.0'
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImage
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-al2023-arm64-recipe'

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution-config'
      Description: >-
        Distributes the hardened AMI in the current Region and shares launch
        permissions with the organization, the development account and the
        production account.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-al2023-arm64-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: >-
              CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 image pre-configured
              for Elastic Beanstalk.
            AmiTags:
              Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-al2023-arm64'
              Hardening: cis-level-1
              Platform: amazon-linux-2023-arm64
              ManagedBy: ec2-image-builder
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
              UserIds:
                - !Ref DevAccountId
                - !Ref ProdAccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution-config'

  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    DependsOn:
      - ImageRecipe
      - ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration
      - DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-al2023-arm64-pipeline'
      Description: >-
        Daily pipeline that builds, tests and distributes the CIS Level 1
        hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 Elastic Beanstalk AMI.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      Status: ENABLED
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 8 * * ? *)'
        Timezone: UTC
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-al2023-arm64-pipeline'

  LifecyclePolicyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role used by the EC2 Image Builder lifecycle policy to delete stale AMIs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lifecycle-role'

  ImageLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    DependsOn:
      - ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ami-lifecycle-policy'
      Description: >-
        Deletes the AMIs and their backing snapshots produced by this pipeline
        once they are six months old.
      Status: ENABLED
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecyclePolicyRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-al2023-arm64-recipe'
            SemanticVersion: '1.0.0'
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DELETE
            IncludeResources:
              Amis: true
              Containers: false
              Snapshots: true
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 6
            Unit: MONTHS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ami-lifecycle-policy'

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Image Builder pipeline that produces the hardened AMI.
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the image recipe used to build the hardened Elastic Beanstalk AMI.
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipe
  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the build infrastructure configuration used by the pipeline.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the distribution configuration that shares the AMI with the organization and the dev and prod accounts.
    Value: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
  ImageLifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the lifecycle policy that deletes AMIs and snapshots after six months.
    Value: !Ref ImageLifecyclePolicy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Maths MCP server with API Gateway, Lambda, and Cognito authentication.

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage name for the API Gateway stage.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool app client.

Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  MathsMcpLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              headers = {
                  "Content-Type": "application/json",
                  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type,Authorization",
                  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "OPTIONS,POST,GET"
              }
              path = event.get("path", "/")
              method = event.get("httpMethod", "GET")
              if method == "GET" and path == "/":
                  body = {"status": "healthy"}
              else:
                  body = {"message": "Maths MCP placeholder", "path": path, "method": method}
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": headers,
                  "body": json.dumps(body)
              }

  ApiGatewayRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-api"
      Description: Maths MCP API
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId

Description: Fargate ECS task definition with ECR image, task execution role, and task role.

Parameters:
  ECRRepositoryName:
    Type: String
    Default: sample-app
    Description: Name of the ECR repository containing the container image.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
  ImageTag:
    Type: String
    Default: v1.0.0
    Description: Immutable tag for the container image.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128

Resources:
  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  ECSTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fargate-task"
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: sample-app
          Image: !Sub
            - "${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${RepoName}:${Tag}"
            - RepoName: !Ref ECRRepositoryName
              Tag: !Ref ImageTag
          Essential: true

Outputs:

    Description: Full ECR image URI used by the ECS task definition.
    Value: !Sub
      - "${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${RepoName}:${Tag}"
      - RepoName: !Ref ECRRepositoryName
        Tag: !Ref ImageTag
  TaskDefinitionArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task definition.
    Value: !Ref ECSTaskDefinition
  ExecutionRoleArn:

    Value: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn

    Description: ARN of the ECS task role.
    Value: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Cognito authentication infrastructure for nih-grants'

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nih-grants-user-pool'
      MfaConfiguration: 'ON'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 11
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      EmailVerificationSubject: 'Your verification code'
      EmailVerificationMessage: 'Your verification code is {####}'
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: 'ENFORCED'

  UserPoolClientWeb:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nih-grants-web-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: 'ENABLED'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  UserPoolClientGeneral:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nih-grants-general-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: 'ENABLED'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  IdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nih-grants-identity-pool'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClientWeb
          ProviderName: !Sub 'cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}'
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
        - ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClientGeneral
          ProviderName: !Sub 'cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}'
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true

  AuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref IdentityPool
              'ForAnyValue:StringLike':
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: nih-grants-auth-inline-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObjectTagging
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::nih-grants-context-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'kms:RequestAlias': 'alias/nih-grants-s3-key'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:Invoke
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/$connect'

  UnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref IdentityPool
              'ForAnyValue:StringLike':
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': unauthenticated

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthRole.Arn

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: 'Cognito User Pool ID'
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: 'Cognito User Pool ARN'
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientWebId:
    Description: 'Web App Client ID'
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClientWeb
  UserPoolClientGeneralId:
    Description: 'General App Client ID'
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClientGeneral
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: 'Cognito Identity Pool ID'
    Value: !Ref IdentityPool
  AuthRoleArn:
    Description: 'Authenticated IAM Role ARN'
    Value: !GetAtt AuthRole.Arn
  UnauthRoleArn:
    Description: 'Unauthenticated IAM Role ARN'
    Value: !GetAtt UnauthRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless REST API for email submissions via Amazon SES with API key, usage plan, request validation, and throttling.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: The stage name for the API Gateway deployment.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
  ApiKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: email-apikey
    Description: The name of the API key.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128

Resources:
  EmailApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-email-api
      Description: API for sending emails via Amazon SES
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  EmailResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt EmailApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: email
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi

  EmailModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
      ContentType: application/json
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EmailRequest
      Schema:
        $schema: 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#'
        title: EmailRequest
        type: object
        properties:
          to:
            type: array
            minItems: 1
            items:
              type: string
              format: email
          from:
            type: string
            format: email
          html:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
          text:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
          cc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
              format: email
          bcc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
              format: email
          subject:
            type: string
        required:
          - to
          - from
          - html
          - text
        additionalProperties: false

  EmailRequestValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-email-request-validator
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
      ValidateRequestBody: true
      ValidateRequestParameters: false

  ApiGatewaySESRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SES-SendEmail
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource: '*'

  EmailMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
      ResourceId: !Ref EmailResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref EmailRequestValidator
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref EmailModel
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:ses:action/SendEmail
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewaySESRole.Arn
        RequestParameters:
          integration.request.header.Content-Type: "'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'"
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: |-
            Action=SendEmail&Source=$util.urlEncode($input.path('$.from'))#foreach($to in $input.path('$.to'))&Destination.ToAddresses.member$foreach.count=$util.urlEncode($to)#end#if($input.path('$.cc'))#foreach($cc in $input.path('$.cc'))&Destination.CcAddresses.member$foreach.count=$util.urlEncode($cc)#end#end#if($input.path('$.bcc'))#foreach($bcc in $input.path('$.bcc'))&Destination.BccAddresses.member$foreach.count=$util.urlEncode($bcc)#end#end#set($subject = $input.path('$.subject'))#if(!$subject)#set($subject = "No Subject")#end&Message.Subject.Data=$util.urlEncode($subject)&Message.Body.Html.Data=$util.urlEncode($input.path('$.html'))&Message.Body.Text.Data=$util.urlEncode($input.path('$.text'))
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {"message": "Email sent successfully"}
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  EmailApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: EmailMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
      Description: Deployment for the email API

  EmailApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref EmailApiDeployment
      Description: Stage for the email API

  EmailApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiKeyName
      Enabled: true
      Description: API key for the email API

  EmailApiUsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    Properties:
      UsagePlanName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-email-usage-plan
      ApiStages:
        - ApiId: !Ref EmailApi
          Stage: !Ref EmailApiStage
      Description: Usage plan for the email API
      Quota:
        Limit: 10000
        Period: MONTH
      Throttle:
        BurstLimit: 1000
        RateLimit: 500

  EmailApiUsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Reusable nested stack to conditionally subscribe email, SQS, Lambda, and HTTPS endpoints to an existing SNS topic.

Parameters:
  TopicArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the existing SNS topic to subscribe endpoints to.
  EmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: 'example@example.com'
    Description: Email endpoint. Leave as the default value to skip email subscription.
  SqsQueueArn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:example-queue'
    Description: ARN of an existing SQS queue. Leave as the default value to skip SQS subscription.
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:example-function'
    Description: ARN of an existing Lambda function. Leave as the default value to skip Lambda subscription.
  HttpsEndpointUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: 'https://example.com/example'
    Description: HTTPS endpoint URL. Leave as the default value to skip HTTPS subscription.

Conditions:
  IsEmailProvided: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref EmailAddress
      - 'example@example.com'
  IsSqsProvided: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref SqsQueueArn
      - 'arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:example-queue'
  IsLambdaProvided: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref LambdaFunctionArn
      - 'arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:example-function'
  IsHttpsProvided: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref HttpsEndpointUrl
      - 'https://example.com/example'

Resources:
  EmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: IsEmailProvided
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref EmailAddress

  SqsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: IsSqsProvided
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn
      Protocol: sqs
      Endpoint: !Ref SqsQueueArn

  LambdaSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: IsLambdaProvided
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn
      Protocol: lambda
      Endpoint: !Ref LambdaFunctionArn

  HttpsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: IsHttpsProvided
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn
      Protocol: https
      Endpoint: !Ref HttpsEndpointUrl
      DeliveryPolicy:
        healthyRetryPolicy:
          minDelayTarget: 20
          maxDelayTarget: 600
          numRetries: 10
          numMaxDelayRetries: 5
          numNoDelayRetries: 0
          numMinDelayRetries: 3
          backoffFunction: exponential
        sicklyRetryPolicy:
          minDelayTarget: 20
          maxDelayTarget: 600
          numRetries: 10
          numMaxDelayRetries: 5
          numNoDelayRetries: 0
          numMinDelayRetries: 3
          backoffFunction: exponential

Outputs:
  EmailSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: IsEmailProvided
    Description: ARN of the email SNS subscription.
    Value: !Ref EmailSubscription
  SqsSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: IsSqsProvided
    Description: ARN of the SQS SNS subscription.
    Value: !Ref SqsSubscription
  LambdaSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: IsLambdaProvided
    Description: ARN of the Lambda SNS subscription.
    Value: !Ref LambdaSubscription
  HttpsSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: IsHttpsProvided
    Description: ARN of the HTTPS SNS subscription.
    Value: !Ref HttpsSubscription

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Builds a custom Amazon Linux 2023 bastion-style AMI using EC2 Image Builder. Creates a self-contained VPC with private subnet and NAT Gateway, IAM role, and shares the AMI with an AWS Organization and publicly.

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1.0.0'
    Description: Version of the Image Builder component, recipe, and image.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$'
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 1024
    Description: Size of the root EBS volume in GB.
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS Organization ID to share the AMI with (e.g., o-abc1234567).
  OrganizationManagementAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional. Management account ID of the AWS Organization. If blank, current account ID is used.
  ParentImage:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: '/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64'
    Description: SSM parameter for the latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI.

Conditions:
  UseCurrentAccount: !Equals [!Ref OrganizationManagementAccountId, '']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet'

  ElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt ElasticIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-natgw'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:

          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:

      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instance
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-sg'

  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-role'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-profile'

  BastionComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-bastion-component'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Installs SSM Agent, MongoDB tools, Python Synapse client, and .NET SDK
      Platform: Linux
      Data: |
        name: BastionImageComponent
        description: Install required packages for bastion-style server
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSystem
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo dnf update -y
              - name: InstallSSMAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo dnf install -y amazon-ssm-agent
                    - sudo systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent
                    - sudo systemctl start amazon-ssm-agent
              - name: AddMongoDBRepo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      sudo tee /etc/yum.repos.d/mongodb-org-8.0.repo > /dev/null <<'EOF'
                      [mongodb-org-8.0]
                      name=MongoDB Repository
                      baseurl=https://repo.mongodb.org/yum/amazon/2023/mongodb-org/8.0/x86_64/
                      gpgcheck=1
                      enabled=1
                      gpgkey=https://pgp.mongodb.com/server-8.0.asc
                      EOF
              - name: InstallMongoDBTools
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo dnf install -y mongodb-database-tools mongosh
              - name: InstallPythonAndSynapse
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo dnf install -y python3 python3-pip
                    - sudo python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
                    - sudo python3 -m pip install --upgrade synapseclient
              - name: InstallDotNetSDK
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo dnf install -y dotnet-sdk-8.0

  BastionImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-bastion-recipe'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Recipe for bastion-style Amazon Linux 2023 image
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImage
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref BastionComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true

  BastionInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-bastion-infra'
      Description: Infrastructure configuration for bastion image build
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.medium
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  BastionDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-bastion-dist'
      Description: Distribution configuration for bastion image
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-bastion-{{ imagebuilder:buildVersion }}'
            Description: Bastion AMI built from ${AWS::StackName}
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !If
                  - UseCurrentAccount
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${OrganizationManagementAccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
              UserGroups:
                - all
            AmiTags:
              Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-bastion'
              Version: !Ref ImageVersion

  BastionImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-bastion-pipeline'
      Description: Pipeline for bastion image
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref BastionImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref BastionInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref BastionDistributionConfiguration
      Status: ENABLED

  BastionImage:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Image
    Properties:
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref BastionImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref BastionInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref BastionDistributionConfiguration
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: false
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-bastion-image'
        - Key: Version
          Value: !Ref ImageVersion

Outputs:
  BastionAmiId:
    Description: The ID of the built bastion AMI
    Value: !GetAtt BastionImage.ImageId
  BastionImageArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Image Builder image
    Value: !Ref BastionImage
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !Ref BastionImagePipeline
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: Private subnet ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: Public subnet ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
  InstanceProfileName:
    Description: Image Builder instance profile name
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Self-contained SLO monitoring stack for the FSx for ONTAP S3 Access Point event-driven
  pipeline pattern. Creates four CloudWatch SLO alarms (EventIngestionLatency,
  ProcessingSuccessRate, FPolicyReconnectTime, ReplayCompletionTime), a CloudWatch
  dashboard with SLO metric widgets, synthetic canary widgets and an alarm status
  widget. All alarm/dashboard resources are deployed only when EnableMonitoring is
  set to true. Alarms optionally notify an existing SNS topic when an ARN is supplied.

Parameters:
  EnableMonitoring:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Set to true to deploy the SLO CloudWatch alarms and the CloudWatch dashboard.
      When false (default) no monitoring resources are created.
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"

  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix applied to every resource name created by this template.
    Default: "fsxn-s3ap"
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$"
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must start with an alphanumeric character and contain only alphanumeric
      characters and hyphens.

  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Description: CloudWatch namespace that holds the pipeline SLO metrics.
    Default: "FSxN-S3AP-Patterns"
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255

  CanaryMetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Description: CloudWatch namespace that holds the synthetic canary metrics.
    Default: "FSxN-S3AP-Patterns/Canary"
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255

  DashboardRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS Region whose metrics are displayed by the dashboard widgets.
    Default: "us-east-1"
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32

  AlarmSnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Optional existing SNS topic ARN that receives alarm state changes. Leave empty
      to deploy the alarms without any notification action.
    Default: ""

  EventIngestionLatencyThresholdSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Description: P99 event ingestion latency SLO threshold, in seconds.
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 0.001

  ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent:
    Type: Number
    Description: Average processing success rate SLO threshold, in percent.
    Default: 99.5
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 100

  FPolicyReconnectTimeThresholdSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum FPolicy reconnect time SLO threshold, in seconds.
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0

  ReplayCompletionTimeThresholdSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Description: >-
      Maximum replay completion time SLO threshold, in seconds
      (300 seconds equals 5 minutes).
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 0

Conditions:
  MonitoringEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableMonitoring, "true"]
  HasSnsTopicArn: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn, ""]]

Resources:
  EventIngestionLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: MonitoringEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-EventIngestionLatency-P99"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        SLO breach: P99 event ingestion latency exceeded
        ${EventIngestionLatencyThresholdSeconds} seconds over 3 consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: EventIngestionLatency
      Statistic: p99
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyThresholdSeconds
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If [HasSnsTopicArn, [!Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: MonitoringEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-ProcessingSuccessRate"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        SLO breach: average processing success rate fell below
        ${ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent} percent over 3 consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ProcessingSuccessRate
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If [HasSnsTopicArn, [!Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: MonitoringEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-FPolicyReconnectTime"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        SLO breach: maximum FPolicy reconnect time exceeded
        ${FPolicyReconnectTimeThresholdSeconds} seconds over 3 consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: FPolicyReconnectTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref FPolicyReconnectTimeThresholdSeconds
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If [HasSnsTopicArn, [!Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: MonitoringEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-ReplayCompletionTime"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        SLO breach: maximum replay completion time exceeded
        ${ReplayCompletionTimeThresholdSeconds} seconds over 3 consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace

      Threshold: !Ref ReplayCompletionTimeThresholdSeconds

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Self-service Cognito user pool for testing JWT authentication flows with an AgentCore Gateway and MCP server (hosted UI, resource server with api/mcp and api/gateway scopes, public PKCE web client, and two machine-to-machine client-credentials clients).

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: agentcore-gateway-mcp-test
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool used for AgentCore Gateway and MCP server JWT authentication testing.

  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9]$"
    Description: Optional globally unique Cognito hosted UI domain prefix (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens). Leave empty to auto-generate one from the AWS account ID.

  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "http://localhost:3000/callback,http://localhost:8080/callback"
    Description: Comma-delimited list of allowed callback (redirect) URLs for the public web client. Defaults to common localhost development URLs.

  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "http://localhost:3000/logout,http://localhost:8080/logout"
    Description: Comma-delimited list of allowed sign-out URLs for the public web client. Defaults to common localhost development URLs.

Conditions:
  UseCustomDomainPrefix: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref DomainPrefix
      - ""

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      EmailVerificationSubject: Verify your email address for AgentCore MCP testing
      EmailVerificationMessage: Your AgentCore Gateway and MCP test verification code is {####}.
      UserPoolTags:
        Name: !Ref UserPoolName

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !If
        - UseCustomDomainPrefix
        - !Ref DomainPrefix
        - !Sub "agentcore-mcp-${AWS::AccountId}"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: api
      Name: !Sub "${UserPoolName}-api"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: mcp
          ScopeDescription: Access to the MCP server endpoints protected by the AgentCore Gateway
        - ScopeName: gateway
          ScopeDescription: Access to the AgentCore Gateway endpoints

    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${UserPoolName}-web"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - api/mcp
        - api/gateway
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs

Description: AWS Backup infrastructure with daily, weekly, and monthly schedules, encrypted vaults, KMS key, IAM role, and Service Catalog TagOptions.

Resources:

    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for AWS Backup vault encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForBackup'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BackupKmsPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                Resource: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn

  DailyBackupVault:

          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: monthly

    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: daily
      Active: true

      Key: backup
      Value: weekly
      Active: true

  BackupMonthlyTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: monthly
      Active: true

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: IAM roles and managed policies for the e-commerce serverless architecture (API Gateway to SQS to Lambda to DynamoDB Streams to Lambda to SNS).

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment name used to build the SQS queue, DynamoDB table, SNS topic, role and policy names.
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    ConstraintDescription: Must be one of dev, test or prod.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed policies
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  SQSConsumerPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "ecommerce-${Environment}-sqs-consumer-policy"
      Description: !Sub "Grants a Lambda function permission to receive and delete messages from POC-Queue-${Environment}."
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: SQSConsumerAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              - sqs:GetQueueUrl
              - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}"

  DynamoDBWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "ecommerce-${Environment}-dynamodb-write-policy"
      Description: !Sub "Grants a Lambda function permission to write order items to the ecommerce-orders-${Environment} DynamoDB table."
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DynamoDBTableWriteAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}"

  DynamoDBStreamReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "ecommerce-${Environment}-dynamodb-stream-read-policy"
      Description: !Sub "Grants a Lambda function permission to read the DynamoDB stream of the ecommerce-orders-${Environment} table."
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DynamoDBStreamReadAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:GetRecords
              - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}/stream/*"
          - Sid: DynamoDBListStreams
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:ListStreams
            Resource: "*"

  SNSPublishPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "ecommerce-${Environment}-sns-publish-policy"
      Description: !Sub "Grants a Lambda function permission to publish notifications to POC-Topic-${Environment}."
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: SNSPublishAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Topic-${Environment}"

  APIGatewaySQSSendPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "ecommerce-${Environment}-apigw-sqs-send-policy"
      Description: !Sub "Grants API Gateway permission to send messages to POC-Queue-${Environment}."
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: SQSSendMessageAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:SendMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              - sqs:GetQueueUrl
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  LambdaSQSConsumerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "ecommerce-${Environment}-lambda-sqs-consumer-role"
      Description: !Sub "Execution role for the Lambda function that consumes POC-Queue-${Environment} and writes orders to DynamoDB."
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: LambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
        - !Ref SQSConsumerPolicy
        - !Ref DynamoDBWritePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  LambdaDynamoDBStreamRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "ecommerce-${Environment}-lambda-dynamodb-stream-role"
      Description: !Sub "Execution role for the Lambda function that reads DynamoDB Streams of ecommerce-orders-${Environment} and publishes to SNS."
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: LambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
        - !Ref DynamoDBStreamReadPolicy
        - !Ref SNSPublishPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  APIGatewaySQSSendRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "ecommerce-${Environment}-apigw-sqs-send-role"
      Description: !Sub "Execution role for API Gateway integrations that send messages to POC-Queue-${Environment}."
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: APIGatewayAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref APIGatewaySQSSendPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:

  LambdaSQSConsumerRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the Lambda function that consumes the SQS queue.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaSQSConsumerRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "ecommerce-${Environment}-LambdaSQSConsumerRoleArn"

  LambdaDynamoDBStreamRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the Lambda function that processes DynamoDB Streams and publishes to SNS.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaDynamoDBStreamRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "ecommerce-${Environment}-LambdaDynamoDBStreamRoleArn"

  APIGatewaySQSSendRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by API Gateway to send messages to the SQS queue.
    Value: !GetAtt APIGatewaySQSSendRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "ecommerce-${Environment}-APIGatewaySQSSendRoleArn"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC with public and private subnets, NAT gateway for private outbound internet access.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.0.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet.
  PrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.32.0/21
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  NatGatewayEIP:

    Type: AWS::S3::Object
    Properties:

      Key: scripts/assets_access.py
      Body: |
        import sys
        import json
        import boto3
        from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions

        args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ["BUCKET", "PREFIX", "ACCOUNT_ID"])
        bucket = args["BUCKET"]
        prefix = args["PREFIX"]
        account_id = args["ACCOUNT_ID"]

        qs = boto3.client("quicksight")
        s3 = boto3.client("s3")

        PERMISSION_APIS = {
            "DashboardId": "describe_dashboard_permissions",
            "AnalysisId": "describe_analysis_permissions",
            "DataSetId": "describe_data_set_permissions",
            "DataSourceId": "describe_data_source_permissions",
            "FolderId": "describe_folder_permissions",
        }

        LIST_APIS = {
            "Dashboard": ("list_dashboards", "DashboardSummaryList"),
            "Analysis": ("list_analyses", "AnalysisSummaryList"),
            "DataSet": ("list_data_sets", "DataSetSummaries"),
            "DataSource": ("list_data_sources", "DataSources"),
            "Folder": ("list_folders", "FolderSummaryList"),
        }


        def paginate(client_fn, result_key, **kwargs):
            items = []
            token = None
            while True:
                if token:
                    kwargs["NextToken"] = token
                resp = client_fn(**kwargs)
                items.extend(resp.get(result_key, []))
                token = resp.get("NextToken")
                if not token:
                    break
            return items


        def asset_permissions(id_key, asset_id):
            api_name = PERMISSION_APIS.get(id_key)
            if not api_name:
                return []
            api = getattr(qs, api_name)
            try:
                resp = api(AwsAccountId=account_id, **{id_key: asset_id})
            except Exception as exc:
                return [{"AssetId": asset_id, "Error": str(exc)}]
            out = []
            for perm in resp.get("Permissions", []):
                out.append(
                    {
                        "AssetId": asset_id,
                        "Principal": perm.get("Principal"),
                        "Actions": perm.get("Actions", []),
                    }
                )
            return out


        def main():
            assets = []
            for asset_type, (list_api, result_key) in LIST_APIS.items():
                id_key = asset_type + "Id"
                try:
                    summaries = paginate(
                        getattr(qs, list_api), result_key, AwsAccountId=account_id
                    )
                except Exception as exc:
                    assets.append({"AssetType": asset_type, "Error": str(exc)})
                    continue
                for summary in summaries:
                    asset_id = summary.get(id_key)
                    if not asset_id:
                        continue
                    for record in asset_permissions(id_key, asset_id):
                        record["AssetType"] = asset_type
                        assets.append(record)

            users = []
            try:
                users = paginate(
                    qs.list_users,
                    "UserList",
                    AwsAccountId=account_id,
                    Namespace="default",
                )
            except Exception as exc:
                users = [{"Error": str(exc)}]

            payload = {"Assets": assets, "Users": users}
            s3.put_object(
                Bucket=bucket,
                Key=prefix + "assets-access.json",
                Body=json.dumps(payload, default=str).encode("utf-8"),
            )
            print("Exported {0} asset permission records".format(len(assets)))


        if __name__ == "__main__":
            main()
