final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice that registers itself with a private
  AWS Cloud Map DNS namespace for service discovery. Includes its own VPC
  (public subnet, two private subnets across two AZs, Internet Gateway, NAT
  Gateway), ECS cluster, task execution role, CloudWatch log group, and
  Application Auto Scaling (2-10 tasks) driven by CloudWatch CPU alarms.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 24
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens."
    Description: Name of the environment, used for naming and for the private DNS namespace.

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-service
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 24
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens."
    Description: Name of the microservice.

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx:latest
    Description: Container image to run (for example, nginx:latest or an ECR image URI).

  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: Port on which the container listens and that is registered in Cloud Map.

  TaskCpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    Description: Fargate task CPU units (256 = 0.25 vCPU).

  TaskMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: Fargate task memory in MiB.

  DesiredTaskCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Desired number of running ECS tasks.

  CustomTaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of an existing IAM role that the container can assume to
      access other AWS resources. Leave blank to have the stack create a
      default task role.

Conditions:
  CreateDefaultTaskRole: !Equals [!Ref CustomTaskRoleArn, ""]

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Networking

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-igw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # ------------------------------------------------------------ Security Group

  ServiceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub Security group for the ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName} ECS service
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow container-to-container traffic within the VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: "-1"
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow all outbound traffic
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------- ECS Cluster

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ------------------------------------------------------------ Logging / IAM

  ServiceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Execution role for the ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName} ECS tasks
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DefaultTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateDefaultTaskRole
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Default task role for the ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName} ECS tasks
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ------------------------------------------------------------ Service Discovery

  ServiceDiscoveryNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}.local
      Description: !Sub Private DNS namespace shared by services in ${EnvironmentName}
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ServiceDiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      Description: !Sub Cloud Map service registration for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}
      NamespaceId: !Ref ServiceDiscoveryNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ------------------------------------------------------- Task Definition / Service

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}
      Cpu: !Ref TaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref TaskMemory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If
        - CreateDefaultTaskRole
        - !GetAtt DefaultTaskRole.Arn
        - !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              HostPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          Environment:
            - Name: ENVIRONMENT
              Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
            - Name: SERVICE_NAME
              Value: !Ref ServiceName
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ServiceLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - PrivateRoute
      - PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation
      - PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      ServiceName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredTaskCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryService.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ------------------------------------------------------- Application Auto Scaling

  ECSScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: ECSService
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ResourceId: !Sub service/${ECSCluster}/${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}
      RoleARN: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/ecs.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForApplicationAutoScaling_ECSService
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs

  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-up
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ECSScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 10
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 10
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 3

  ScaleDownPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-down
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ECSScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  # --------------------------------------------------------------- CloudWatch Alarms

  HighCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-high
      AlarmDescription: !Sub Scale up ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName} when average CPU utilization is at or above 70 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleUpPolicy

  LowCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-low
      AlarmDescription: !Sub Scale down ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName} when average CPU utilization is at or below 20 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleDownPolicy

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC created for the environment.
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first private subnet.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second private subnet.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EcsClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster.
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster

  EcsServiceName:
    Description: Name of the ECS service.
    Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}

  TaskDefinitionArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task definition.
    Value: !Ref TaskDefinition

  ServiceSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group used by the microservice containers.
    Value: !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup

  ServiceDiscoveryNamespaceName:
    Description: Private DNS namespace used for service discovery.
    Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}.local

  ServiceDiscoveryServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cloud Map service; other services resolve this service via SRV DNS records.
    Value: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryService.Arn

  ServiceDnsName:
    Description: DNS namespace-qualified name of the microservice (SRV record).

  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch log group that receives the container logs.
    Value: !Ref ServiceLogGroup

  TaskExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn

Description: AWS network backbone for hybrid interconnect demonstration with OCI primary region

Parameters:

    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block.
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the subnet
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block.
  InternalCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    Description: CIDR block for internal access (on-premises or corporate network)
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block.
  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the OCI backbone network
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block.
  CreateVpn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'

      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the VPN connection to OCI.
  CustomerGatewayIp:
    Type: String
    Default: '192.0.2.1'
    Description: Public IP address of the OCI customer gateway. Required if CreateVpn is true.
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$

Conditions:

Resources:

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet:

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'

  Route:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Transit Gateway for ${AWS::StackName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw'

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-attachment'

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-rt'

  TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  RouteToTransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      GatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for hybrid interconnect
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS from internal CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS to OCI backbone CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg'

  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC flow logs encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: key-default-1
        Statement:
          - Sid: Allow administration of the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': logs.amazonaws.com
                'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlog'

  CustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateVpnCondition
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      IpAddress: !Ref CustomerGatewayIp
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cgw'

  VPNConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateVpnCondition
    Properties:
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      Type: ipsec.1
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpn'

  VPNConnectionRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnectionRoute
    Condition: CreateVpnCondition
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref VPNConnection

  TransitGatewayRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Condition: CreateVpnCondition
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VPNConnection

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  SubnetId:
    Description: Subnet ID
    Value: !Ref Subnet
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: Transit Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security Group ID
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroup
  FlowLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Log Group for VPC Flow Logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline: S3 bucket, IAM role,
  five Glue jobs, five scheduled triggers, CloudTrail Glue table, and outputs.

Resources:
  DataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "quicksight-admin-prep-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AccessControl: Private
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "quicksight-admin-prep-${AWS::AccountId}"

  GlueJobRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "QuickSightAdminConsoleGlueRole-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - quicksight.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonQuickSightFullAccess"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSGlueConsoleFullAccess"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchFullAccess"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchLogsFullAccess"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AssumeRolesForGlueAndCloudFormation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/GlueServiceRole*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormationServiceRole*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/service-role/CloudFormation*"

  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub "quicksight_admin_console_${AWS::AccountId}"
        Description: Database for QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline

  CloudTrailLogTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabase
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: cloudtrail_logs
        Description: CloudTrail logs for QuickSight admin console
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: cloudtrail
          EXTERNAL: 'TRUE'
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: eventversion
              Type: string
            - Name: useridentity
              Type: 'struct<type:string,principalid:string,arn:string,accountid:string,accesskeyid:string,username:string,sessioncontext:struct<attributes:struct<creationdate:string,mfaauthenticated:string>,sessionissuer:struct<type:string,principalid:string,arn:string,accountid:string,username:string>>>'
            - Name: eventtime
              Type: string
            - Name: eventsource
              Type: string
            - Name: eventname
              Type: string
            - Name: awsregion
              Type: string
            - Name: sourceipaddress
              Type: string
            - Name: useragent
              Type: string
            - Name: errorcode
              Type: string
            - Name: errormessage
              Type: string
            - Name: requestparameters
              Type: string
            - Name: responseelements
              Type: string
            - Name: additionaleventdata
              Type: string
            - Name: requestid
              Type: string
            - Name: eventid
              Type: string
            - Name: resources
              Type: 'array<struct<arn:string,accountid:string,type:string>>'
            - Name: eventtype
              Type: string
            - Name: apiversion
              Type: string
            - Name: readonly
              Type: boolean
            - Name: recipientaccountid
              Type: string
            - Name: serviceeventdetails
              Type: string
            - Name: sharedeventid
              Type: string
            - Name: vpcendpointid
              Type: string
            - Name: tlsdetails
              Type: 'struct<clientprovidedhostheader:string,tlssubject:string,cipher_suite:string,tls_version:string,client_provided_host_header:string>'
          Location: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/cloudtrail/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/CloudTrail/"
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.openx.data.jsonserde.JsonSerDe
            Parameters:
              paths: eventversion,useridentity,eventtime,eventsource,eventname,awsregion,sourceipaddress,useragent,errorcode,errormessage,requestparameters,responseelements,additionaleventdata,requestid,eventid,resources,eventtype,apiversion,readonly,recipientaccountid,serviceeventdetails,sharedeventid,vpcendpointid,tlsdetails
          PartitionKeys:
            - Name: year
              Type: string
            - Name: month
              Type: string
            - Name: day
              Type: string

  GroupMembershipJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "quicksight-admin-group-membership-${AWS::Region}"
      Role: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/scripts/group_membership.py"
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1.0
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-language": python
        "--output_path": !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/prepared/group_membership/"
        "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": 'true'
        "--enable-metrics": 'true'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Tags:
        Project: QuickSightAdminConsole

  ObjectAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "quicksight-admin-object-access-${AWS::Region}"
      Role: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/scripts/object_access.py"
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1.0
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-language": python
        "--output_path": !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/prepared/object_access/"
        "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": 'true'
        "--enable-metrics": 'true'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Tags:
        Project: QuickSightAdminConsole

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "quicksight-admin-folder-assets-${AWS::Region}"
      Role: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/scripts/folder_assets.py"
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1.0
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-language": python
        "--output_path": !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/prepared/folder_assets/"
        "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": 'true'
        "--enable-metrics": 'true'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Tags:
        Project: QuickSightAdminConsole

  FolderLookupJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "quicksight-admin-folder-lookup-${AWS::Region}"
      Role: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/scripts/folder_lookup.py"
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 10
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-language": python
        "--output_path": !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/prepared/folder_lookup/"
        "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": 'true'
        "--enable-metrics": 'true'
        "--enable-glue-datacatalog": 'true'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Tags:
        Project: QuickSightAdminConsole

  FolderPathJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "quicksight-admin-folder-path-${AWS::Region}"
      Role: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/scripts/folder_path.py"
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 10
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-language": python
        "--output_path": !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/prepared/folder_path/"
        "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": 'true'
        "--enable-metrics": 'true'
        "--enable-glue-datacatalog": 'true'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Tags:
        Project: QuickSightAdminConsole

  GroupMembershipTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    DependsOn: GroupMembershipJob
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "quicksight-admin-group-membership-trigger-${AWS::Region}"
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GroupMembershipJob

  ObjectAccessTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    DependsOn: ObjectAccessJob
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "quicksight-admin-object-access-trigger-${AWS::Region}"
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref ObjectAccessJob

  FolderAssetsTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    DependsOn: FolderAssetsJob
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "quicksight-admin-folder-assets-trigger-${AWS::Region}"
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderAssetsJob

  FolderLookupTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    DependsOn: FolderLookupJob
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "quicksight-admin-folder-lookup-trigger-${AWS::Region}"
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderLookupJob

  FolderPathTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    DependsOn: FolderPathJob
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "quicksight-admin-folder-path-trigger-${AWS::Region}"
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderPathJob

Outputs:
  DataBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for QuickSight admin console data preparation
    Value: !Ref DataBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DataBucketName"

  GroupMembershipPath:
    Description: S3 path for group membership prepared data
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/prepared/group_membership/"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-GroupMembershipPath"

  ObjectAccessPath:
    Description: S3 path for object access prepared data
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/prepared/object_access/"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ObjectAccessPath"

  FolderAssetsPath:
    Description: S3 path for folder assets prepared data
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/prepared/folder_assets/"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-FolderAssetsPath"

  FolderLookupPath:
    Description: S3 path for folder lookup prepared data
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/prepared/folder_lookup/"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-FolderLookupPath"

  FolderPathPath:
    Description: S3 path for folder path prepared data
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/prepared/folder_path/"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-FolderPathPath"

  CloudTrailLogTableName:
    Description: Glue Catalog table name for CloudTrail logs
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailLogTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogTableName"

  CloudTrailLogS3Location:
    Description: S3 location for CloudTrail log table
    Value: !Sub "s3://${DataBucket}/cloudtrail/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/CloudTrail/"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogS3Location"

  GlueJobRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by Glue jobs
    Value: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-GlueJobRoleArn"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for EC2 Image Builder pipeline with custom Chef recipe, AMI distribution, and lifecycle policy.

Parameters:
  PipelineName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyImagePipeline
    Description: Name of the Image Builder pipeline.
  ComponentNameChef:
    Type: String
    Default: ChefRecipeComponent
    Description: Name of the Chef recipe component.
  ComponentNameSSM:
    Type: String
    Default: UpdateSSMAgentComponent
    Description: Name of the SSM agent update component.
  ComponentNameTest:
    Type: String
    Default: TestComponent
    Description: Name of the test component.
  ImageRecipeName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyImageRecipe
    Description: Name of the Image Recipe.
  InfrastructureConfigName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyInfraConfig
    Description: Name of the Infrastructure Configuration.
  DistributionConfigName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyDistributionConfig
    Description: Name of the Distribution Configuration.
  LifecyclePolicyName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyLifecyclePolicy
    Description: Name of the Lifecycle Policy.
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: Target region for AMI distribution.
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.medium
    Description: EC2 instance type for Image Builder.
  SubnetId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id
    Description: Subnet ID for Image Builder instances.
  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup::Id
    Description: Security Group ID for Image Builder instances.
  ChefS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Default: my-chef-recipe-bucket
    Description: S3 bucket containing the Chef recipe.
  ChefS3Key:
    Type: String
    Default: chef-recipe.tar.gz
    Description: S3 key of the Chef recipe.

Resources:
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3ReadAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ChefS3Bucket}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ChefS3Bucket}/*"

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2ImageBuilderServiceRolePolicy"

  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LifecyclePermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute
                Resource: "*"

  ChefRecipeComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ComponentNameChef
      Description: Downloads and executes a Chef recipe from S3.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: "1.0.0"
      Data: |
        name: ChefRecipeComponent
        description: Downloads and executes a Chef recipe from S3.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        parameters:
          - ChefS3Bucket:
              type: string
              description: S3 bucket containing the Chef recipe
          - ChefS3Key:
              type: string
              description: S3 key of the Chef recipe
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallChef
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - curl -L https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh | bash -s -- -v 17
              - name: DownloadChefRecipe
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - aws s3 cp s3://{{ChefS3Bucket}}/{{ChefS3Key}} /tmp/chef-recipe.tar.gz
              - name: ExtractChefRecipe
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - mkdir -p /tmp/chef-recipe
                    - tar -xzf /tmp/chef-recipe.tar.gz -C /tmp/chef-recipe --strip-components=1
              - name: RunChefRecipe
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - cd /tmp/chef-recipe && chef-solo -c solo.rb -j node.json || chef-client -z -c client.rb

  UpdateSSMAgentAndCollectMetadataComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ComponentNameSSM
      Description: Updates SSM agent and collects metadata.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: "1.0.0"
      Data: |
        name: UpdateSSMAgentAndCollectMetadata
        description: Updates SSM agent and collects metadata.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSSMAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent
              - name: CollectMetadata
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - echo "Instance ID: $(ec2-metadata --instance-id | cut -d ' ' -f 2)" > /tmp/metadata.txt
                    - echo "AMI ID: $(ec2-metadata --ami-id | cut -d ' ' -f 2)" >> /tmp/metadata.txt
                    - echo "Instance Type: $(ec2-metadata --instance-type | cut -d ' ' -f 2)" >> /tmp/metadata.txt
                    - cat /tmp/metadata.txt

  TestComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ComponentNameTest
      Description: Test component to verify the image.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: "1.0.0"
      Data: |
        name: TestComponent
        description: Test component to verify the image.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: TestSSMAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - systemctl status amazon-ssm-agent

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ImageRecipeName
      Description: Image recipe for custom AMI.
      Version: "1.0.0"
      ParentImage: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::parameter/aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id"
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt ChefRecipeComponent.Arn
          Parameters:
            - Name: ChefS3Bucket
              Value: !Ref ChefS3Bucket
            - Name: ChefS3Key
              Value: !Ref ChefS3Key
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt UpdateSSMAgentAndCollectMetadataComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt TestComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref InfrastructureConfigName
      Description: Infrastructure configuration for Image Builder.
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref InstanceType
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetId
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroupId
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DistributionConfigName
      Description: Distribution configuration for Image Builder.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref TargetRegion
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: "{{imagebuilder:buildDate}}-{{imagebuilder:buildVersion}}"
            Description: "AMI distributed from {{imagebuilder:buildDate}}"
            AmiTags:
              Lifecycle: Deprecate
              SourceAMI: "{{imagebuilder:parentImage}}"

  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref PipelineName
      Description: Pipeline for building custom AMIs.
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 0 * * ? *)"
      Status: ENABLED
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderExecutionRole.Arn
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true

  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref LifecyclePolicyName
      Description: Lifecycle policy to deprecate old AMIs.
      Status: ENABLED
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI
      ResourceSelection:
        TagSelection:
          TagKey: Lifecycle
          TagValue: Deprecate
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action: DEPRECATE
          Schedule:
            ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 0 1 * ? *)"
          Deprecation:
            DeprecationAt: 90

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Pipeline.
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePipeline.Arn
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Recipe.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the Distribution Configuration.
    Value: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lifecycle Policy.
    Value: !GetAtt LifecyclePolicy.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'PII Classification Scanner for S3 Access Point using Amazon Comprehend'

Parameters:
  AccessPointArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the S3 Access Point to scan.

  SNSTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: ARN of an existing SNS topic for notifications (optional).

  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: VPC ID where the access point is VPC-scoped (required if access point is VPC-scoped).

  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Comma-separated list of subnet IDs for the Lambda (required if VpcId is provided).

  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Security group ID for the Lambda (required if VpcId is provided).

  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Comma-separated list of route table IDs for Gateway endpoints (required if VpcId is provided).

  CreateEndpoints:
    Type: Boolean
    Default: true
    Description: Create VPC endpoints for S3, DynamoDB, Comprehend, and SNS (only if VpcId is provided). Set to false if the VPC already has these endpoints.

  LambdaMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: Memory size for the Lambda function in MB.

  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    Description: Timeout for the Lambda function in seconds.

  ComprehendLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: 'en'
    Description: Language code for Comprehend DetectPiiEntities.

  MaxFilesPerInvocation:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    Description: Maximum number of files to scan per Lambda invocation.

Conditions:
  HasVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
  HasSnsTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SNSTopicArn, '']]
  ShouldCreateEndpoints: !And
    - !Condition HasVpc
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateEndpoints, true]

Resources:
  PiiReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PiiReports'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: FileKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: FileKey
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PiiReports'

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !If
          - HasVpc
          - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaPiiScannerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetAccessPoint
                Resource: !Ref AccessPointArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Ref AccessPointArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${AccessPointArn}/object/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt PiiReportTable.Arn
              - !If
                - HasSnsTopic
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - sns:Publish
                  Resource: !Ref SNSTopicArn
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  PiiScannerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PiiScanner'
      Runtime: python3.9
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemory
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !Ref AccessPointArn
          REPORT_TABLE_NAME: !Ref PiiReportTable
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !If [HasSnsTopic, !Ref SNSTopicArn, '']
          COMPREHEND_LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref ComprehendLanguageCode
          MAX_FILES_PER_INVOCATION: !Ref MaxFilesPerInvocation
          VPC_ID: !If [HasVpc, !Ref VpcId, '']
      VpcConfig: !If
        - HasVpc
        - SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
          SecurityGroupIds:
            - !Ref SecurityGroupId
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os
          import json
          import random
          from datetime import datetime

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              access_point_arn = os.environ['ACCESS_POINT_ARN']
              report_table_name = os.environ['REPORT_TABLE_NAME']
              sns_topic_arn = os.environ.get('SNS_TOPIC_ARN', '')
              language_code = os.environ.get('COMPREHEND_LANGUAGE_CODE', 'en')
              max_files = int(os.environ.get('MAX_FILES_PER_INVOCATION', 500))
              vpc_id = os.environ.get('VPC_ID', '')

              # Parse access point ARN to get account ID and name
              parts = access_point_arn.split(':')
              account_id = parts[4]
              ap_name = parts[5].split('/')[1]

              s3control = boto3.client('s3control')
              try:
                  ap_info = s3control.get_access_point(AccountId=account_id, Name=ap_name)
                  network_origin = ap_info['NetworkOrigin']
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error getting access point info: {e}")
                  raise

              if network_origin == 'VPC' and not vpc_id:
                  raise Exception("Access point is VPC-scoped but Lambda is not configured with VPC parameters. Please provide VpcId, SubnetIds, SecurityGroupId, and RouteTableIds.")

              s3 = boto3.client('s3')
              comprehend = boto3.client('comprehend')
              dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
              table = dynamodb.Table(report_table_name)

              # List all objects with pagination
              all_keys = []
              paginator = s3.get_paginator('list_objects_v2')
              for page in paginator.paginate(Bucket=access_point_arn):
                  if 'Contents' in page:
                      for obj in page['Contents']:
                          all_keys.append(obj['Key'])

              if len(all_keys) > max_files:
                  sampled_keys = random.sample(all_keys, max_files)
              else:
                  sampled_keys = all_keys

              results = []
              for key in sampled_keys:
                  try:
                      response = s3.get_object(Bucket=access_point_arn, Key=key)
                      content = response['Body'].read()
                      try:
                          text = content.decode('utf-8')
                      except UnicodeDecodeError:
                          text = content.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')

                      chunk_size = 5000
                      all_entities = []
                      for i in range(0, len(text), chunk_size):
                          chunk = text[i:i+chunk_size]
                          if len(chunk.strip()) == 0:
                              continue
                          try:
                              comp_response = comprehend.detect_pii_entities(
                                  Text=chunk,
                                  LanguageCode=language_code
                              )
                              for entity in comp_response.get('Entities', []):
                                  entity['BeginOffset'] += i
                                  entity['EndOffset'] += i
                                  all_entities.append(entity)
                          except Exception as e:
                              print(f"Comprehend error for key {key} chunk {i}: {e}")
                              continue

                      item = {
                          'FileKey': key,
                          'ScanTimestamp': datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
                          'PiiEntities': all_entities,
                          'EntityCount': len(all_entities)
                      }
                      table.put_item(Item=item)
                      results.append({
                          'FileKey': key,
                          'EntityCount': len(all_entities)
                      })

                  except Exception as e:
                      print(f"Error processing key {key}: {e}")
                      results.append({
                          'FileKey': key,
                          'Error': str(e)
                      })

              if sns_topic_arn:
                  sns = boto3.client('sns')
                  message = f"PII scan completed. Scanned {len(results)} files. Results stored in {report_table_name}."
                  try:
                      sns.publish(TopicArn=sns_topic_arn, Subject='PII Scan Report', Message=message)
                  except Exception as e:
                      print(f"Error publishing to SNS: {e}")

              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({
                      'message': 'Scan completed',
                      'scanned_files': len(results),
                      'results': results
                  })
              }

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'

            Resource: '*'

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateEndpoints

      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Air-routes graph catalog. Creates the "graph-database" AWS Glue database holding the
  labeled property graph (LPG) tables (airport, country, continent, route and customairport)
  and the "graph-database-rdf" AWS Glue database holding the RDF tables (airport_rdf,
  route_rdf and route_rdf_nopfx), all with a comma field separator and the graph
  semantics expressed through glue.graph.* table properties.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Graph database names
        Parameters:
          - LpgDatabaseName
          - RdfDatabaseName
      - Label:
          default: Air-routes ontology namespaces
        Parameters:
          - AirRoutesClassNamespace
          - AirRoutesDatatypePropertyNamespace
          - AirRoutesObjectPropertyNamespace
    ParameterLabels:
      LpgDatabaseName:
        default: Labeled property graph database name
      RdfDatabaseName:
        default: RDF graph database name
      AirRoutesClassNamespace:
        default: Air-routes class namespace URI
      AirRoutesDatatypePropertyNamespace:
        default: Air-routes datatypeProperty namespace URI
      AirRoutesObjectPropertyNamespace:
        default: Air-routes objectProperty namespace URI

Parameters:

  LpgDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database
    Description: >-
      Name of the AWS Glue database that holds the labeled property graph (LPG) tables
      of the air-routes graph.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+'

  RdfDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database-rdf
    Description: >-
      Name of the AWS Glue database that holds the RDF tables of the air-routes graph.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+'

  AirRoutesClassNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/class/'
    Description: >-
      Base URI of the air-routes ontology "class" namespace, exposed to the RDF tables
      through the "class" prefix (for example class:Airport).
    MinLength: 1

  AirRoutesDatatypePropertyNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/'
    Description: >-
      Base URI of the air-routes ontology "datatypeProperty" namespace, exposed to the
      RDF tables through the "datatypeProperty" prefix.
    MinLength: 1

  AirRoutesObjectPropertyNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/'
    Description: >-
      Base URI of the air-routes ontology "objectProperty" namespace, exposed to the RDF
      tables through the "objectProperty" prefix.
    MinLength: 1

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Databases
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  LpgGraphDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref LpgDatabaseName
        Description: >-
          AWS Glue database that holds the labeled property graph (LPG) tables of the
          air-routes graph (airport, country, continent, route and customairport).

  RdfGraphDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref RdfDatabaseName
        Description: >-
          AWS Glue database that holds the RDF tables of the air-routes graph
          (airport_rdf, route_rdf and route_rdf_nopfx).

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LPG (labeled property graph) tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  AirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LpgGraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport
        Description: Airports of the air-routes graph - vertex table labeled "airport".
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          separatorChar: ','
          skip.header.line.count: '1'
          glue.graph.type: vertex
          glue.graph.node.label: airport
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
              Comment: Unique airport identifier
            - Name: code
              Type: string
              Comment: Three letter IATA airport code
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
              Comment: Airport description
            - Name: region
              Type: string
              Comment: Region the airport belongs to
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
              Comment: Number of runways
            - Name: longest
              Type: int
              Comment: Length of the longest runway in feet
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
              Comment: Airport elevation in feet
            - Name: country
              Type: string
              Comment: Country code of the airport
            - Name: city
              Type: string
              Comment: City served by the airport
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
              Comment: Latitude of the airport
            - Name: lon
              Type: double
              Comment: Longitude of the airport
            - Name: type
              Type: string
              Comment: Airport type
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat

  CountryTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LpgGraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: country
        Description: Countries of the air-routes graph - vertex table labeled "country".
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          separatorChar: ','
          skip.header.line.count: '1'
          glue.graph.type: vertex
          glue.graph.node.label: country
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
              Comment: Unique country identifier
            - Name: code
              Type: string
              Comment: Two letter ISO country code
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
              Comment: Country description
            - Name: type
              Type: string
              Comment: Country type
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat

  ContinentTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LpgGraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: continent
        Description: Continents of the air-routes graph - vertex table labeled "continent".
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          separatorChar: ','
          skip.header.line.count: '1'
          glue.graph.type: vertex
          glue.graph.node.label: continent
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
              Comment: Unique continent identifier
            - Name: code
              Type: string
              Comment: Continent code
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
              Comment: Continent description
            - Name: type
              Type: string
              Comment: Continent type
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LpgGraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route
        Description: Routes between airports - edge table labeled "route".
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          separatorChar: ','
          skip.header.line.count: '1'
          glue.graph.type: edge
          glue.graph.node.label: route
          glue.graph.edge.source: airport
          glue.graph.edge.destination: airport
          glue.graph.edge.source.column: src
          glue.graph.edge.destination.column: dst
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
              Comment: Unique route identifier
            - Name: src
              Type: string
              Comment: Airport code the route departs from
            - Name: dst
              Type: string
              Comment: Airport code the route arrives at
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
              Comment: Distance of the route in miles
            - Name: label
              Type: string
              Comment: Edge label
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat

  CustomAirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LpgGraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: customairport
        Description: >-
          View table that projects the source and destination airport codes for up to
          ten routes of the air-routes graph.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          separatorChar: ','
          glue.graph.type: view
          glue.graph.node.label: customairport
          glue.graph.query.language: gremlin
          glue.graph.query: "g.V().hasLabel('airport').as('srcAirport').outE('route').inV().as('dstAirport').select('srcAirport','dstAirport').by('code').limit(10)"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: srcAirport
              Type: string
              Comment: IATA code of the airport the route departs from
            - Name: dstAirport
              Type: string
              Comment: IATA code of the airport the route arrives at
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RDF tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  AirportRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RdfGraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport_rdf
        Description: >-
          RDF class table for air-routes airports, backed by the class:Airport URI of the
          air-routes ontology.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          separatorChar: ','
          skip.header.line.count: '1'
          glue.graph.type: rdf
          glue.graph.rdf.querymode: class
          glue.graph.rdf.classuri: 'class:Airport'
          glue.graph.rdf.stripprefix: 'true'
          glue.graph.rdf.prefix.class: !Ref AirRoutesClassNamespace
          glue.graph.rdf.prefix.datatypeProperty: !Ref AirRoutesDatatypePropertyNamespace
          glue.graph.rdf.prefix.objectProperty: !Ref AirRoutesObjectPropertyNamespace
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
              Comment: Unique airport identifier
            - Name: code
              Type: string
              Comment: Three letter IATA airport code
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
              Comment: Airport description
            - Name: region
              Type: string
              Comment: Region the airport belongs to
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
              Comment: Number of runways
            - Name: longest
              Type: int
              Comment: Length of the longest runway in feet
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
              Comment: Airport elevation in feet
            - Name: country
              Type: string
              Comment: Country code of the airport
            - Name: city
              Type: string
              Comment: City served by the airport
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
              Comment: Latitude of the airport
            - Name: lon
              Type: double
              Comment: Longitude of the airport
            - Name: type
              Type: string
              Comment: Airport type
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat

  RouteRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RdfGraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf
        Description: >-
          RDF SPARQL table projecting route codes and distances, using the air-routes
          ontology prefixes declared as separate parameters.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          separatorChar: ','
          glue.graph.type: rdf
          glue.graph.rdf.querymode: sparql
          glue.graph.rdf.stripprefix: 'true'
          glue.graph.rdf.prefix.class: !Ref AirRoutesClassNamespace
          glue.graph.rdf.prefix.datatypeProperty: !Ref AirRoutesDatatypePropertyNamespace
          glue.graph.rdf.prefix.objectProperty: !Ref AirRoutesObjectPropertyNamespace
          glue.graph.query.language: sparql
          glue.graph.query: |
            SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist
            WHERE {
              ?route a class:Route .
              ?route objectProperty:from ?srcAirport .
              ?route objectProperty:to ?dstAirport .
              ?route datatypeProperty:dist ?dist .
              ?srcAirport datatypeProperty:code ?incode .
              ?dstAirport datatypeProperty:code ?outcode .
            }
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
              Comment: IATA code of the inbound airport
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
              Comment: IATA code of the outbound airport
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
              Comment: Distance of the route in miles
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat

  RouteRdfNoPfxTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RdfGraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf_nopfx
        Description: >-
          RDF SPARQL table projecting route codes and distances, embedding the full
          air-routes ontology URIs directly in the query text instead of using prefixes.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          separatorChar: ','
          glue.graph.type: rdf
          glue.graph.rdf.querymode: sparql
          glue.graph.rdf.stripprefix: 'true'
          glue.graph.query.language: sparql
          glue.graph.query: !Sub
            - |
              SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist
              WHERE {
                ?route a <${ClassNs}Route> .
                ?route <${ObjNs}from> ?srcAirport .
                ?route <${ObjNs}to> ?dstAirport .
                ?route <${DtNs}dist> ?dist .
                ?srcAirport <${DtNs}code> ?incode .
                ?dstAirport <${DtNs}code> ?outcode .
              }
            - ClassNs: !Ref AirRoutesClassNamespace
              ObjNs: !Ref AirRoutesObjectPropertyNamespace
              DtNs: !Ref AirRoutesDatatypePropertyNamespace
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
              Comment: IATA code of the inbound airport
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
              Comment: IATA code of the outbound airport
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
              Comment: Distance of the route in miles
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat

Outputs:

  LpgGraphDatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the AWS Glue database that holds the labeled property graph tables.
    Value: !Ref LpgGraphDatabase

  RdfGraphDatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the AWS Glue database that holds the RDF tables.
    Value: !Ref RdfGraphDatabase

          RequireSymbols: true

      AdminCreateUserConfig:

        Project: PiBot

      LogoutURLs:
        - https://localhost/logout
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:

        - openid
