AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff authentication platform. Creates an Amazon Cognito user pool on the
  PLUS tier with advanced security enforced, email as the username attribute, admin-only user creation,
  custom guest_id/property_id/region attributes, a strong password policy, and email account recovery.
  Includes a public SPA client (SRP), a dedicated admin test-harness client (ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH),
  a confidential machine-to-machine OAuth2 client with a resource server (read/write/admin scopes),
  Cognito groups for staff roles, and a hosted user pool domain scoped by environment and account ID.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment for the AnyCompany Hotel authentication stack.
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    ConstraintDescription: Environment must be one of dev, staging, or prod.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito User Pool (PLUS tier, advanced security, email usernames)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HotelUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-user-pool"
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        UnusedAccountValidityDays: 7
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          PasswordHistorySize: 24
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: "custom:guest_id"
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: "1"
            MaxLength: "128"
        - Name: "custom:property_id"
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: "1"
            MaxLength: "128"
        - Name: "custom:region"
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: "1"
            MaxLength: "64"
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: anycompany-hotel-auth
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted user pool domain (environment + account ID) for the OAuth2 endpoints
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HotelUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}"
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public SPA client - SRP auth, no secret, 1h access/id, 30d refresh
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HotelSpaUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-spa-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AuthSessionValidity: 3
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Dedicated admin client - ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH for test harnesses/simulators
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HotelAdminUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-admin-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # OAuth2 resource server exposing read/write/admin scopes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HotelApiResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: anycompany-hotel-api
      Name: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api"
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Confidential machine-to-machine client - client_credentials flow with secret
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HotelMachineUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-m2m-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - "anycompany-hotel-api/read"
        - "anycompany-hotel-api/write"
        - "anycompany-hotel-api/admin"
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
    DependsOn: HotelApiResourceServer

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Staff role groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: Full administrative access to AnyCompany Hotel platforms
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Precedence: 1

  RegionalManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegionalManager
      Description: Regional level management and reporting access
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Precedence: 2

  ManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Manager
      Description: Property level management access
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Precedence: 3

  RevenueManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RevenueManager
      Description: Rates, inventory and revenue management access
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Precedence: 4

  FrontDeskGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: FrontDesk
      Description: Front desk check-in, check-out and guest service access
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Precedence: 5

  HousekeepingGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Housekeeping
      Description: Housekeeping task and room status access
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Precedence: 6

Outputs:

  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the AnyCompany Hotel Cognito user pool
    Value: !Ref HotelUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId"

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the AnyCompany Hotel Cognito user pool
    Value: !GetAtt HotelUserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn"

  SpaUserPoolClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the public SPA app client (USER_SRP_AUTH)
    Value: !Ref HotelSpaUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SpaUserPoolClientId"

  AdminUserPoolClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the admin test-harness app client (ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH)
    Value: !Ref HotelAdminUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AdminUserPoolClientId"

  MachineUserPoolClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the machine-to-machine OAuth2 app client (client_credentials)
    Value: !Ref HotelMachineUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-MachineUserPoolClientId"

  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Description: Identifier of the OAuth2 resource server exposing read, write and admin scopes
    Value: anycompany-hotel-api
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ResourceServerIdentifier"

  UserPoolDomainPrefix:
    Description: Cognito hosted domain prefix for the user pool
    Value: !Ref HotelUserPoolDomain
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolDomainPrefix"

  UserPoolDomainUrl:
    Description: Base URL of the hosted Cognito domain (hosted UI and OAuth2 authorization endpoints)
    Value: !Sub "https://${HotelUserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolDomainUrl"

  OAuth2TokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint used by the machine-to-machine client_credentials flow
    Value: !Sub "https://${HotelUserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-OAuth2TokenEndpoint"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito user pool for Hospitality Insights prod with post-auth Lambda, groups, optional SSO, and hosted UI domain.

Parameters:
  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Name of the SAML identity provider for SSO. Leave empty to disable SSO.
  SSOLoginUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: SAML metadata URL for the identity provider. Leave empty to disable SSO.
  CognitoDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights-prod
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Cognito hosted UI domain prefix (must be unique within the region).
  CallbackURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost
    Description: Allowed callback URL for the hosted UI.
  LogoutURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost
    Description: Allowed logout URL for the hosted UI.

Conditions:
  SSOEnabled: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOProviderName, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOLoginUrl, '']]

Resources:
  PostAuthLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PostAuthLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'

  PostAuthLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Updates custom:last_login on post authentication.
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              username = event['userName']
              last_login = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
              cognito.admin_update_user_attributes(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  UserAttributes=[
                      {'Name': 'custom:last_login', 'Value': last_login}
                  ]
              )
              return event

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: HospitalityInsightsUserPool-prod
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OFF
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: custom:last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Environment: prod
        Application: HospitalityInsights

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: WebSocket API (API Gateway V2) with $connect, $default and $disconnect routes backed by Lambda functions and a DynamoDB session table with TTL enabled.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    Description: Name of the API Gateway stage that the WebSocket API is deployed to.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '[A-Za-z0-9_-]+'
    ConstraintDescription: The stage name may only contain alphanumeric characters, hyphens and underscores.

Resources:
  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-sessions'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-sessions'

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-lambda-role'
      Description: Execution role used by the WebSocket API Lambda functions to manage connection sessions.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SessionTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SessionTableWriteAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: ManageConnectionsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageWebSocketConnections
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/*'

  ConnectFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ws-connect'
      Description: Handles the $connect route and stores the new connection id in the session table.
      Runtime: nodejs20.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 256
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SESSION_TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          const { DynamoDBClient, PutItemCommand } = require('@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb');

          const client = new DynamoDBClient({});
          const TABLE_NAME = process.env.SESSION_TABLE_NAME;
          const SESSION_TTL_SECONDS = 3600;

          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            const connectionId = event.requestContext.connectionId;
            const expiresAt = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + SESSION_TTL_SECONDS;

            await client.send(new PutItemCommand({
              TableName: TABLE_NAME,
              Item: {
                connectionId: { S: connectionId },
                connectedAt: { S: new Date().toISOString() },
                ttl: { N: String(expiresAt) }
              }
            }));

            return { statusCode: 200, body: 'Connected' };
          };
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ws-connect'

  DisconnectFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ws-disconnect'
      Description: Handles the $disconnect route and removes the connection id from the session table.
      Runtime: nodejs20.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 256
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SESSION_TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          const { DynamoDBClient, DeleteItemCommand } = require('@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb');

          const client = new DynamoDBClient({});
          const TABLE_NAME = process.env.SESSION_TABLE_NAME;

          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            const connectionId = event.requestContext.connectionId;

            await client.send(new DeleteItemCommand({
              TableName: TABLE_NAME,
              Key: {
                connectionId: { S: connectionId }
              }
            }));

            return { statusCode: 200, body: 'Disconnected' };
          };
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ws-disconnect'

  DefaultFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ws-default'
      Description: Handles the $default route and echoes incoming messages back to the calling client.
      Runtime: nodejs20.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 256
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          const { ApiGatewayManagementApiClient, PostToConnectionCommand } = require('@aws-sdk/client-apigatewaymanagementapi');

          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            const { domainName, stage, connectionId } = event.requestContext;
            const client = new ApiGatewayManagementApiClient({
              endpoint: `https://${domainName}/${stage}`
            });

            const data = event.body || JSON.stringify({ message: 'No message body received' });

            await client.send(new PostToConnectionCommand({
              ConnectionId: connectionId,
              Data: data
            }));

            return { statusCode: 200, body: 'Message sent' };
          };
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ws-default'

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-api'
      Description: WebSocket API used to manage client connections and session state.
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-api'

  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ConnectFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'
      TimeoutInMillis: 10000
      Description: Lambda proxy integration for the $connect route.

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DisconnectFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'
      TimeoutInMillis: 10000
      Description: Lambda proxy integration for the $disconnect route.

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DefaultFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'
      TimeoutInMillis: 10000
      Description: Lambda proxy integration for the $default route.

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$connect'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ConnectIntegration}'

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$disconnect'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$default'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DefaultIntegration}'

  ConnectFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ConnectFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/*'

  DisconnectFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref DisconnectFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/*'

  DefaultFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref DefaultFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/*'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Deployment containing the $connect, $default and $disconnect routes.
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      Description: WebSocket API stage for client connections and session state.
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 500
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 1000
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-stage'

Outputs:
  WebSocketApiEndpoint:
    Description: WebSocket URL that clients use to connect to the API.
    Value: !Sub 'wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'
  WebSocketApiId:
    Description: Identifier of the WebSocket API.
    Value: !Ref WebSocketApi
  StageName:
    Description: Name of the deployed API stage.
    Value: !Ref ApiStage
  SessionTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table that tracks client sessions.
    Value: !Ref SessionTable
  ConnectFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the Lambda function that handles the $connect route.
    Value: !Ref ConnectFunction
  DisconnectFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the Lambda function that handles the $disconnect route.
    Value: !Ref DisconnectFunction
  DefaultFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the Lambda function that handles the $default route.
    Value: !Ref DefaultFunction

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates a VPC with a single public subnet, internet gateway, public route table, and network ACL allowing all TCP/UDP traffic.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.0.0/16
    AllowedValues:
      - 172.18.0.0/16
      - 172.19.0.0/16
      - 172.20.0.0/16
      - 172.21.0.0/16
      - 172.22.0.0/16
      - 172.23.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC. Must be one of the fixed /16 ranges.

Mappings:
  VpcCidrToSubnet:
    "172.18.0.0/16":
      SubnetCidr: "172.18.0.0/22"
    "172.19.0.0/16":
      SubnetCidr: "172.19.0.0/22"
    "172.20.0.0/16":
      SubnetCidr: "172.20.0.0/22"
    "172.21.0.0/16":
      SubnetCidr: "172.21.0.0/22"
    "172.22.0.0/16":
      SubnetCidr: "172.22.0.0/22"
    "172.23.0.0/16":
      SubnetCidr: "172.23.0.0/22"

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [VpcCidrToSubnet, !Ref VpcCidr, SubnetCidr]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTable"

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:

Description: >-
  Deploys an AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS) experiment template and all supporting resources
  required for multi-service chaos engineering. The experiment blocks application network traffic
  from the local deployment region to a target region and pauses cross-region replication for a
  configurable duration (default 20 minutes). Only transit gateways, subnets, S3 buckets and
  DynamoDB global tables tagged with ChaosAllowed=true are targeted. The stack also provisions the
  FIS execution IAM role and policy, a KMS customer managed key, and a CloudWatch log group
  encrypted with that key for experiment logging.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Experiment configuration
        Parameters:
          - TargetRegion
          - ChaosDuration
      - Label:
          default: Experiment logging
        Parameters:
          - LogRetentionInDays
    ParameterLabels:
      TargetRegion:
        default: Target AWS Region
      ChaosDuration:
        default: Chaos duration (ISO 8601)
      LogRetentionInDays:
        default: Log retention in days

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-[0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region name, for example us-west-2.
    Description: >-
      AWS Region that the local deployment region is isolated from while the experiment runs.
      Used to scope the simulated network disruption and recorded on the experiment template.
  ChaosDuration:
    Type: String
    Default: PT20M
    AllowedPattern: '^PT([0-9]+[HMS])+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be an ISO 8601 duration expressed in hours (H), minutes (M) and/or seconds (S),
      for example PT20M.
    Description: >-
      Duration for which the network disruption and the paused replication remain in effect.
      Defaults to PT20M (20 minutes).
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: Number of days that FIS experiment logs are retained in CloudWatch Logs.

Resources:
  ExperimentLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS CMK used to encrypt AWS FIS experiment logs for stack ${AWS::StackName}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: fis-experiment-logs-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  ExperimentLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-fis-experiment-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ExperimentLogsKey

  ExperimentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/fis/${AWS::StackName}/experiment-logs'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ExperimentLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fis-experiment-logs'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  FisExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by AWS Fault Injection Simulator to disrupt network connectivity and pause
        cross-region replication during the chaos experiment.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFisToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fis-experiment-role'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FisExperimentExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: DisruptTransitGatewayAndRouteTableConnectivity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkAcls
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayVpcAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:ReplaceRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry
                  - ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclEntry
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry
                  - ec2:CreateTransitGatewayRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayRoute
                  - ec2:SearchTransitGatewayRoutes
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PauseS3CrossRegionReplication
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:PutBucketTagging
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetBucketReplication
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PutBucketReplication
                  - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PauseDynamoDBGlobalTableReplication
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:ListTables
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTableSettings
                  - dynamodb:DescribeContinuousBackups
                  - dynamodb:ListTagsOfResource
                  - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTableSettings
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ResolveTaggedTargetResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: WriteExperimentLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ExperimentLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ExperimentLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: UseExperimentLogEncryptionKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                Resource: !GetAtt ExperimentLogsKey.Arn

  ChaosExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub
        - >-
          Multi-service chaos experiment that blocks application network traffic from ${AWS::Region}
          to ${TargetRegion} and pauses cross-region replication for ${Duration} on all subnets,
          transit gateways, S3 buckets and DynamoDB global tables tagged ChaosAllowed=true.
        - TargetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
          Duration: !Ref ChaosDuration
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 2
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt ExperimentLogGroup.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      ExperimentOptions:
        AccountTargeting: single-account
        EmptyTargetResolutionMode: fail
      Tags:
        Purpose: chaos-engineering
        ChaosTargetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
        ChaosDuration: !Ref ChaosDuration
      Targets:
        Subnets:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
        TransitGateways:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:transit-gateway
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
        S3Buckets:
          ResourceType: aws:s3:bucket
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
        DynamoDBGlobalTables:
          ResourceType: aws:dynamodb:global-table
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
      Actions:
        DisruptSubnetConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:network:disrupt-connectivity
          Description: >-
            Block network traffic to the target region for every tagged subnet by manipulating the
            associated network ACLs.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ChaosDuration
          Targets:
            Subnets: Subnets
        DisruptTransitGatewayConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:network:disrupt-connectivity
          Description: >-
            Blackhole transit gateway and route table paths that carry traffic to the target region
            for every tagged transit gateway.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ChaosDuration
          Targets:
            TransitGateways: TransitGateways
        PauseS3Replication:
          ActionId: aws:s3:bucket-pause-replication
          Description: Pause cross-region replication for every tagged S3 bucket.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ChaosDuration
          Targets:
            Buckets: S3Buckets
        PauseDynamoDBGlobalTableReplication:
          ActionId: aws:dynamodb:global-table-pause-replication
          Description: Pause cross-region replication for every tagged DynamoDB global table.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ChaosDuration
          Targets:
            Tables: DynamoDBGlobalTables

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: ID of the FIS experiment template. Pass this to "aws fis start-experiment".
    Value: !Ref ChaosExperimentTemplate
  ExperimentTemplateTargetRegion:
    Description: AWS Region that the experiment isolates the deployment region from.
    Value: !Ref TargetRegion
  ExperimentDuration:
    Description: ISO 8601 duration applied to every fault in the experiment.
    Value: !Ref ChaosDuration
  ExperimentLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the KMS-encrypted CloudWatch log group receiving FIS experiment logs.
    Value: !Ref ExperimentLogGroup
  ExperimentLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS customer managed key used to encrypt experiment logs.
    Value: !GetAtt ExperimentLogsKey.Arn
  FisExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by AWS FIS to execute the experiment.
    Value: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC network foundation for Kerberos-secured Amazon EMR on EKS deployment with VPC Flow Logs encryption

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/26
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.64/26
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.128/26
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.192/26
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2
  FlowLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/vpc-flow-logs/emr-eks
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Log Group for VPC Flow Logs
    AllowedPattern: '^[\.\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Log group name can contain only alphanumeric characters, periods, hyphens, underscores, slashes, and hash signs.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1"

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2"

  NatGateway1:

Description: EC2 Image Builder pipeline for testing with custom component, workflow, recipe, distribution, and lifecycle policy.

                inputs:
                  commands:

                    - sudo chef-client --version

  SampleWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: sample-workflow
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Updates SSM agent and builds an AMI
      Type: BUILD
      Data: |
        name: sample-workflow
        description: Updates SSM agent and builds an AMI
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSsmAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent || sudo dnf update -y amazon-ssm-agent

  SampleBuildInstanceRole:

    Properties:

  SampleBuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref SampleBuildInstanceRole

  SampleInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-infrastructure-configuration
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref SampleBuildInstanceProfile
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  SampleDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-distribution-configuration

        - Region: us-east-1
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:

  SampleRecipe:

  SampleImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline

      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref SampleDistributionConfiguration

      ImageScanningConfiguration:

        - WorkflowArn: !Ref SampleWorkflow

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cognito authentication layer for a Lex chatbot web UI. Creates a Cognito User
  Pool with email as the username alias, auto-verified email and required
  given_name, family_name, email and preferred_username attributes, a User Pool
  Client without a secret, a Cognito Identity Pool that permits authenticated
  and unauthenticated identities, IAM roles attached to the identity pool and
  policies granting either Amazon Lex V1 (PostText/PostContent) or Amazon Lex
  V2 (RecognizeText/RecognizeUtterance) permissions based on parameters, Polly
  SynthesizeSpeech for authenticated identities, an optional live chat API
  (execute-api) invoke permission and an optional deny for unauthenticated Lex
  and API actions.

Parameters:
  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'identity pool'
    Description: Name of the Cognito Identity Pool created by this stack.

  LexV1BotName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'OrderFlowers'
    Description: >-
      Name of the Amazon Lex V1 bot used to build IAM policies when no Lex V2
      bot ID is provided.

  LexV2BotId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional Amazon Lex V2 bot ID. When supplied, Lex V2 IAM permissions are
      created instead of Lex V1 permissions.

  LexV2BotAliasId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Amazon Lex V2 bot alias ID. Required when LexV2BotId is supplied.

  ForceCognitoLogin:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: >-
      When true, unauthenticated identities are explicitly denied access to
      Amazon Lex and execute-api (live chat) actions.

  ShouldEnableLiveChat:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: >-
      When true, an execute-api:Invoke permission for the live chat API is
      added to the identity pool IAM roles.

Conditions:
  ShouldUseLexV2Bot: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV2BotId, '']]
  ShouldUseLexV1Bot: !Equals [!Ref LexV2BotId, '']
  ShouldForceCognitoLogin: !Equals [!Ref ForceCognitoLogin, 'true']
  ShouldEnableLiveChat: !Equals [!Ref ShouldEnableLiveChat, 'true']

Resources:

  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: 'AWS::Cognito::UserPool'
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: 'AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient'
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  CognitoIdentityPool:
    Type: 'AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool'
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false

  CognitoAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role assumed by authenticated Cognito identity pool users.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
              'ForAnyValue:StringLike':
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': authenticated
      Policies:
        - !If
          - ShouldUseLexV1Bot
          - PolicyName: LexV1BotAccess
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 'lex:PostText'
                    - 'lex:PostContent'
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}'
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}:*'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - ShouldUseLexV2Bot
          - PolicyName: LexV2BotAccess
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 'lex:RecognizeText'
                    - 'lex:RecognizeUtterance'
                    - 'lex:StartConversation'
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - PolicyName: PollySynthesizeSpeechAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'polly:SynthesizeSpeech'
                Resource: '*'
        - !If
          - ShouldEnableLiveChat
          - PolicyName: LiveChatApiInvokeAccess
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 'execute-api:Invoke'
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  CognitoUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role assumed by unauthenticated Cognito identity pool users.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
              'ForAnyValue:StringLike':
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - !If
          - ShouldUseLexV1Bot
          - PolicyName: LexV1BotAccess
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 'lex:PostText'
                    - 'lex:PostContent'
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}'
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}:*'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - ShouldUseLexV2Bot
          - PolicyName: LexV2BotAccess
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 'lex:RecognizeText'
                    - 'lex:RecognizeUtterance'
                    - 'lex:StartConversation'
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - ShouldEnableLiveChat
          - PolicyName: LiveChatApiInvokeAccess
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 'execute-api:Invoke'
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - ShouldForceCognitoLogin
          - PolicyName: DenyUnauthenticatedAccess
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Deny
                  Action:
                    - 'lex:*'
                    - 'execute-api:Invoke'
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  CognitoIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: 'AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment'
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt CognitoAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt CognitoUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito Identity Pool.
    Value: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IdentityPoolId'

  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool.
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool Client.
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Amazon Cognito authentication infrastructure for the customer support system.
  Creates an email sign-in user pool with admin and customer groups, an
  authorization code grant web application client, a client credentials grant
  machine-to-machine client, a resource server that publishes the custom read
  scope, a Cognito hosted UI domain, a post-confirmation Lambda function that
  adds new sign-ups to the customer group, and SSM parameters under
  /app/customersupport/agentcore/ that expose the client IDs, user pool ID,
  OAuth scope, discovery URL, token endpoint, authorize endpoint, and domain for
  backend services.

Parameters:
  CognitoDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: customersupport-auth
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 30
    AllowedPattern: '[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must start with a lowercase letter or number and may contain only
      lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    Description: >-
      Prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain. The AWS account ID and Region are
      appended to guarantee global uniqueness.

  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: customersupport
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '[A-Za-z0-9_-]+'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.
    Description: Identifier of the Cognito resource server that owns the custom scope.

  ReadScopeName:
    Type: String
    Default: read
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '[A-Za-z0-9_]+'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only letters, numbers, and underscores.
    Description: Name of the custom read scope published by the resource server.

  WebAppCallbackURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost:3000/oauth2/callback
    Description: Allowed callback (redirect) URL for the web application client.

  WebAppLogoutURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost:3000/logout
    Description: Allowed logout URL for the web application client.

  AdminGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    Description: Name of the Cognito group with the highest precedence.

  CustomerGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: customer
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    Description: Name of the Cognito group that new sign-ups are added to.

  SsmPathPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: /app/customersupport/agentcore
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 512
    Description: Parameter Store path prefix used for all authentication parameters.

Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-customersupport-users'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
        UnusedAccountValidityDays: 7
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      LambdaConfig:
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GroupName: !Ref AdminGroupName
      Description: Administrators of the customer support system.
      Precedence: 1

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GroupName: !Ref CustomerGroupName
      Description: Customers of the customer support system.
      Precedence: 10

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Identifier: !Ref ResourceServerIdentifier
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-resource-server'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: !Ref ReadScopeName
          ScopeDescription: Read access to customer support resources.

  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-app'
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - !Sub '${ResourceServerIdentifier}/${ReadScopeName}'
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref WebAppCallbackURL
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref WebAppLogoutURL
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  MachineToMachineClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-m2m'
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${ResourceServerIdentifier}/${ReadScopeName}'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  CognitoUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Domain: !Sub '${CognitoDomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'

  PostConfirmationFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Cognito post-confirmation trigger.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoAddUserToGroup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminGetUser
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'

  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Adds newly confirmed Cognito sign-ups to the customer group.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME: !Ref CustomerGroupName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          GROUP_NAME = os.environ.get("CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME", "customer")


          def handler(event, context):
              # Only act when a user confirms their sign-up (not on password reset).
              if event.get("triggerSource") != "PostConfirmation_ConfirmSignUp":
                  return event

              user_pool_id = event["userPoolId"]
              username = event["userName"]

              cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
              cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  GroupName=GROUP_NAME,
              )

              print("Added user %s to group %s in pool %s" % (username, GROUP_NAME, user_pool_id))
              return event

  PostConfirmationFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref PostConfirmationFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn

  SsmUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SsmPathPrefix}/user-pool-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Description: Cognito user pool ID for the customer support system.

  SsmWebClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SsmPathPrefix}/web-client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Description: Cognito app client ID for the authorization code grant web application.

  SsmMachineClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SsmPathPrefix}/m2m-client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineToMachineClient
      Description: Cognito app client ID for the client credentials grant machine-to-machine client.

  SsmOAuthScope:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SsmPathPrefix}/oauth-scope'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${ResourceServerIdentifier}/${ReadScopeName}'
      Description: Custom OAuth 2.0 scope published by the Cognito resource server.

  SsmDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SsmPathPrefix}/discovery-url'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OpenID Connect discovery document URL for the Cognito user pool.

  SsmDomain:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC with two public and two private subnets across two Availability Zones, Internet Gateway, NAT Gateways, and route tables.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.10.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPC'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IGW'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.10.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.10.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.10.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.10.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  ElasticIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EIP1'

  ElasticIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EIP2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt ElasticIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt ElasticIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTable'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway1
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
