final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Simple VPC setup for learning with optional resources controlled by boolean parameters.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: SimpleApp1
    Description: Prefix for naming resources.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet.
  CreateInternetGatewayParam:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create an Internet Gateway.
  CreatePublicSubnetParam:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a public subnet.
  CreateRouteTableParam:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a route table.
  CreateSecurityGroupParam:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a security group.
  AllowedHttpHttpsSource:
    Type: String
    Default: 0.0.0.0/0
    Description: CIDR block allowed for HTTP and HTTPS traffic.

Conditions:
  CreateInternetGateway: !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGatewayParam, 'true']
  CreatePublicSubnet: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnetParam, 'true']
  CreateRouteTable: !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTableParam, 'true']
  CreateSecurityGroup: !Equals [!Ref CreateSecurityGroupParam, 'true']
  CreateRouteAndIgw: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTableParam, 'true']
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGatewayParam, 'true']
  CreateSubnetAndRouteTable: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnetParam, 'true']
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTableParam, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateInternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-public-subnet'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateRouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-public-rt'

  Route:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateRouteAndIgw
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateSubnetAndRouteTable
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP and HTTPS from specified source
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedHttpHttpsSource
          Description: Allow HTTP
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedHttpHttpsSource
          Description: Allow HTTPS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-sg'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
all_security_errors: [AWS-0164] HIGH: Instances in a subnet should not receive a public IP address by default. — Subnet associates public IP address.
latest_error_trivy: [AWS-0164] HIGH: Instances in a subnet should not receive a public IP address by default. — Subnet associates public IP address.

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Landing Zone Hub VPC for multi-account spoke attachment. Creates a VPC with
  public/private subnets across two AZs, NAT gateways, a Transit Gateway with
  DNS and VPN ECMP support, private routes to the TGW for spoke connectivity,
  VPC flow logs to CloudWatch, and VPC endpoints for SSM, EC2 Messages,
  SSM Messages, CloudWatch Logs, and S3.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Environment name prefix used for naming and tagging resources.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    Description: CIDR block for the hub VPC.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24

  TransitGatewayAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534
    Description: Private BGP ASN for the Transit Gateway (64512-65534).

  FlowLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]

Resources:

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Route Tables
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet1NatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet2NatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayAsn
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentName} landing zone hub Transit Gateway'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    DependsOn:
      - PrivateSubnet1NatRoute
      - PrivateSubnet2NatRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw-attachment'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1TgwRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateSubnet2TgwRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/${EnvironmentName}-hub-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn:
      - FlowLogsRole
      - FlowLogsLogGroup
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security Group for Interface VPC Endpoints
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from within the VPC to interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS from within the VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Interface VPC Endpoints (PrivateLink)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ssm'

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ec2messages'

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ssmmessages'

  CloudWatchLogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-logs'

  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-s3'

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs and Exports
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
Outputs:

  VpcId:
    Description: Hub VPC ID
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-id'

  VpcCidr:
    Description: Hub VPC CIDR
    Value: !Ref VpcCidr
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-cidr'

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: Internet Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-igw-id'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1-id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2-id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1-id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2-id'

  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: Public route table ID
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Student Services AgentCore infrastructure with per-domain Cognito user pools and IAM execution roles.

Resources:
  StudentServicesAgentCoreBasePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: StudentServicesAgentCoreBasePolicy
      Description: Base least-privilege policy for Student Services AgentCore execution roles
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore:*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore:*:*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
          - Sid: XRayTracing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
              - xray:GetSamplingRules
              - xray:GetSamplingTargets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMParameterAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*'

  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:

            Statement:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 log-based monitoring controls. Deploys a KMS
  customer managed key, an encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group that receives CloudTrail
  management events, an encrypted SNS notification topic, and one metric filter, CloudWatch
  alarm and CloudWatch Logs Insights query definition for each CIS control (3.1 - 3.14).

Parameters:

  CloudWatchLogsRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    Description: Number of days that CloudTrail management events are retained in the CIS monitoring log group.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653

  AlarmMetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: CISBenchmark
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._/-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only letters, numbers, periods, hyphens, underscores and forward slashes.
    Description: CloudWatch namespace that the CIS metric filters publish into and that the CIS alarms evaluate.

  AlarmNotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 254
    Description: Optional email address to subscribe to the alarm notification topic. Leave blank to skip creating a subscription.

Conditions:

  CreateNotificationSubscription: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmNotificationEmail, '']]

Resources:

  ###########################################################################
  # KMS customer managed key used by the log group and the notification topic
  ###########################################################################

  MonitoringKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CMK used to encrypt the ${AWS::StackName} CIS monitoring log group and alarm notification topic'
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-monitoring-key'
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-monitoring-key-policy'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncryptFrom'
              - 'kms:ReEncryptTo'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowSnsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
            Resource: '*'

  MonitoringKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-cis-monitoring'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref MonitoringKey

  ###########################################################################
  # Encrypted SNS topic that receives every alarm notification
  ###########################################################################

  AlarmNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-alarm-notifications'
      DisplayName: CIS Benchmark Alarm Notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref MonitoringKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-alarm-notifications'

  AlarmNotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-alarm-topic-policy'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowOwnerAccountFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - 'SNS:Publish'
              - 'SNS:GetTopicAttributes'
              - 'SNS:SetTopicAttributes'
              - 'SNS:AddPermission'
              - 'SNS:RemovePermission'
              - 'SNS:DeleteTopic'
              - 'SNS:Subscribe'
              - 'SNS:ListSubscriptionsByTopic'
              - 'SNS:Receive'
            Resource: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'SNS:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:*'

  AlarmNotificationSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateNotificationSubscription
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmNotificationEmail

  ###########################################################################
  # Encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group receiving CloudTrail management events
  ###########################################################################

  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-cloudtrail-management-events'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref CloudWatchLogsRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt MonitoringKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-cloudtrail-management-events'

  ###########################################################################
  # CIS 3.1 - Unauthorized API calls
  ###########################################################################

  UnauthorizedApiCallsMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref AlarmMetricNamespace
          MetricName: UnauthorizedApiCalls
          MetricValue: '1'

  UnauthorizedApiCallsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CIS-3.1-UnauthorizedAPICalls'
      AlarmDescription: 'CIS 3.1 - Unauthorized API calls were detected in CloudTrail management events.'
      Namespace: !Ref AlarmMetricNamespace
      MetricName: UnauthorizedApiCalls
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  UnauthorizedApiCallsQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CIS-3.1-UnauthorizedAPICalls'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, eventSource, eventName, errorCode, errorMessage, awsRegion
        | filter errorCode in ["AccessDenied", "AccessDeniedException", "UnauthorizedOperation", "Client.UnauthorizedOperation"]
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  ###########################################################################
  # CIS 3.2 - Console sign-in without MFA
  ###########################################################################

  ConsoleSignInWithoutMfaMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref AlarmMetricNamespace
          MetricName: ConsoleSignInWithoutMfa
          MetricValue: '1'

  ConsoleSignInWithoutMfaAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CIS-3.2-ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA'
      AlarmDescription: 'CIS 3.2 - A console sign-in without MFA was detected.'
      Namespace: !Ref AlarmMetricNamespace
      MetricName: ConsoleSignInWithoutMfa
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  ConsoleSignInWithoutMfaQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CIS-3.2-ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, responseElements.ConsoleLogin, additionalEventData.MFAUsed
        | filter eventName = "ConsoleLogin" and additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  ###########################################################################
  # CIS 3.3 - Root account usage
  ###########################################################################

  RootAccountUsageMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.userIdentity.type = "Root" && $.userIdentity.invokedBy NOT EXISTS && $.eventType != "AwsServiceEvent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref AlarmMetricNamespace
          MetricName: RootAccountUsage
          MetricValue: '1'

  RootAccountUsageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CIS-3.3-RootAccountUsage'
      AlarmDescription: 'CIS 3.3 - The AWS root account was used.'
      Namespace: !Ref AlarmMetricNamespace
      MetricName: RootAccountUsage
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  RootAccountUsageQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CIS-3.3-RootAccountUsage'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, eventSource, eventName, awsRegion
        | filter userIdentity.type = "Root" and userIdentity.invokedBy not like /.*/ and eventType != "AwsServiceEvent"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  ###########################################################################
  # CIS 3.4 - IAM policy changes
  ###########################################################################

  IamPolicyChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = DeleteGroupPolicy) || ($.eventName = DeleteRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = DeleteUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = PutGroupPolicy) || ($.eventName = PutRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = PutUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = CreatePolicy) || ($.eventName = DeletePolicy) || ($.eventName = CreatePolicyVersion) || ($.eventName = DeletePolicyVersion) || ($.eventName = AttachRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = AttachUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = AttachGroupPolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachGroupPolicy) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref AlarmMetricNamespace
          MetricName: IamPolicyChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  IamPolicyChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CIS-3.4-IAMPolicyChanges'
      AlarmDescription: 'CIS 3.4 - An IAM policy was created, modified, attached or detached.'
      Namespace: !Ref AlarmMetricNamespace
      MetricName: IamPolicyChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  IamPolicyChangesQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CIS-3.4-IAMPolicyChanges'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, eventSource, eventName, requestParameters
        | filter eventName in ["DeleteGroupPolicy", "DeleteRolePolicy", "DeleteUserPolicy", "PutGroupPolicy", "PutRolePolicy", "PutUserPolicy", "CreatePolicy", "DeletePolicy", "CreatePolicyVersion", "DeletePolicyVersion", "AttachRolePolicy", "DetachRolePolicy", "AttachUserPolicy", "DetachUserPolicy", "AttachGroupPolicy", "DetachGroupPolicy"]
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  ###########################################################################
  # CIS 3.5 - CloudTrail configuration changes
  ###########################################################################

  CloudTrailConfigChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = CreateTrail) || ($.eventName = UpdateTrail) || ($.eventName = DeleteTrail) || ($.eventName = StartLogging) || ($.eventName = StopLogging) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref AlarmMetricNamespace
          MetricName: CloudTrailConfigChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  CloudTrailConfigChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CIS-3.5-CloudTrailConfigChanges'
      AlarmDescription: 'CIS 3.5 - The CloudTrail configuration was changed.'
      Namespace: !Ref AlarmMetricNamespace
      MetricName: CloudTrailConfigChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  CloudTrailConfigChangesQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CIS-3.5-CloudTrailConfigChanges'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, eventSource, eventName, requestParameters
        | filter eventName in ["CreateTrail", "UpdateTrail", "DeleteTrail", "StartLogging", "StopLogging"]
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  ###########################################################################
  # CIS 3.6 - Console login failures
  ###########################################################################

  ConsoleLoginFailuresMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = ConsoleLogin) && ($.errorMessage = "Failed authentication") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref AlarmMetricNamespace
          MetricName: ConsoleLoginFailures
          MetricValue: '1'

  ConsoleLoginFailuresAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CIS-3.6-ConsoleLoginFailures'
      AlarmDescription: 'CIS 3.6 - A console login failed authentication.'
      Namespace: !Ref AlarmMetricNamespace
      MetricName: ConsoleLoginFailures
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  ConsoleLoginFailuresQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CIS-3.6-ConsoleLoginFailures'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, responseElements.ConsoleLogin, errorMessage
        | filter eventName = "ConsoleLogin" and errorMessage = "Failed authentication"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  ###########################################################################

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Automated Security Hub deployment across AWS Organization with Control Tower integration

Resources:
  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SecurityHubAutomationRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecurityHubAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/superwerker/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource:
                  - 'arn:aws:iam::*:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                Resource: '*'

  EventBridgeRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SecurityHubEventBridgeRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgeInvokeSsmPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubInitialize}:$DEFAULT'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubAddAccount}:$DEFAULT'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn

  SecurityHubInitialize:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SecurityHubInitialize'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Initialize Security Hub delegated admin and enable audit/log archive accounts
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The IAM role for the Automation execution
        mainSteps:
          - name: InitializeSecurityHub
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import os
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def handler(event, context):
                    region = os.environ['AWS_REGION']
                    ssm = boto3.client('ssm', region_name=region)
                    audit_id = ssm.get_parameter(Name='/superwerker/account_id_audit')['Parameter']['Value']
                    log_archive_id = ssm.get_parameter(Name='/superwerker/account_id_log_archive')['Parameter']['Value']

                    try:
                        sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region)
                        sh.enable_organization_admin_account(AdminAccountId=audit_id)
                    except ClientError:
                        pass

                    enable_account(audit_id, region, is_audit=True)
                    enable_account(log_archive_id, region, is_audit=False)
                    add_member(audit_id, log_archive_id, region)
                    return {'AuditAccountId': audit_id, 'LogArchiveAccountId': log_archive_id}

                def assume_role(account_id, region):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts', region_name=region)
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
                    creds = sts.assume_role(RoleArn=role_arn, RoleSessionName='SecurityHubEnable')['Credentials']
                    return {
                        'aws_access_key_id': creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        'aws_secret_access_key': creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        'aws_session_token': creds['SessionToken']
                    }

                def enable_account(account_id, region, is_audit=False):
                    creds = assume_role(account_id, region)
                    sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **creds)
                    try:
                        sh.enable_security_hub()
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] not in ['InvalidAccessException', 'ResourceConflictException']:
                            raise
                    if is_audit:
                        try:
                            sh.update_organization_configuration(AutoEnable=True)
                        except ClientError:
                            pass

                def add_member(audit_id, target_id, region):
                    creds = assume_role(audit_id, region)
                    sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **creds)
                    org = boto3.client('organizations', region_name=region)
                    email = org.describe_account(AccountId=target_id)['Account']['Email']
                    try:
                        sh.create_members(AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': target_id, 'Email': email}])
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] not in ['ResourceConflictException', 'InvalidAccessException']:
                            raise
                    try:
                        invitations = sh.invite_members(AccountIds=[target_id])['Invitations']
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] != 'ResourceConflictException':
                            raise
                        invitations = []
                    if invitations:
                        inv_id = invitations[0]['InvitationId']
                        creds_target = assume_role(target_id, region)
                        sh_target = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **creds_target)
                        try:
                            sh_target.accept_administrator_invitation(AdministratorId=audit_id, InvitationId=inv_id)
                        except ClientError as e:
                            if e.response['Error']['Code'] != 'ResourceConflictException':
                                raise

  SecurityHubAddAccount:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SecurityHubAddAccount'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enable Security Hub in a new account and add it as a member
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The IAM role for the Automation execution
          AccountId:
            type: String
            description: The AWS account ID to enable and add
        mainSteps:
          - name: AddAccount
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import os
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def handler(event, context):
                    region = os.environ['AWS_REGION']
                    target_id = event['AccountId']
                    ssm = boto3.client('ssm', region_name=region)
                    audit_id = ssm.get_parameter(Name='/superwerker/account_id_audit')['Parameter']['Value']

                    enable_account(target_id, region)
                    add_member(audit_id, target_id, region)
                    return {'AccountId': target_id}

                def assume_role(account_id, region):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts', region_name=region)
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
                    creds = sts.assume_role(RoleArn=role_arn, RoleSessionName='SecurityHubAddAccount')['Credentials']
                    return {
                        'aws_access_key_id': creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        'aws_secret_access_key': creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        'aws_session_token': creds['SessionToken']
                    }

                def enable_account(account_id, region):
                    creds = assume_role(account_id, region)
                    sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **creds)
                    try:
                        sh.enable_security_hub()
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] not in ['InvalidAccessException', 'ResourceConflictException']:
                            raise

                def add_member(audit_id, target_id, region):
                    creds = assume_role(audit_id, region)
                    sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **creds)
                    org = boto3.client('organizations', region_name=region)
                    email = org.describe_account(AccountId=target_id)['Account']['Email']
                    try:
                        sh.create_members(AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': target_id, 'Email': email}])
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] not in ['ResourceConflictException', 'InvalidAccessException']:
                            raise
                    try:
                        invitations = sh.invite_members(AccountIds=[target_id])['Invitations']
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] != 'ResourceConflictException':
                            raise
                        invitations = []
                    if invitations:
                        inv_id = invitations[0]['InvitationId']
                        creds_target = assume_role(target_id, region)
                        sh_target = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **creds_target)
                        try:
                            sh_target.accept_administrator_invitation(AdministratorId=audit_id, InvitationId=inv_id)
                        except ClientError as e:
                            if e.response['Error']['Code'] != 'ResourceConflictException':
                                raise
              Inputs:
                AccountId: '{{ AccountId }}'

  SetupLandingZoneRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SetupLandingZone'
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - AWS Service Event via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - controltower.amazonaws.com
          eventName:
            - SetupLandingZone
          serviceEventDetails:
            setupLandingZoneStatus:
              state:
                - SUCCEEDED
      Targets:
        - Id: SecurityHubInitializeTarget
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubInitialize}:$DEFAULT'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRuleRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub |
            {
              "Parameters": {
                "AutomationAssumeRole": ["${AutomationExecutionRole.Arn}"]
              }
            }

  UpdateLandingZoneRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UpdateLandingZone'
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - AWS Service Event via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - controltower.amazonaws.com
          eventName:
            - UpdateLandingZone
          serviceEventDetails:
            updateLandingZoneStatus:
              state:
                - SUCCEEDED
      Targets:
        - Id: SecurityHubInitializeTarget
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubInitialize}:$DEFAULT'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRuleRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub |
            {
              "Parameters": {
                "AutomationAssumeRole": ["${AutomationExecutionRole.Arn}"]
              }
            }

  CreateManagedAccountRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CreateManagedAccount'
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - AWS Service Event via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - controltower.amazonaws.com
          eventName:
            - CreateManagedAccount
          serviceEventDetails:
            createManagedAccountStatus:
              state:
                - SUCCEEDED
      Targets:
        - Id: SecurityHubAddAccountTarget
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubAddAccount}:$DEFAULT'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRuleRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              accountId: $.detail.serviceEventDetails.createManagedAccountStatus.account.accountId
            InputTemplate: !Sub |
              {
                "Parameters": {
                  "AccountId": ["<accountId>"],
                  "AutomationAssumeRole": ["${AutomationExecutionRole.Arn}"]
                }
              }

Outputs:
  AutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by SSM Automation
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
  EventBridgeRuleRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by EventBridge rules
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeRuleRole.Arn
  SecurityHubInitializeDocument:
    Description: Name of the SSM Automation document for initialization
    Value: !Ref SecurityHubInitialize
  SecurityHubAddAccountDocument:
    Description: Name of the SSM Automation document for adding new accounts
    Value: !Ref SecurityHubAddAccount

Description: Shared IAM roles and supporting resources for use across multiple EKS deployments.

Parameters:

  FindingPublishingFrequency:
    Type: String

Resources:

  KubernetesResourceLogGroup:

  KubernetesHelmLogGroup:

  EKSClusterLogGroup:

  LambdaExecutionRole:

              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"

  LambdaCallerIdentityRole:

                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate

                  - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
                  - cloudtrail:ListTrails

  EKSNodeGroupDescribeRole:

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSNodeGroupDescribeAccess

            Version: "2012-10-17"

              - Sid: EKSDescribeAccess

                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeAddon

                Resource: "*"

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub
        - "${AliasPart}${HashPart}CloudFormationExecutionRole"
        - AliasPart: !If [HasEnvironmentAlias, !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-", ""]
          HashPart: !If [HasEnvironmentHash, !Sub "${EnvironmentHash}-", ""]
      # PermissionsBoundary: !Ref PermissionsBoundary
      Description: CloudFormation execution role used to manage EKS and supporting resources.
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudFormationAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationExecutionAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Comprehensive Amazon SQS test infrastructure: a FIFO queue without a dead
  letter queue, a FIFO queue with a dead letter queue plus its DLQ, a standard
  queue with a dead letter queue (maxReceiveCount 5) plus its DLQ, a separate
  FIFO dead letter queue, a KMS customer managed key used to encrypt every
  queue, and CloudWatch alarms monitoring the queues with actions disabled.

Resources:

  ##########################################################################
  # KMS key used to encrypt every SQS queue in this stack
  ##########################################################################
  QueueEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS customer managed key used to encrypt SQS queues for ${AWS::StackName}"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: sqs-queue-encryption-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPermissionsForAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"

  ##########################################################################
  # FIFO queue WITHOUT a dead letter queue (the "separate" FIFO queue)
  ##########################################################################
  FifoQueueWithoutDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fifo-queue.fifo"
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20

  ##########################################################################
  # FIFO dead letter queue used by the FIFO queue with a DLQ
  ##########################################################################
  FifoQueueDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fifo-queue-dlq.fifo"
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20

  ##########################################################################
  # FIFO queue WITH a dead letter queue
  ##########################################################################
  FifoQueueWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fifo-queue-with-dlq.fifo"
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoQueueDlq.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  ##########################################################################
  # Standard dead letter queue used by the standard queue
  ##########################################################################
  StandardQueueDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-dlq"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20

  ##########################################################################
  # Standard queue WITH a dead letter queue (maxReceiveCount = 5)
  ##########################################################################
  StandardQueueWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-with-dlq"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardQueueDlq.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  ##########################################################################
  # Standalone / separate FIFO dead letter queue
  ##########################################################################
  SeparateFifoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-separate-fifo-dlq.fifo"
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20

  ##########################################################################
  # Alarm 1: Sum of messages sent on the standard queue, breaching on
  #          missing data, threshold 1
  ##########################################################################
  StandardQueueNumberOfMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-number-of-messages-sent-sum"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Sum of NumberOfMessagesSent on ${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-with-dlq is >= 1 (missing data treated as breaching)"
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  ##########################################################################
  # Alarm 2: Average messages sent on the FIFO queue with DLQ using an
  #          anomaly detection band
  ##########################################################################
  FifoQueueWithDlqMessagesSentAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fifo-queue-with-dlq-number-of-messages-sent-anomaly"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Average NumberOfMessagesSent on ${AWS::StackName}-fifo-queue-with-dlq is outside the anomaly detection band"
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          ReturnData: true
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlq.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
        - Id: ad1
          ReturnData: true
          Expression: "ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)"
          Label: NumberOfMessagesSentAnomalyDetectionBand

  ##########################################################################
  # Alarm 3: Maximum sent message size on the standard queue (183500 bytes)
  ##########################################################################
  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-max-sent-message-size"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Maximum SentMessageSize on ${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-with-dlq is >= 183500 bytes"
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  ##########################################################################
  # Alarm 4: Maximum sent message size on the separate FIFO queue
  #          (183500 bytes)
  ##########################################################################
  FifoQueueWithoutDlqSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fifo-queue-max-sent-message-size"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Maximum SentMessageSize on ${AWS::StackName}-fifo-queue is >= 183500 bytes"
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithoutDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  ##########################################################################
  # Alarm 5: Sum of visible messages on the standard DLQ (> 0)
  ##########################################################################
  StandardQueueDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-dlq-messages-visible"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Sum of ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible on ${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-dlq is > 0"
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  ##########################################################################
  # Alarm 6: Sum of visible messages on the FIFO DLQ (> 0)
  ##########################################################################
  FifoQueueDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fifo-queue-dlq-messages-visible"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Sum of ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible on ${AWS::StackName}-fifo-queue-dlq is > 0"
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  ##########################################################################
  # Alarm 7: Maximum age of the oldest message on the standard queue (15)
  ##########################################################################
  StandardQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-oldest-message-age"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Maximum ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage on ${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-with-dlq is >= 15 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  ##########################################################################
  # Alarm 8: Maximum age of the oldest message on the separate FIFO queue (15)
  ##########################################################################
  FifoQueueWithoutDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fifo-queue-oldest-message-age"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Maximum ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage on ${AWS::StackName}-fifo-queue is >= 15 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithoutDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  ##########################################################################
  # Alarm 9: Maximum number of not visible messages on the standard queue
  #          (108000)
  ##########################################################################
  StandardQueueNotVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-messages-not-visible"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Maximum ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible on ${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-with-dlq is >= 108000"
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 108000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  ##########################################################################
  # Alarm 10: Maximum number of not visible messages on the separate FIFO
  #           queue (18000)
  ##########################################################################
  FifoQueueWithoutDlqNotVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fifo-queue-messages-not-visible"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Maximum ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible on ${AWS::StackName}-fifo-queue is >= 18000"
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithoutDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 18000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  ##########################################################################
  # Alarm 11: Maximum age of the oldest message on the standard DLQ (90)
  ##########################################################################
  StandardQueueDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-dlq-oldest-message-age"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Maximum ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage on ${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-dlq is >= 90 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 90
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  ##########################################################################
  # Alarm 12: Synthetic alarm that always evaluates to OK (not breaching)
  ##########################################################################
  SyntheticAlwaysOkAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-synthetic-always-ok"
      AlarmDescription: "Synthetic alarm that always evaluates to OK, even when data points are missing"
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: e1
          ReturnData: true
          Expression: "IF(m1 >= 0, 0, 1)"
          Label: SyntheticAlwaysOk
