final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Private networking infrastructure for a private Red Hat OpenShift on AWS (ROSA)
  cluster using AWS PrivateLink. Creates a private ROSA VPC with one or three
  private subnets, a centralized egress VPC with public/private subnets, NAT and
  Internet gateways, and an AWS Transit Gateway that interconnects both VPCs so
  that ROSA private subnets reach the internet through the egress VPC NAT gateway.
  Optionally creates the Elastic Load Balancing service-linked role and encrypts
  VPC Flow Logs to CloudWatch Logs with a customer managed KMS key.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: ROSA VPC Configuration
        Parameters:
          - RosaVpcCidr
          - AvailabilityZoneCount
          - RosaSubnet1Cidr
          - RosaSubnet2Cidr
          - RosaSubnet3Cidr
      - Label:
          default: Egress VPC Configuration
        Parameters:
          - EgressVpcCidr
          - EgressPublicSubnetCidr
          - EgressPrivateSubnetCidr
      - Label:
          default: Optional Features
        Parameters:
          - CreateElbServiceLinkedRole
          - EnableFlowLogs
    ParameterLabels:
      RosaVpcCidr:
        default: ROSA VPC CIDR
      AvailabilityZoneCount:
        default: Number of Availability Zones
      RosaSubnet1Cidr:
        default: ROSA Private Subnet 1 CIDR
      RosaSubnet2Cidr:
        default: ROSA Private Subnet 2 CIDR
      RosaSubnet3Cidr:
        default: ROSA Private Subnet 3 CIDR
      EgressVpcCidr:
        default: Egress VPC CIDR
      EgressPublicSubnetCidr:
        default: Egress Public Subnet CIDR
      EgressPrivateSubnetCidr:
        default: Egress Private Subnet CIDR
      CreateElbServiceLinkedRole:
        default: Create ELB Service-Linked Role
      EnableFlowLogs:
        default: Enable VPC Flow Logs

Parameters:
  AvailabilityZoneCount:
    Type: String
    Default: "3"
    AllowedValues:
      - "1"
      - "3"
    Description: >-
      Number of Availability Zones (and private ROSA subnets) to create.
      ROSA supports a single-AZ or a three-AZ cluster topology.

  RosaVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
    Description: CIDR block for the private ROSA VPC.

  RosaSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/19
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA private subnet 1.

  RosaSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.32.0/19
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA private subnet 2 (used only when 3 AZs are selected).

  RosaSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.64.0/19
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA private subnet 3 (used only when 3 AZs are selected).

  EgressVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
    Description: CIDR block for the centralized egress VPC.

  EgressPublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
    Description: CIDR block for the egress VPC public subnet (hosts the NAT gateway).

  EgressPrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
    Description: CIDR block for the egress VPC private subnet (hosts the Transit Gateway attachment).

  CreateElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: >-
      When true, creates the Elastic Load Balancing service-linked role required
      by ROSA.

  EnableFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: >-
      When true, enables VPC Flow Logs for both VPCs, delivered to CloudWatch Logs
      and encrypted with a customer managed KMS key.

Conditions:
  IsMultiAz: !Equals
    - !Ref AvailabilityZoneCount
    - "3"

  ShouldCreateElbServiceLinkedRole: !Equals
    - !Ref CreateElbServiceLinkedRole
    - "true"

  EnableFlowLogs: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableFlowLogs
    - "true"

Resources:

  ######################################################################
  # ROSA private VPC
  ######################################################################

  RosaVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-vpc

  RosaPrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-subnet-1

  RosaPrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-subnet-2

  RosaPrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet3Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-subnet-3

  RosaPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-rt

  RosaPrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1

  RosaPrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2

  RosaPrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3

  RosaDefaultRouteToTransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: RosaTransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  ######################################################################
  # Centralized egress VPC
  ######################################################################

  EgressVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-vpc

  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-public-subnet

  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-private-subnet

  EgressInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-igw

  EgressVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressInternetGateway

  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-public-rt

  EgressPublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: EgressVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref EgressInternetGateway

  EgressPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet

  EgressNatGatewayElasticIp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: EgressVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-nat-eip

  EgressNatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: EgressVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EgressNatGatewayElasticIp.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-nat-gateway

  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-private-rt

  EgressPrivateDefaultRouteToNatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: EgressNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref EgressNatGateway

  EgressPrivateRouteToRosaVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: EgressTransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet

  ######################################################################
  # Transit Gateway and attachments
  ######################################################################

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub ${AWS::StackName} centralized egress transit gateway
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-tgw

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-tgw-rt

  RosaTransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1
        - !If
          - IsMultiAz
          - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - IsMultiAz
          - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-tgw-attach-rosa

  EgressTransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-tgw-attach-egress

  RosaTransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  EgressTransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  RosaTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  EgressTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  TransitGatewayDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    DependsOn:
      - TransitGatewayRouteTable
      - EgressTransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      Blackhole: false

  ######################################################################
  # Optional: Elastic Load Balancing service-linked role
  ######################################################################

  ElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Condition: ShouldCreateElbServiceLinkedRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
      Description: Service-linked role for Elastic Load Balancing used by ROSA.

  ######################################################################
  # Optional: VPC Flow Logs encrypted with a customer managed KMS key
  ######################################################################

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: EnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer managed key used to encrypt VPC Flow Logs for ${AWS::StackName}
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: EnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  RosaFlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: EnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}-rosa
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 90

  EgressFlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: EnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}-egress
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 90

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-role
      Description: Allows the VPC Flow Logs service to publish logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsPublishToCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: WriteLogEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RosaFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !GetAtt EgressFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "${RosaFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*"
                  - !Sub "${EgressFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*"

  RosaVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: EnableFlowLogs
    DependsOn:
      - FlowLogsRole
      - RosaFlowLogsLogGroup
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref RosaVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt RosaFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-vpc-flow-log

  EgressVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: EnableFlowLogs
    DependsOn:
      - FlowLogsRole
      - EgressFlowLogsLogGroup
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt EgressFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-vpc-flow-log

Outputs:

  RosaVpcId:
    Description: ID of the private ROSA VPC.
    Value: !Ref RosaVpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-RosaVpcId

  RosaPrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of ROSA private subnet 1.
    Value: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-RosaPrivateSubnet1Id

  RosaPrivateSubnet2Id:
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Description: ID of ROSA private subnet 2.
    Value: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-RosaPrivateSubnet2Id

  RosaPrivateSubnet3Id:
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Description: ID of ROSA private subnet 3.
    Value: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-RosaPrivateSubnet3Id

  RosaPrivateRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the ROSA private route table.
    Value: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-RosaPrivateRouteTableId

  EgressVpcId:
    Description: ID of the centralized egress VPC.
    Value: !Ref EgressVpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EgressVpcId

  EgressPublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the egress VPC public subnet.
    Value: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EgressPublicSubnetId

  EgressPrivateSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the egress VPC private subnet.
    Value: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EgressPrivateSubnetId

  EgressInternetGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the egress VPC internet gateway.
    Value: !Ref EgressInternetGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EgressInternetGatewayId

  EgressNatGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the egress VPC NAT gateway.
    Value: !Ref EgressNatGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EgressNatGatewayId

  EgressNatGatewayPublicIp:
    Description: Public IP address of the egress VPC NAT gateway.
    Value: !Ref EgressNatGatewayElasticIp
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EgressNatGatewayPublicIp

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the transit gateway connecting the ROSA and egress VPCs.
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-TransitGatewayId

  TransitGatewayRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the transit gateway route table.
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-TransitGatewayRouteTableId

  RosaTransitGatewayAttachmentId:
    Description: ID of the transit gateway attachment for the ROSA VPC.
    Value: !Ref RosaTransitGatewayAttachment
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-RosaTransitGatewayAttachmentId

  EgressTransitGatewayAttachmentId:
    Description: ID of the transit gateway attachment for the egress VPC.
    Value: !Ref EgressTransitGatewayAttachment
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EgressTransitGatewayAttachmentId

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: PCI DSS remediation prerequisites and nine AWS Systems Manager Automation documents for automated remediation of specific PCI DSS controls.

Parameters:
  CloudTrailLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/cloudtrail/pci-dss
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that CloudTrail will publish to.
  CloudTrailLogGroupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1827
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Retention in days for the CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log group (1827 days = 5 years).
  KmsKeyAliasName:
    Type: String
    Default: alias/pci-dss-cloudtrail
    Description: Alias name (must start with "alias/") for the PCI DSS KMS CMK.

Resources:

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite 1: CloudWatch Logs log group for CloudTrail
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroupRetentionDays

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite 2: KMS Customer Master Key with rotation and root key policy
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PciKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: PCI DSS customer managed key for CloudTrail and remediation workloads.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  PciKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Ref KmsKeyAliasName
      TargetKeyId: !Ref PciKmsKey

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite 3: IAM role assumed by the SSM Automation documents
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AutomationAssumeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: PCI-DSS-AutomationAssumeRole
      Description: IAM role assumed by PCI DSS SSM Automation documents.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSsmAutomationAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite 4: IAM role for CloudTrail -> CloudWatch Logs integration
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: PCI-DSS-CloudTrail-CloudWatchLogsRole
      Description: IAM role used by CloudTrail to deliver trail events to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AWSCloudTrailCreateLogStream
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn}:log-stream:*'
              - Sid: AWSCloudTrailCreateLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
              - Sid: AWSCloudTrailDescribeLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                  - logs:TagLogGroup
                  - logs:UntagLogGroup
                Resource: '*'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 1: Encrypt CloudTrail trail with KMS + CloudWatch Logs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EncryptCloudTrailTrailDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-EncryptCloudTrailTrail
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Encrypts a CloudTrail trail with a provided KMS key and integrates it with CloudWatch Logs.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail to remediate.
          KmsKeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS key ID or ARN used to encrypt the trail's log files.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group to receive trail events.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role CloudTrail uses to deliver events to CloudWatch Logs.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: IAM role that the automation document assumes.
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrailWithKmsAndCloudWatch
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              KmsKeyId: '{{ KmsKeyId }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: TrailArn
                Selector: $.TrailARN
                Type: String
              - Name: UpdatedTrailName
                Selector: $.Name
                Type: String

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 2: Enable KMS key rotation
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EnableKmsKeyRotationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-EnableKmsKeyRotation
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables automatic key rotation for a specified KMS customer managed key.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          KeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS key ID or ARN whose rotation should be enabled.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: IAM role that the automation document assumes.
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableKeyRotation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: '{{ KeyId }}'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 3: Integrate CloudTrail with CloudWatch Logs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatchDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-IntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatchLogs
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Integrates a CloudTrail trail with a CloudWatch Logs log group using the provided role.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail to integrate.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group to receive trail events.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role CloudTrail uses to deliver events to CloudWatch Logs.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: IAM role that the automation document assumes.
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrailCloudWatchLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: TrailArn
                Selector: $.TrailARN
                Type: String

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 4: Update IAM account password policy
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UpdateIamPasswordPolicyDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-UpdateIamPasswordPolicy
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Updates the account IAM password policy to enforce PCI DSS compliant settings.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: IAM role that the automation document assumes.
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireSymbols: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
              ExpirePasswords: true
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24
              HardExpiry: true

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 5: Enable log file validation (plus multi-region/CWL)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EnableCloudTrailLogFileValidationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-EnableCloudTrailLogFileValidation
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables CloudTrail log file validation, enforces multi-region trails, and ensures CloudWatch Logs integration.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail to remediate.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group to receive trail events.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role CloudTrail uses to deliver events to CloudWatch Logs.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: IAM role that the automation document assumes.
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableLogFileValidationAndMultiRegion
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: TrailArn
                Selector: $.TrailARN
                Type: String

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 6: Revoke all rules on a default security group
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Revokes all inbound and outbound rules on a specified default security group.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: Security group ID that will have all ingress and egress rules revoked.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: IAM role that the automation document assumes.
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeAllRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: revoke_all_rules
              InputPayload:
                GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
                Region: '{{ global:REGION }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def revoke_all_rules(events, context):
                    group_id = events['GroupId']
                    region = events.get('Region')
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2', region_name=region)

                    response = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[group_id])
                    sg = response['SecurityGroups'][0]

                    ip_permissions = sg.get('IpPermissions', [])
                    ip_permissions_egress = sg.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])

                    if ip_permissions:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                            GroupId=group_id,
                            IpPermissions=ip_permissions
                        )
                    if ip_permissions_egress:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(
                            GroupId=group_id,
                            IpPermissions=ip_permissions_egress
                        )

                    return {
                        'Status': 'Success',
                        'GroupId': group_id,
                        'IngressRevoked': len(ip_permissions),
                        'EgressRevoked': len(ip_permissions_egress)
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 7: Delete a specified security group
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DeleteSecurityGroupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-DeleteSecurityGroup
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Deletes a specified security group.

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Releases an unused Elastic IP address given its allocation ID.

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation Document 9: Remove CodeBuild credential environment variables
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RemoveCodeBuildProjectCredentialsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-RemoveCodeBuildProjectCredentials
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Updates a CodeBuild project to remove AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variables.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CodeBuild project to remediate.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: IAM role that the automation document assumes.
        mainSteps:
          - name: RemoveCredentialEnvironmentVariables
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: remove_credentials
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: '{{ ProjectName }}'
                Region: '{{ global:REGION }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                FORBIDDEN_NAMES = ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')

                def remove_credentials(events, context):
                    project_name = events['ProjectName']
                    region = events.get('Region')
                    codebuild = boto3.client('codebuild', region_name=region)

                    response = codebuild.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])
                    projects = response.get('projects', [])
                    if not projects:
                        raise Exception(
                            'CodeBuild project not found: {}'.format(project_name)
                        )

                    project = projects[0]
                    environment = project.get('environment', {})
                    env_vars = environment.get('environmentVariables', [])

                    removed = [
                        var['name'] for var in env_vars
                        if var.get('name') in FORBIDDEN_NAMES
                    ]

                    if not removed:
                        return {
                            'Status': 'NoChange',
                            'ProjectName': project_name,
                            'RemovedVariables': []
                        }

                    filtered = [
                        var for var in env_vars
                        if var.get('name') not in FORBIDDEN_NAMES
                    ]

                    new_environment = dict(environment)
                    new_environment['environmentVariables'] = filtered

                    codebuild.update_project(
                        name=project_name,
                        environment=new_environment
                    )

                    return {
                        'Status': 'Success',
                        'ProjectName': project_name,
                        'RemovedVariables': removed
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CDK bootstrap environment with file and container assets, KMS encryption, and IAM roles.
Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: hnb659fds
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{1,10}$'
    Description: Short qualifier to distinguish bootstrapped resources.
  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "21"
    Description: CDK bootstrap version.
  FileAssetsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Name for the S3 bucket. Leave empty to auto-generate.
  FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ARN of existing KMS key to use for S3 bucket encryption. Leave empty to create a new key.
  FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Alias for the new KMS key. Leave empty for default alias (alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-assets).
  ContainerAssetsRepositoryName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Name for the ECR repository. Leave empty to auto-generate.
  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: Comma-separated list of AWS account IDs allowed to assume publishing and deployment roles. Leave empty to use the current account.
  TrustedAccountsForLookup:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: Comma-separated list of AWS account IDs allowed to assume the lookup role. Leave empty to use the current account.
  CloudFormationExecutionPolicies:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: Comma-separated list of managed policy ARNs for the CloudFormation execution role. Leave empty to use AdministratorAccess.
Conditions:
  HasFileAssetsBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketName, ""]]
  HasFileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId, ""]]
  CreateNewKmsKey: !Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId, ""]
  HasFileAssetsBucketKmsKeyAlias: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyAlias, ""]]
  HasContainerAssetsRepositoryName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ContainerAssetsRepositoryName, ""]]
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Join [",", !Ref TrustedAccounts], ""]]
  HasTrustedAccountsForLookup: !Not [!Equals [!Join [",", !Ref TrustedAccountsForLookup], ""]]
  HasCloudFormationExecutionPolicies: !Not [!Equals [!Join [",", !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies], ""]]
Resources:
  FileAssetsBucketKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateNewKmsKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for CDK bootstrap ${Qualifier} file assets"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-key"
  FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateNewKmsKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !If [HasFileAssetsBucketKmsKeyAlias, !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyAlias, !Sub "alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-assets"]
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKey
  FileAssetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If [HasFileAssetsBucketName, !Ref FileAssetsBucketName, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If [HasFileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId, !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId, !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKey]
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: CleanupOldAssets
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365
            NoncurrentVersionExpirationInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
  FileAssetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FileAssetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Sid: ForceHTTPS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${FileAssetBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false
  ContainerAssetsRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !If [HasContainerAssetsRepositoryName, !Ref ContainerAssetsRepositoryName, !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"]
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [
              {
                "rulePriority": 1,
                "description": "Keep only 10 images",
                "selection": {
                  "tagStatus": "any",
                  "countType": "imageCountMoreThan",
                  "countNumber": 10
                },
                "action": {
                  "type": "expire"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If [HasTrustedAccounts, !Ref TrustedAccounts, [!Ref "AWS::AccountId"]]
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FilePublishingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetObjectVersionTagging
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:PutObjectVersionTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersionTagging
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FileAssetBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If [HasFileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId, !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId, !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketKmsKey.Arn]
  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If [HasTrustedAccounts, !Ref TrustedAccounts, [!Ref "AWS::AccountId"]]
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImagePublishingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                Resource: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn
  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If [HasTrustedAccountsForLookup, !Ref TrustedAccountsForLookup, [!Ref "AWS::AccountId"]]
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSCloudFormationReadOnlyAccess"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LookupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                Resource: "*"
  DeploymentActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If [HasTrustedAccounts, !Ref TrustedAccounts, [!Ref "AWS::AccountId"]]
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeploymentActionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:SetStackPolicy
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FileAssetBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: "*"
  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If [HasCloudFormationExecutionPolicies, !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies, [!Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"]]
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FileAssetBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If [HasFileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId, !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId, !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketKmsKey.Arn]
  BootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for Elastic Beanstalk Blue-Green deployment.

Parameters:
  CreateNewResources:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: true
    Description: Set to true to create a new Elastic Beanstalk application and blue environment. Set to false to use an existing application and environment.
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyEBApplication
    Description: Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application. If CreateNewResources is false, this must be an existing application.
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyEBEnvironment
    Description: Name of the blue Elastic Beanstalk environment. If CreateNewResources is false, this must be an existing environment.
  CreateGreenEnvironment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: false
    Description: Set to true to create a temporary green environment for blue-green deployment.
  GreenEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyEBGreenEnvironment
    Description: Name of the green Elastic Beanstalk environment.
  SolutionStackName:
    Type: String
    Default: "64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v4.0.0 running Python 3.11"
    Description: The Elastic Beanstalk solution stack to use.
  SampleApplicationBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: elasticbeanstalk-samples
    Description: S3 bucket containing the sample application. If using the default bucket, the region will be appended.
  SampleApplicationKey:
    Type: String
    Default: python-sample-v1.zip
    Description: S3 key of the sample application.

Conditions:
  CreateNewResources: !Equals [!Ref CreateNewResources, "true"]
  UseExistingResources: !Equals [!Ref CreateNewResources, "false"]
  CreateGreenEnvironment: !Equals [!Ref CreateGreenEnvironment, "true"]
  CreateAnyEnvironment: !Or
    - !Condition CreateNewResources
    - !Condition CreateGreenEnvironment
  IsDefaultSampleBucket: !Equals [!Ref SampleApplicationBucket, "elasticbeanstalk-samples"]

Resources:
  EBInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateAnyEnvironment
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWebTier"
      Path: /

  EBInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Condition: CreateAnyEnvironment
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref EBInstanceRole

  EBServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateAnyEnvironment
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkService"
      Path: /

  EBApplication:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application
    Condition: CreateNewResources
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Elastic Beanstalk application for blue-green deployment

  EBApplicationVersionNew:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Condition: CreateNewResources
    DependsOn: EBApplication
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Sample application version for new application
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !If [IsDefaultSampleBucket, !Sub "${SampleApplicationBucket}-${AWS::Region}", !Ref SampleApplicationBucket]
        S3Key: !Ref SampleApplicationKey

  EBApplicationVersionExisting:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Condition: UseExistingResources
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Sample application version for existing application
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !If [IsDefaultSampleBucket, !Sub "${SampleApplicationBucket}-${AWS::Region}", !Ref SampleApplicationBucket]
        S3Key: !Ref SampleApplicationKey

  BlueEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Condition: CreateNewResources
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Ref EnvironmentName
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref EBApplicationVersionNew
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref EBInstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !Ref EBServiceRole

  GreenEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Condition: CreateGreenEnvironment
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Ref GreenEnvironmentName
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !If [CreateNewResources, !Ref EBApplicationVersionNew, !Ref EBApplicationVersionExisting]
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref EBInstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !Ref EBServiceRole

Outputs:
  BlueEnvironmentURL:
    Condition: CreateNewResources
    Description: URL of the blue Elastic Beanstalk environment
    Value: !GetAtt BlueEnvironment.EndpointURL
  GreenEnvironmentURL:
    Condition: CreateGreenEnvironment
    Description: URL of the green Elastic Beanstalk environment
    Value: !GetAtt GreenEnvironment.EndpointURL
  ApplicationName:
    Description: Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application
    Value: !Ref ApplicationName

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS Service Catalog environment for ML workshop with admin and end-user portfolios, products, launch roles, and end-user IAM roles.

Parameters:
  RootS3Url:
    Type: String
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
    Description: Root S3 URL pointing to the location of the nested CloudFormation templates.
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: user-1
    Description: Prefix for environment resources.

Resources:
  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-AdminPortfolio"
      ProviderName: ML Workshop
      Description: Portfolio for ML Workshop admin team
      AcceptLanguage: en

  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-EndUserPortfolio"
      ProviderName: ML Workshop
      Description: Portfolio for ML Workshop end users
      AcceptLanguage: en

  LaunchRoleVPC:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-LaunchRoleVPC"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  LaunchRoleIAM:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-LaunchRoleIAM"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  LaunchRoleDataExchange:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-LaunchRoleDataExchange"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  LaunchRoleInfrastructure:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-LaunchRoleInfrastructure"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  LaunchRoleApplication:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-LaunchRoleApplication"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  LaunchRoleSageMaker:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-LaunchRoleSageMaker"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  LaunchRoleThirdPartyML:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-LaunchRoleThirdPartyML"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  VPCProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-VPCProduct"
      Owner: ML Workshop
      Description: VPC with private subnets and endpoints
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-v1"
          Description: VPC template
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "${RootS3Url}/vpc.yaml"
          Type: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      AcceptLanguage: en

  IAMProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-IAMProduct"
      Owner: ML Workshop
      Description: IAM roles with KMS keys and S3 buckets
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-v1"
          Description: IAM template
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "${RootS3Url}/iam.yaml"
          Type: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      AcceptLanguage: en

  DataExchangeProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-DataExchangeProduct"
      Owner: ML Workshop
      Description: AWS Data Exchange product
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-v1"
          Description: Data Exchange template
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "${RootS3Url}/data-exchange.yaml"
          Type: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      AcceptLanguage: en

  InfrastructureProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-InfrastructureProduct"
      Owner: ML Workshop
      Description: Infrastructure product
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-v1"
          Description: Infrastructure template
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "${RootS3Url}/infrastructure.yaml"
          Type: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      AcceptLanguage: en

  ApplicationProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-ApplicationProduct"
      Owner: ML Workshop
      Description: Application product
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-v1"
          Description: Application template
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "${RootS3Url}/application.yaml"
          Type: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      AcceptLanguage: en

  SageMakerNotebookProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-SageMakerNotebookProduct"
      Owner: ML Workshop
      Description: SageMaker notebook instance
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-v1"
          Description: SageMaker notebook template
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "${RootS3Url}/sagemaker-notebook.yaml"
          Type: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      AcceptLanguage: en

  ThirdPartyMLProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-ThirdPartyMLProduct"
      Owner: ML Workshop
      Description: Third-party ML model
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-v1"
          Description: Third-party ML template
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "${RootS3Url}/third-party-ml.yaml"
          Type: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      AcceptLanguage: en

  AdminVPCProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VPCProduct
      AcceptLanguage: en

  AdminIAMProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IAMProduct
      AcceptLanguage: en

  AdminDataExchangeProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct
      AcceptLanguage: en

  AdminInfrastructureProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct
      AcceptLanguage: en

  EndUserApplicationProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct
      AcceptLanguage: en

  EndUserSageMakerNotebookProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerNotebookProduct
      AcceptLanguage: en

  EndUserThirdPartyMLProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyMLProduct
      AcceptLanguage: en

  VPCLaunchRoleConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VPCProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt LaunchRoleVPC.Arn
      Description: Launch role for VPC product
      AcceptLanguage: en

  IAMLaunchRoleConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IAMProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt LaunchRoleIAM.Arn
      Description: Launch role for IAM product
      AcceptLanguage: en

  DataExchangeLaunchRoleConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt LaunchRoleDataExchange.Arn
      Description: Launch role for Data Exchange product
      AcceptLanguage: en

  InfrastructureLaunchRoleConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt LaunchRoleInfrastructure.Arn
      Description: Launch role for Infrastructure product
      AcceptLanguage: en

  ApplicationLaunchRoleConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt LaunchRoleApplication.Arn
      Description: Launch role for Application product
      AcceptLanguage: en

  SageMakerNotebookLaunchRoleConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerNotebookProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt LaunchRoleSageMaker.Arn
      Description: Launch role for SageMaker Notebook product
      AcceptLanguage: en

  ThirdPartyMLLaunchRoleConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyMLProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt LaunchRoleThirdPartyML.Arn
      Description: Launch role for Third-party ML product
      AcceptLanguage: en

  LeadEndUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-LeadEndUserRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ServiceCatalogReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMParameterAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*"
        - PolicyName: S3TaggedObjectAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:ExistingObjectTag/Provisioning: "true"

  DeveloperEndUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-DeveloperEndUserRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ServiceCatalogReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMParameterAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*"
        - PolicyName: S3TaggedObjectAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:ExistingObjectTag/Provisioning: "true"

  LeadEndUserToAdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioPrincipalAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      PrincipalARN: !GetAtt LeadEndUserRole.Arn
      PrincipalType: IAM
      AcceptLanguage: en

  DeveloperEndUserToEndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioPrincipalAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      PrincipalARN: !GetAtt DeveloperEndUserRole.Arn
      PrincipalType: IAM
      AcceptLanguage: en

Outputs:
  LeadEndUserSwitchRoleURL:
    Description: Switch role URL for lead end user
    Value: !Sub "https://signin.aws.amazon.com/switchrole?roleName=${LeadEndUserRole}&account=${AWS::AccountId}&displayName=LeadEndUser"
  DeveloperEndUserSwitchRoleURL:
    Description: Switch role URL for developer end user
    Value: !Sub "https://signin.aws.amazon.com/switchrole?roleName=${DeveloperEndUserRole}&account=${AWS::AccountId}&displayName=DeveloperEndUser"
