final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Dual-stack (IPv4/IPv6) environment network stack. Provisions a VPC with three
  public subnets and two private subnets, an internet gateway, an egress-only
  internet gateway, an optional NAT gateway, public and private network ACLs,
  a cluster placement group, and a DHCP options set. The Environment parameter
  selects the VPC, subnet CIDR ranges and DHCP domain name used by the stack.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Environment this network is built for. Selects the VPC, subnet CIDR ranges
      and the DHCP domain name from the template mappings.
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: production

  DeployNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      'true' deploys a NAT gateway (with an Elastic IP) in a public subnet to
      provide IPv4 egress for the private subnets. 'false' skips the NAT gateway
      entirely, which is appropriate when a bastion host provides that function.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref DeployNatGateway, 'true']

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: 10.10.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: 10.10.0.0/20
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: 10.10.16.0/20
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: 10.10.32.0/20
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: 10.10.48.0/20
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: 10.10.64.0/20
      DomainName: staging.internal
    production:
      VpcCidr: 10.20.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: 10.20.0.0/20
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: 10.20.16.0/20
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: 10.20.32.0/20
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: 10.20.48.0/20
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: 10.20.64.0/20
      DomainName: production.internal

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr]
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet1Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 64, 8]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet2Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 64, 8]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet3Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 64, 8]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-subnet-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet1Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 64, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet2Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 64, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRouteIpv6EgressOnly:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway

  PrivateRouteIpv4Nat:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-nat-gateway'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-nacl'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicNetworkAclInboundHttpIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicNetworkAclInboundHttpsIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  PublicNetworkAclInboundSshIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22

  PublicNetworkAclInboundVpnIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 130
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1194
        To: 1194

  PublicNetworkAclInboundEphemeralIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 140
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  PublicNetworkAclInboundHttpIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 150
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: ::/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicNetworkAclInboundHttpsIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 160
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: ::/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  PublicNetworkAclInboundSshIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 170
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: ::/0
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22

  PublicNetworkAclInboundVpnIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 180
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: ::/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1194
        To: 1194

  PublicNetworkAclInboundEphemeralIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 190
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: ::/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  PublicNetworkAclInboundIcmpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: 58
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: ::/0
      Icmp:
        Type: -1
        Code: -1

  PublicNetworkAclOutboundAllIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0

  PublicNetworkAclOutboundAllIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: ::/0

  PublicSubnet1NetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2NetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnet3NetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  PrivateNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-nacl'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateNetworkAclInboundAllIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0

  PrivateNetworkAclInboundAllIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: ::/0

  PrivateNetworkAclOutboundAllIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0

  PrivateNetworkAclOutboundAllIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: ::/0

  PrivateSubnet1NetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2NetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  ClusterPlacementGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::PlacementGroup
    Properties:
      Strategy: cluster
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-cluster-placement-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DHCPOptions:
    Type: AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions
    Properties:
      DomainName: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, DomainName]
      DomainNameServers:
        - AmazonProvidedDNS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-dhcp-options'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      DhcpOptionsId: !Ref DHCPOptions

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the environment VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidr:
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block of the environment VPC.
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'

  VpcIpv6CidrBlock:
    Description: IPv6 CIDR block assigned to the environment VPC.
    Value: !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcIpv6CidrBlock'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 1 (first availability zone).
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 2 (first availability zone).
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PublicSubnet3Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 3 (additional availability zone).
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet3Id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 1 (application tier).
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 2 (data tier).
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'

  PrivateRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the private route table used by both private subnets.
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTableId'

  EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the egress-only internet gateway attached to the VPC.
    Value: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId'

  PrivateNetworkAclId:
    Description: ID of the network ACL applied to the private subnets.
    Value: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateNetworkAclId'

  ClusterPlacementGroupName:
    Description: Name of the cluster placement group for tightly coupled workloads.
    Value: !Ref ClusterPlacementGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClusterPlacementGroupName'

  DHCPOptionsId:
    Description: ID of the DHCP options set associated with the environment VPC.
    Value: !Ref DHCPOptions
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DHCPOptionsId'

  NatGatewayId:
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway providing IPv4 egress for the private subnets.
    Value: !Ref NatGateway

      a new VPC, subnet, and SageMaker Studio domain are created.

      existing SageMaker Studio domain. Required if SageMakerDomainId is provided.
  SageMakerDomainSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >
      Optional. Comma-separated list of subnet IDs associated with the existing
      SageMaker Studio domain. Not used when creating a new domain.
  MLOpsUserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-engineer
    Description: The name of the SageMaker Studio user profile for the MLOps engineer.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be alphanumeric and hyphens, 1-63 characters.

    Type: String
    Default: mlops-studio-domain

          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']

      Tags:
        - Key: Name

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet

                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob

                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Data Master IAM roles for data pipeline from ingestion through analytics

Parameters:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of existing KMS key used for raw data encryption
  TargetAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Target AWS Account ID to scope STS AssumeRole policies
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID.

  DMSKinesisRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'dm-${AWS::StackName}-DMSKinesisRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DMSKinesisAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                  - kinesis:ListStreams
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  EventBridgePipesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'dm-${AWS::StackName}-EventBridgePipesRole'

        Version: '2012-10-17'

          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pipes.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

      RoleName: !Sub 'dm-${AWS::StackName}-FirehoseAccessRole'

        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component

                  - kinesis:ListShards

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudWatch composite alarms for cross-region failover application health monitoring

Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: Remittance
    Description: Name of the existing API Gateway API.
  ApiStage:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Stage name of the existing API Gateway API.
  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: GetRemittances
    Description: Name of the GetRemittances Lambda function.
  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: CreateRemittance
    Description: Name of the CreateRemittance Lambda function.
  RDSInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: dbcluster1-instance1
    Description: Identifier of the existing RDS instance.

Resources:
  Api4xxAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "API Gateway 4XX Errors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when API Gateway 4XX errors average above 0 over 300 seconds"
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref ApiStage

  Api5xxAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "API Gateway 5XX Errors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when API Gateway 5XX errors average above 1 over 60 seconds"
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref ApiStage

  ApiLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "API Gateway Latency"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when API Gateway latency is at or above 10000 ms over 300 seconds"
      MetricName: Latency
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref ApiStage

  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "GetRemittances Errors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when GetRemittances errors exceed 0 over 60 seconds"
      MetricName: Errors
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName

  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "GetRemittances Invocations"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when GetRemittances invocations exceed 2 over 60 seconds"
      MetricName: Invocations
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName

  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "GetRemittances Duration"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when GetRemittances average duration is at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds"
      MetricName: Duration
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName

  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "CreateRemittance Errors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when CreateRemittance errors exceed 0 over 60 seconds"
      MetricName: Errors
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName

  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "CreateRemittance Invocations"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when CreateRemittance invocations exceed 2 over 60 seconds"
      MetricName: Invocations
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName

  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "CreateRemittance Duration"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when CreateRemittance average duration is at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds"
      MetricName: Duration
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName

  RdsCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS CPU Utilization"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS CPU utilization is at or above 70 percent over 300 seconds"
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RdsDbConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS Database Connections"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS database connections are at or above 100 over 300 seconds"
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS Deadlocks"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS deadlocks are at or above 10 over 300 seconds"
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RdsNetworkTransmitAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS Network Transmit Throughput"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS network transmit throughput is at or above 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds"
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RdsNetworkReceiveAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS Network Receive Throughput"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS network receive throughput is at or above 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds"
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RdsQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS Queries"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS queries are at or above 100 over 300 seconds"
      MetricName: Queries
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RdsDiskQueueAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS Disk Queue Depth"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS disk queue depth is at or above 50 over 300 seconds"
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RdsReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS Read Latency"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS read latency is at or above 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds"
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RdsWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS Write Latency"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS write latency is at or above 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds"
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "API Gateway Health"
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm for API Gateway health"
      AlarmRule: !Sub 'OR(ALARM("${Api4xxAlarm}"), ALARM("${Api5xxAlarm}"), ALARM("${ApiLatencyAlarm}"))'

  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "Lambda Health"
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm for Lambda health"
      AlarmRule: !Sub 'OR(ALARM("${GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm}"), ALARM("${CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm}"), ALARM("${GetRemittancesDurationAlarm}"), ALARM("${CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm}"))'

  RdsHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS Health"
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm for RDS health"
      AlarmRule: !Sub 'OR(ALARM("${RdsCpuAlarm}"), ALARM("${RdsDbConnectionsAlarm}"), ALARM("${RdsDeadlocksAlarm}"), ALARM("${RdsNetworkTransmitAlarm}"), ALARM("${RdsNetworkReceiveAlarm}"), ALARM("${RdsQueriesAlarm}"), ALARM("${RdsDiskQueueAlarm}"), ALARM("${RdsReadLatencyAlarm}"), ALARM("${RdsWriteLatencyAlarm}"))'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Admin Suite QuickSight monitoring and data extraction pipeline. Creates seven AWS Glue
  jobs (five Python shell jobs and two Spark ETL jobs), seven scheduled Glue triggers, a
  private and retained S3 output bucket, five CloudWatch metric streams, five Kinesis Data
  Firehose delivery streams, and a single shared IAM role.

Parameters:
  ScriptsBucketName:
    Type: String
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 63
    Description: >-
      Name of the existing S3 bucket that stores the Glue job scripts (without the
      s3:// prefix).
  ScriptsBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: glue-scripts
    Description: Prefix (folder path) inside the scripts bucket where the Glue scripts are stored.
  GlueScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
    Description: Cron expression used by every scheduled Glue trigger (default is every 3 hours).

Resources:

  AdminSuiteS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced

  AdminSuiteIAMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}"
      Description: >-
        Shared role for the Admin Suite Glue jobs, Firehose delivery streams and CloudWatch
        metric streams.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSharedServiceAssumption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AdminSuiteServicePermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:*
                  - glue:*
                  - s3:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - firehose:*
                  - iam:*
                Resource: "*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Python shell Glue jobs (Glue 3.0, Python 3.9)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Description: Extracts QuickSight asset access details.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptsBucketName}/${ScriptsBucketPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py"
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--account_id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"

  GlueJobAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Description: Extracts QuickSight asset metadata.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptsBucketName}/${ScriptsBucketPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py"
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--account_id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"

  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Description: Extracts QuickSight folder structure information.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptsBucketName}/${ScriptsBucketPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py"
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--account_id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"

  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Description: Extracts QuickSight Q topic metadata.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptsBucketName}/${ScriptsBucketPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py"
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--account_id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"

  GlueJobQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Description: Extracts QuickSight Q object access details.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptsBucketName}/${ScriptsBucketPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py"
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--account_id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Spark ETL Glue jobs (Glue 5.0, G.1X x 2 workers)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GlueJobDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Description: Extracts QuickSight dataset properties.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptsBucketName}/${ScriptsBucketPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--account_id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"

  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Description: Extracts QuickSight data source properties.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptsBucketName}/${ScriptsBucketPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--account_id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scheduled Glue triggers (every 3 hours)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GlueTriggerAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_assets_access
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref GlueScheduleExpression
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsAccess

  GlueTriggerAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref GlueScheduleExpression
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsMetadata

  GlueTriggerFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref GlueScheduleExpression
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderAssets

  GlueTriggerQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref GlueScheduleExpression
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQMetadata

  GlueTriggerQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_q_access
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_q_access every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref GlueScheduleExpression
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQAccess

  GlueTriggerDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref GlueScheduleExpression
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDsProperties

  GlueTriggerDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref GlueScheduleExpression
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDatasourceProperties

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Kinesis Data Firehose DirectPut delivery streams
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FirehoseIngestionStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-firehose-ingestion
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteS3Bucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
        Prefix: quicksight/ingestion/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 1
        CloudWatchLoggingOptions:
          Enabled: false

  FirehoseVisualStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-firehose-visual
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteS3Bucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
        Prefix: quicksight/visual/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 1
        CloudWatchLoggingOptions:
          Enabled: false

  FirehoseSpiceStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-firehose-spice
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteS3Bucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
        Prefix: quicksight/spice/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 1
        CloudWatchLoggingOptions:
          Enabled: false

  FirehoseIndexStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-firehose-index
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteS3Bucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
        Prefix: quicksight/index/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 1
        CloudWatchLoggingOptions:
          Enabled: false

  FirehoseActionStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-firehose-action
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteS3Bucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
        Prefix: quicksight/action/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 1
        CloudWatchLoggingOptions:
          Enabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch metric streams (JSON output)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MetricStreamIngestion:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-metric-stream-ingestion
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseIngestionStream.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - IngestionRowCount
            - IngestionLatency
            - IngestionInvocationCount
            - IngestionErrorCount

  MetricStreamVisual:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-metric-stream-visual
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseVisualStream.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - VisualLoadTime
            - DashboardViewLoadTime
            - DashboardViewCount
            - VisualLoadErrorCount

  MetricStreamSpice:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-metric-stream-spice
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseSpiceStream.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - SPICECapacityLimitInMB
            - SPICECapacityConsumedInMB

  MetricStreamIndex:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-metric-stream-index
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseIndexStream.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - QuickIndexDocumentCount
            - QuickIndexExtractedTextSize

  MetricStreamAction:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-metric-stream-action
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseActionStream.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - ActionInvocationError
            - ActionInvocationCount

Outputs:
  AdminSuiteBucketName:
    Description: Name of the private S3 bucket that stores all extracted administration data.
    Value: !Ref AdminSuiteS3Bucket

  AdminSuiteBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the private S3 bucket that stores all extracted administration data.
    Value: !GetAtt AdminSuiteS3Bucket.Arn

  AdminSuiteRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared IAM role used by Glue, Firehose and CloudWatch metric streams.
    Value: !GetAtt AdminSuiteIAMRole.Arn

  GlueJobAssetsAccessName:
    Description: Name of the QuickSight asset access extraction Glue job.
    Value: !Ref GlueJobAssetsAccess

  GlueJobAssetsMetadataName:
    Description: Name of the QuickSight asset metadata extraction Glue job.
    Value: !Ref GlueJobAssetsMetadata

  GlueJobFolderAssetsName:
    Description: Name of the QuickSight folder structure extraction Glue job.
    Value: !Ref GlueJobFolderAssets

  GlueJobQMetadataName:
    Description: Name of the QuickSight Q topic metadata extraction Glue job.
    Value: !Ref GlueJobQMetadata

  GlueJobQAccessName:
    Description: Name of the QuickSight Q object access extraction Glue job.
    Value: !Ref GlueJobQAccess

  GlueJobDsPropertiesName:
    Description: Name of the QuickSight dataset properties extraction Glue job.
    Value: !Ref GlueJobDsProperties

  GlueJobDatasourcePropertiesName:
    Description: Name of the QuickSight data source properties extraction Glue job.
    Value: !Ref GlueJobDatasourceProperties

  FirehoseIngestionStreamName:
    Description: Name of the Firehose delivery stream for QuickSight ingestion metrics.
    Value: !Ref FirehoseIngestionStream

  FirehoseVisualStreamName:
    Description: Name of the Firehose delivery stream for QuickSight visual metrics.
    Value: !Ref FirehoseVisualStream

  FirehoseSpiceStreamName:
    Description: Name of the Firehose delivery stream for QuickSight SPICE metrics.
    Value: !Ref FirehoseSpiceStream

  FirehoseIndexStreamName:
    Description: Name of the Firehose delivery stream for QuickSight index metrics.
    Value: !Ref FirehoseIndexStream

  FirehoseActionStreamName:
    Description: Name of the Firehose delivery stream for QuickSight action metrics.
    Value: !Ref FirehoseActionStream

  MetricStreamIngestionName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch metric stream for QuickSight ingestion metrics.
    Value: !Ref MetricStreamIngestion

  MetricStreamVisualName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch metric stream for QuickSight visual metrics.
    Value: !Ref MetricStreamVisual

  MetricStreamSpiceName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch metric stream for QuickSight SPICE metrics.

  MetricStreamIndexName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch metric stream for QuickSight index metrics.
    Value: !Ref MetricStreamIndex

  MetricStreamActionName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch metric stream for QuickSight action metrics.
    Value: !Ref MetricStreamAction

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Standard Step Functions state machine with a single Pass state that returns 1,
  a published version and an alias, plus API Gateway, EventBridge rule, and
  EventBridge Scheduler integrations that start executions on the alias.

Parameters:
  AliasName:
    Type: String
    Default: live
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 80
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$"
    Description: Name of the Step Functions state machine alias that all triggers target.

  ApiStageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$"
    Description: Name of the API Gateway deployment stage.

  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: "rate(1 minute)"
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: Schedule expression used by the disabled EventBridge rule and the EventBridge Scheduler schedule.

Resources:
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Step Functions state machine.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "states.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogDelivery"
                  - "logs:GetLogDelivery"
                  - "logs:UpdateLogDelivery"
                  - "logs:DeleteLogDelivery"
                  - "logs:ListLogDeliveries"
                  - "logs:PutResourcePolicy"
                  - "logs:DescribeResourcePolicies"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
                Resource: "*"

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: A state machine with a single Pass state that returns the value 1.
        StartAt: ReturnOne
        States:
          ReturnOne:
            Type: Pass
            Result: 1
            End: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-state-machine"

  StateMachineVersion:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineVersion
    Properties:
      StateMachineArn: !Ref StateMachine
      Description: Published version of the state machine.

  StateMachineAlias:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineAlias
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref AliasName
      Description: Alias that points all traffic to the published state machine version.
      DeploymentPreference:
        Type: ALL_AT_ONCE
        StateMachineVersionArn: !Ref StateMachineVersion

  ApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows API Gateway to start executions on the state machine alias.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "states:StartExecution"
                Resource:
                  - !Ref StateMachineAlias

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-step-functions-api"
      Description: REST API that starts a Step Functions execution on the alias.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  StartExecutionResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: "start-execution"

  StartExecutionGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref StartExecutionResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: AWS_IAM
      ApiKeyRequired: false
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            #set($body = $input.body)
            #if($body == "")
            #set($body = "{}")
            #end
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachineAlias}",
              "input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($body)"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: "200"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {"status":"started"}
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: "200"

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - StartExecutionGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Deployment that contains the start-execution GET method.

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref ApiStageName
      Description: Stage that exposes the start-execution GET method.

  TerminatedRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows EventBridge to start executions on the state machine alias for terminated state changes.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "states:StartExecution"
                Resource:
                  - !Ref StateMachineAlias

  TerminatedRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts an execution on the alias when a Step Functions execution reaches a terminated state.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - "aws.states"
        detail-type:
          - "Step Functions Execution Status Change"
        detail:
          status:
            - "TERMINATED"
      Targets:
        - Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TerminatedRuleRole.Arn

  ScheduledRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows EventBridge to start executions on the state machine alias from the scheduled rule.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "states:StartExecution"
                Resource:
                  - !Ref StateMachineAlias

  ScheduledRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Scheduled EventBridge rule that starts an execution on the alias every minute. Initially disabled.
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      State: DISABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt ScheduledRuleRole.Arn

  TagChangeRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows EventBridge to start executions on the state machine alias when the AWS Tag service emits tag events.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "states:StartExecution"
                Resource:
                  - !Ref StateMachineAlias

  TagChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts an execution on the alias in response to AWS Tag service tag change events.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - "aws.tag"
        detail-type:
          - "Tag Change on Resource"
      Targets:
        - Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TagChangeRuleRole.Arn

  SchedulerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows EventBridge Scheduler to start executions on the state machine alias.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: scheduler.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "states:StartExecution"
                Resource:
                  - !Ref StateMachineAlias

  MinuteSchedule:
    Type: AWS::Scheduler::Schedule
    Properties:
      Description: EventBridge Scheduler schedule that starts an execution on the alias every minute with flexible time windows disabled.
      FlexibleTimeWindow:
        Mode: "OFF"
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      State: ENABLED
      Target:
        Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
        RoleArn: !GetAtt SchedulerRole.Arn
        Input: "{}"

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !Ref StateMachine

  StateMachineVersionArn:
    Description: ARN of the published Step Functions state machine version.
    Value: !Ref StateMachineVersion

  StateMachineAliasArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine alias targeted by every trigger.
    Value: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  RestApiId:
    Description: Identifier of the API Gateway REST API that starts executions.
    Value: !Ref RestApi

  StartExecutionUrl:
    Description: Invoke URL of the GET method that starts an execution (AWS_IAM authorization required).
    Value: !Sub "https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${ApiStageName}/start-execution"

  TerminatedRuleName:
    Description: Name of the EventBridge rule that matches terminated state changes.
    Value: !Ref TerminatedRule

  ScheduledRuleName:
    Description: Name of the scheduled EventBridge rule that is created in the DISABLED state.
    Value: !Ref ScheduledRule

  TagChangeRuleName:
    Description: Name of the EventBridge rule that matches AWS Tag service tag change events.
    Value: !Ref TagChangeRule

  MinuteScheduleName:
    Description: Name of the EventBridge Scheduler schedule that runs every minute.
    Value: !Ref MinuteSchedule

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC network foundation with public/private subnets, NAT gateways, VPC flow logs, S3 gateway endpoint, and ECR interface endpoints.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1.
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2.
  FlowLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: Number of days to retain VPC flow logs in CloudWatch Logs.
  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    AllowedValues:
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
      - ALL
    Description: Type of traffic to capture in VPC flow logs.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-InternetGateway"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2"

  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NatEip1"

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NatEip2"

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway1"

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway2"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTable"

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable1"

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable2"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway1
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway2
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcFlowLogs"

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcFlowLogsRole"

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogTrafficType
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcFlowLog"

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-S3GatewayEndpoint"

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for interface VPC endpoints - allows HTTPS within VPC CIDR
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS from VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow outbound HTTPS within VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EndpointSecurityGroup"

  ECRApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ECRApiEndpoint"

  ECRDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ECRDkrEndpoint"
