AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC for KerberosEMRonEKS with public/private subnets, NAT gateways, KMS-encrypted VPC flow logs, and SSM/Secrets Manager interface endpoints.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-Public-Subnet-1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.64/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-Public-Subnet-2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.128/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-Private-Subnet-1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.192/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-Private-Subnet-2

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NAT-EIP-1

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NAT-EIP-2

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NAT-Gateway-1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NAT-Gateway-2

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-Public-RouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-Private-RouteTable-1

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-Private-RouteTable-2

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints allowing HTTPS from VPC CIDR
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/24
          Description: Allow HTTPS from VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/24
          Description: Allow HTTPS to VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-Endpoint-SG

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting VPC flow logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: key-default-1
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/KerberosEMRonEKS*'

  FlowLogsKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/KerberosEMRonEKS-flowlogs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flowlogs/KerberosEMRonEKS
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsToCloudWatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Join [':', [!GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn, '*']]

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: CloudWatchLogs
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPC-FlowLog

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-SSM-Endpoint

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-SSMMessages-Endpoint

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-EC2Messages-Endpoint

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-SecretsManager-Endpoint

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Saved CloudWatch Logs Insights query definitions for analyzing usage,
  performance, and cost metrics emitted by a Claude Code application into the
  /aws/claude-code/metrics CloudWatch Logs log group. The queries cover
  real-time monitoring, user and session analytics, cost attribution, model
  efficiency, prompt-cache effectiveness, and ad-hoc debugging.
Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Log Source
        Parameters:
          - LogGroupName
          - CreateLogGroup
    ParameterLabels:
      LogGroupName:
        default: CloudWatch Logs group name
      CreateLogGroup:
        default: Create the log group if it does not exist
Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/claude-code/metrics
    Description: >-
      Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives Claude Code metric
      events. All saved queries are scoped to this log group.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 512
    AllowedPattern: '^[\.\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]{1,512}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Log group names may contain only letters, numbers, and the characters
      . - _ / #
  CreateLogGroup:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: >-
      Set to 'true' to have CloudFormation create the log group. Leave as
      'false' when the log group is already created by the Claude Code
      CloudWatch/OpenTelemetry integration or by another stack.
Conditions:
  ShouldCreateLogGroup: !Equals
    - !Ref CreateLogGroup
    - 'true'
Resources:
  MetricsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: ShouldCreateLogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 90

  TokenAndRequestRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TokenAndRequestRatePerUser'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"user":\s*"(?<user>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"input_tokens":\s*(?<input_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"output_tokens":\s*(?<output_tokens>\d+)/
        | filter ispresent(user)
        | stats count(*) as requests, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens, sum(input_tokens) + sum(output_tokens) as total_tokens by user
        | sort total_tokens desc
        | limit 50

  CurrentTpmAverage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CurrentTpmAverage'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"input_tokens":\s*(?<input_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"output_tokens":\s*(?<output_tokens>\d+)/
        | stats sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens, sum(input_tokens) + sum(output_tokens) as tokens_per_minute by bin(1m) as minute
        | sort minute desc
        | limit 60

  CurrentRpmAverage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CurrentRpmAverage'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @message like /"input_tokens"|"output_tokens"|"request_id"/
        | stats count(*) as requests_per_minute by bin(1m) as minute
        | sort minute desc
        | limit 60

  RateLimitRisk:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RateLimitRisk'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"user":\s*"(?<user>[^"]+)"/
        | filter @message like /(?i)(429|throttl|rate.?limit|too many requests|overloaded)/
        | stats count(*) as rate_limit_events, min(@timestamp) as first_seen, max(@timestamp) as last_seen by user
        | sort rate_limit_events desc
        | limit 50

  SessionUsageSummary:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SessionUsageSummary'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"session_id":\s*"(?<session_id>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"user":\s*"(?<user>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"input_tokens":\s*(?<input_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"output_tokens":\s*(?<output_tokens>\d+)/
        | filter ispresent(session_id)
        | stats min(@timestamp) as session_start, max(@timestamp) as session_end, count(*) as requests, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens, sum(input_tokens) + sum(output_tokens) as total_tokens by session_id, user
        | sort session_start desc
        | limit 200

  HourlyActivityTimeline:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HourlyActivityTimeline'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"user":\s*"(?<user>[^"]+)"/
        | stats count(*) as requests, count_distinct(user) as active_users by bin(1h) as hour
        | sort hour desc
        | limit 168

  ErrorAndThrottlingDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ErrorAndThrottlingDetection'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @message like /(?i)(error|exception|throttl|rate.?limit|429|overloaded)/
        | parse @message /"user":\s*"(?<user>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"session_id":\s*"(?<session_id>[^"]+)"/
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 200

  TopUsersByTokenUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TopUsersByTokenUsage'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"user":\s*"(?<user>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"input_tokens":\s*(?<input_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"output_tokens":\s*(?<output_tokens>\d+)/
        | stats count(*) as requests, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens, sum(input_tokens) + sum(output_tokens) as total_tokens by user
        | sort total_tokens desc
        | limit 25

  CostByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CostByUser'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"user":\s*"(?<user>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"input_tokens":\s*(?<input_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"output_tokens":\s*(?<output_tokens>\d+)/
        | filter ispresent(user)
        | stats sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens by user
        | fields user, input_tokens, output_tokens, input_tokens * 3.0 / 1000000 as input_cost_usd, output_tokens * 15.0 / 1000000 as output_cost_usd
        | fields user, input_tokens, output_tokens, input_cost_usd, output_cost_usd, input_cost_usd + output_cost_usd as estimated_cost_usd
        | sort estimated_cost_usd desc
        | limit 100

  CostByModel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CostByModel'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"model":\s*"(?<model>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"input_tokens":\s*(?<input_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"output_tokens":\s*(?<output_tokens>\d+)/
        | filter ispresent(model)
        | stats count(*) as requests, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens by model
        | fields model, requests, input_tokens, output_tokens, input_tokens * 3.0 / 1000000 as input_cost_usd, output_tokens * 15.0 / 1000000 as output_cost_usd
        | fields model, requests, input_tokens, output_tokens, input_cost_usd, output_cost_usd, input_cost_usd + output_cost_usd as estimated_cost_usd
        | sort estimated_cost_usd desc

  CostByOrganization:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CostByOrganization'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"organization_id":\s*"(?<organization_id>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"input_tokens":\s*(?<input_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"output_tokens":\s*(?<output_tokens>\d+)/
        | filter ispresent(organization_id)
        | stats count(*) as requests, count_distinct(user) as users, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens by organization_id
        | fields organization_id, requests, users, input_tokens, output_tokens, input_tokens * 3.0 / 1000000 as input_cost_usd, output_tokens * 15.0 / 1000000 as output_cost_usd
        | fields organization_id, requests, users, input_tokens, output_tokens, input_cost_usd, output_cost_usd, input_cost_usd + output_cost_usd as estimated_cost_usd
        | sort estimated_cost_usd desc

  ModelEfficiency:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ModelEfficiency'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"model":\s*"(?<model>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"input_tokens":\s*(?<input_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"output_tokens":\s*(?<output_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"duration_ms":\s*(?<duration_ms>\d+)/
        | filter ispresent(model)
        | stats count(*) as requests, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens, avg(duration_ms) as avg_latency_ms, sum(input_tokens) / count(*) as avg_input_tokens_per_request, sum(output_tokens) / count(*) as avg_output_tokens_per_request by model
        | sort requests desc

  PeakUsageWindows:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PeakUsageWindows'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"input_tokens":\s*(?<input_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"output_tokens":\s*(?<output_tokens>\d+)/
        | stats count(*) as requests, sum(input_tokens) + sum(output_tokens) as total_tokens by bin(15m) as window
        | sort total_tokens desc
        | limit 25

  DailyUsageSummary:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DailyUsageSummary'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"user":\s*"(?<user>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"input_tokens":\s*(?<input_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"output_tokens":\s*(?<output_tokens>\d+)/
        | stats count(*) as requests, count_distinct(user) as unique_users, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens, sum(input_tokens) + sum(output_tokens) as total_tokens by bin(1d) as day
        | sort day desc

  CacheHitMissOverall:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CacheHitMissOverall'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"cache_read_input_tokens":\s*(?<cache_read_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"cache_creation_input_tokens":\s*(?<cache_creation_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"input_tokens":\s*(?<uncached_input_tokens>\d+)/
        | stats sum(cache_read_tokens) as cache_read_tokens, sum(cache_creation_tokens) as cache_creation_tokens, sum(uncached_input_tokens) as uncached_input_tokens
        | fields cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens + uncached_input_tokens as total_input_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, uncached_input_tokens
        | fields total_input_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, uncached_input_tokens, cache_read_tokens / total_input_tokens as cache_hit_ratio

  CacheHitMissOverTime:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CacheHitMissOverTime'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"cache_read_input_tokens":\s*(?<cache_read_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"cache_creation_input_tokens":\s*(?<cache_creation_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"input_tokens":\s*(?<uncached_input_tokens>\d+)/
        | stats sum(cache_read_tokens) as cache_read_tokens, sum(cache_creation_tokens) as cache_creation_tokens, sum(uncached_input_tokens) as uncached_input_tokens by bin(1h) as hour
        | fields hour, cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens + uncached_input_tokens as total_input_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, uncached_input_tokens
        | fields hour, total_input_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, uncached_input_tokens, cache_read_tokens / total_input_tokens as cache_hit_ratio
        | sort hour desc

  CacheHitMissBySession:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CacheHitMissBySession'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"session_id":\s*"(?<session_id>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"cache_read_input_tokens":\s*(?<cache_read_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"cache_creation_input_tokens":\s*(?<cache_creation_tokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"input_tokens":\s*(?<uncached_input_tokens>\d+)/
        | filter ispresent(session_id)
        | stats sum(cache_read_tokens) as cache_read_tokens, sum(cache_creation_tokens) as cache_creation_tokens, sum(uncached_input_tokens) as uncached_input_tokens by session_id
        | fields session_id, cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens + uncached_input_tokens as total_input_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, uncached_input_tokens
        | fields session_id, total_input_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, uncached_input_tokens, cache_read_tokens / total_input_tokens as cache_hit_ratio
        | sort total_input_tokens desc
        | limit 200

  SessionDeepDive:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SessionDeepDive'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"session_id":\s*"(?<session_id>[^"]+)"/
        | filter session_id = "REPLACE-WITH-SESSION-ID"
        | sort @timestamp asc
        | limit 1000

  FieldExplorerQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FieldExplorer'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | limit 25

  SavedQueryCount:

        - !Ref CacheHitMissOverall

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: SuperCoolAPI AppSync GraphQL API with IAM authentication, full CloudWatch request logging, and DynamoDB backend (Table1) accessed via multiple data sources.

Resources:

  ############################################################
  # DynamoDB Table
  ############################################################
  Table1:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Table1
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH

  ############################################################
  # IAM Role granting AppSync full read/write access to Table1 and its indexes
  ############################################################
  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBFullAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt Table1.Arn
                  - !Sub "${Table1.Arn}/index/*"

  ############################################################
  # IAM Role granting AppSync permission to write to CloudWatch Logs
  ############################################################
  AppSyncLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"

  ############################################################
  # AppSync GraphQL API (SuperCoolAPI)
  ############################################################
  SuperCoolAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SuperCoolAPI
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLoggingRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL

  ############################################################
  # AppSync GraphQL Schema
  ############################################################
  SuperCoolAPISchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          description: String
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }

        type Mutation {
          addTodo(id: ID!, description: String): Todo
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  ############################################################
  # Data Source #1 - Table & Region referenced with Ref
  ############################################################
  TodoDataSourceRef:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: TodoDataSourceRef
      Description: DynamoDB data source referencing table and region via Ref
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref Table1
        AwsRegion: !Ref "AWS::Region"

  ############################################################
  # Data Source #2 - Table & Region referenced with Sub
  ############################################################
  TodoDataSourceSub:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: TodoDataSourceSub
      Description: DynamoDB data source referencing table and region via Sub
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Sub "${Table1}"
        AwsRegion: !Sub "${AWS::Region}"

  ############################################################
  # Resolver: Query.getTodo
  ############################################################
  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SuperCoolAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDataSourceRef.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "GetItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  ############################################################
  # Resolver: Mutation.addTodo
  ############################################################
  AddTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SuperCoolAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDataSourceSub.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          },
          "attributeValues": $util.dynamodb.toMapValuesJson($ctx.args)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: The SuperCoolAPI AppSync GraphQL API ID
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId

  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: The SuperCoolAPI AppSync GraphQL API ARN
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.Arn

  GraphQLUrl:
    Description: The HTTPS endpoint URL of the SuperCoolAPI GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.GraphQLUrl

  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table backing the API
    Value: !Ref Table1

  DynamoDBTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table backing the API
    Value: !GetAtt Table1.Arn

    Properties:
      Description: Permissions for the legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider on the control plane.

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2LegacyCloudProvider
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingLegacyCloudProvider
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancingLegacyCloudProvider
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: KMSLegacyCloudProvider
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: '*'

  NodeRegistrationPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: EC2, ECR, Secrets Manager, and SSM permissions for node registration and image pulls.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2NodeDiscovery
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces

              - ec2:DescribeTags
            Resource: '*'

            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SecretsManagerAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret

            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:

              - ssm:DescribeParameters
              - ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation
              - ssmmessages:CreateControlChannel

              - iam:PassRole

            Resource: '*'

              - iam:PutRolePolicy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates a dual-stack VPC with optional public subnets and mandatory private subnets across three Availability Zones.

Parameters:
  VpcName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyVPC
    Description: Identifier for the VPC and associated resources.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC. Must be between /16 and /24.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-4])$'
  IncludePublicSubnets:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Whether to create public subnets, an Internet Gateway, and public routing.

Conditions:
  CreatePublicSubnets: !Equals [!Ref IncludePublicSubnets, "true"]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcName
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-IGW"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: !Select
        - 0
        - !Cidr
          - !Ref VpcCidr
          - 8
          - 3
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select
        - 0
        - !Cidr
          - !Select
            - 0
            - !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks
          - 8
          - 8
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-PublicSubnet1"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: !Select
        - 1
        - !Cidr
          - !Ref VpcCidr
          - 8
          - 3
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select
        - 1
        - !Cidr
          - !Select
            - 0
            - !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks
          - 8
          - 8
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-PublicSubnet2"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: !Select
        - 2
        - !Cidr
          - !Ref VpcCidr
          - 8
          - 3
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select
        - 2
        - !Cidr
          - !Select
            - 0
            - !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks
          - 8
          - 8
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-PublicSubnet3"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: !Select
        - 3
        - !Cidr
          - !Ref VpcCidr
          - 8
          - 3
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select
        - 3
        - !Cidr
          - !Select
            - 0
            - !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks
          - 8
          - 8
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-PrivateSubnet1"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: !Select
        - 4
        - !Cidr
          - !Ref VpcCidr
          - 8
          - 3
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select
        - 4
        - !Cidr
          - !Select
            - 0
            - !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks
          - 8
          - 8
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-PrivateSubnet2"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: !Select
        - 5
        - !Cidr
          - !Ref VpcCidr
          - 8
          - 3
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select
        - 5
        - !Cidr
          - !Select
            - 0
            - !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks
          - 8
          - 8
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-PrivateSubnet3"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-PublicRouteTable"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-PrivateRouteTable"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of public subnet IDs
    Value: !If
      - CreatePublicSubnets
      - !Join
        - ","
        - - !Ref PublicSubnet1
          - !Ref PublicSubnet2
          - !Ref PublicSubnet3
      - ""
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3

Parameters:

    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) ARN of the OIDC provider for the EKS cluster to enable IRSA for the controllers role. If provided, the controllers role trust policy will include this provider.

Conditions:

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EKSControlPlaneRole'

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSVPCResourceController

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ControlPlaneRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticLoadBalancingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AutoScalingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecretsManagerReadWrite
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllerPolicy

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC infrastructure for OpenSearch cross-region resilience with configurable single or multi NAT Gateway setup.

Parameters:
  EnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name used for tagging and resource naming.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2.
  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 3.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.101.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1.
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.102.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2.
  PublicSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.103.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 3.
  NatGatewayMode:
    Type: String
    Default: single
    AllowedValues:
      - single
      - multi
    Description: Choose single NAT Gateway (cost-effective) or one NAT Gateway per AZ (high availability).

Conditions:
  UseSingleNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayMode, single]
  UseMultiNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayMode, multi]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-igw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - !GetAZs ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-public-subnet-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - !GetAZs ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-private-subnet-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-public-rt"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEipSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: UseSingleNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-nat-eip-single"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName

  NatGatewaySingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: UseSingleNat
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipSingle.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-nat-gateway-single"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName

  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: UseMultiNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-nat-eip-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: UseMultiNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-nat-eip-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName

  NatEip3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP

    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-nat-eip-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: UseMultiNat
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-nat-gateway-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: UseMultiNat
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-nat-gateway-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: UseMultiNat
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-nat-gateway-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName

  PrivateRouteTableSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: UseSingleNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-private-rt-single"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName

  PrivateRouteSingle:

      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewaySingle

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociationSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: UseSingleNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociationSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: UseSingleNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociationSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: UseSingleNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: UseMultiNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-private-rt-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: UseMultiNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-private-rt-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: UseMultiNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvName}-private-rt-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: UseMultiNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: UseMultiNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: UseMultiNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

    Condition: UseMultiNat

  FlowLogGroup:

  FlowLogsRole:

          - Effect: Allow

  VpcFlowLog:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Completely isolated private VPC (no internet gateway, no NAT) for an
  AI-powered customer support application. Provisions three private subnets
  across three Availability Zones, gateway VPC endpoints for S3 and DynamoDB,
  interface VPC endpoints for Bedrock, ECR, CloudWatch Logs and Monitoring,
  RDS Data API, Secrets Manager, SSM Parameter Store, SSM messages, KMS and
  X-Ray, KMS-encrypted VPC Flow Logs with automatic key rotation, and dedicated
  HTTPS-only security groups for the Agent Runtime, MCP Runtime and Lambda
  application components.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: ai-support
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    Description: Prefix applied to the name of every resource created by this template.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the isolated VPC.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/20
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.16.0/20
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2.

  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.32.0/20
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 3.

Resources:

  ##########################################################################
  # VPC and private networking (no internet gateway, no NAT gateway)
  ##########################################################################

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-subnet-3'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ##########################################################################
  # Security groups
  ##########################################################################

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: >-
        Controls HTTPS access to the interface VPC endpoints from the
        application component security groups.
      GroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpce-sg'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS egress inside the VPC only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpce-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: >-
        Security group for the Agent Runtime. HTTPS-only egress to the VPC
        endpoints, S3 and DynamoDB.
      GroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agent-runtime-sg'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS to the interface VPC endpoints
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
          Description: HTTPS to S3 through the gateway endpoint
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
          Description: HTTPS directly to DynamoDB through the gateway endpoint
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agent-runtime-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  McpRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: >-
        Security group for the MCP Runtime. HTTPS-only egress to the VPC
        endpoints, S3 and DynamoDB.
      GroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-runtime-sg'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS to the interface VPC endpoints
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
          Description: HTTPS to S3 through the gateway endpoint
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
          Description: HTTPS directly to DynamoDB through the gateway endpoint
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: >-
        Security group for the Lambda functions. HTTPS-only egress to the VPC
        endpoints, S3 and DynamoDB.
      GroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-lambda-sg'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS to the interface VPC endpoints
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
          Description: HTTPS to S3 through the gateway endpoint
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
          Description: HTTPS directly to DynamoDB through the gateway endpoint
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-lambda-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

      Description: HTTPS from the Lambda functions

  ##########################################################################
  # Customer managed KMS key for VPC Flow Logs (automatic rotation)
  ##########################################################################

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key used to encrypt VPC Flow Logs for ${ProjectName}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-flow-logs-key'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  ##########################################################################
  # VPC Flow Logs (all traffic, encrypted with the customer managed key)
  ##########################################################################

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${ProjectName}'
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to publish flow log events to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsPublishPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC for EKS with public/private subnets, NAT gateways, and security groups.
Parameters:
  VpcCidrBlock:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  VpcName:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-vpc
    Description: Name tag for VPC resources
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2
  PublicSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 3
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2
  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.12.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 3
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidrBlock
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcName
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-igw
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-public-subnet-1
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-public-subnet-2
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-public-subnet-3
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-private-subnet-1
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-private-subnet-2
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-private-subnet-3
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-public-rt
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-eip-1
  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-eip-2
  EIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-eip-3
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-nat-1
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-nat-2
  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-nat-3
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-private-rt-1
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-private-rt-2
  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-private-rt-3
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
  EKSControlPlaneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EKS control plane to communicate with worker nodes
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-eks-control-plane-sg
  ApplicationSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for application ingress and service mesh gateway ports
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8080
          ToPort: 8080
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8443
          ToPort: 8443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 15021
          ToPort: 15021
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 15012
          ToPort: 15012
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 15017
          ToPort: 15017
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-app-sg
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  EKSControlPlaneSecurityGroupId:
    Description: The EKS control plane security group ID

  ApplicationSecurityGroupId:
    Description: The application security group ID
    Value: !Ref ApplicationSecurityGroup
  SubnetIds:
