AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates IAM execution role for SageMaker HyperPod cluster integrated with EKS
Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix for resource names
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 50
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
  EksClusterName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the EKS cluster
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC ID where the EKS cluster runs
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: List of security group IDs
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: List of private subnet IDs
  LifecycleScriptsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 bucket name for lifecycle scripts
  RigInputBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional RIG input S3 bucket name
    Default: ''
  RigOutputBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional RIG output S3 bucket name
    Default: ''
  CreateRigResources:
    Type: String
    Description: Flag to create RIG resources
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    Description: Flag to enable gated access
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'

Conditions:
  CreateRigPolicy: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateRigResources, 'true']
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigInputBucketName, '']]
  EnableGatedAccessPolicy: !And
    - !Condition CreateRigPolicy
    - !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, 'true']
  RigOutputBucketProvided: !And
    - !Condition CreateRigPolicy
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigOutputBucketName, '']]
  HasPrivateSubnets: !Not [!Equals [!Join [",", !Ref PrivateSubnetIds], '']]
  HasSecurityGroups: !Not [!Equals [!Join [",", !Ref SecurityGroupIds], '']]

Resources:
  SageMakerHyperPodExecRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSCNIPluginPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: ENIManagementPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ENIManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${VpcId}
              - Sid: EC2Read
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ECRPull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchAlarms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EKSAuth
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/${EksClusterName}
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsS3
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsBucketName}
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsBucketName}/*
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"

  RigPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: CreateRigPolicy
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RigInputBucketAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigInputBucketName}
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigInputBucketName}/*
          - Sid: LambdaInvoke
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*SageMaker*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*sagemaker*
          - !If
            - EnableGatedAccessPolicy
            - Sid: GatedS3Access
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
              Resource:
                - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*SageMaker*
                - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*sagemaker*
                - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*SageMaker*
                - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*sagemaker*
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - EnableGatedAccessPolicy
            - Sid: GatedSQSAccess
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - sqs:SendMessage
                - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                - sqs:DeleteMessage
                - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              Resource:
                - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*SageMaker*
                - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*sagemaker*
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - RigOutputBucketProvided
            - Sid: RigOutputBucketAccess
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:ListBucket
                - s3:GetObject
                - s3:PutObject
                - s3:DeleteObject
              Resource:
                - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigOutputBucketName}
                - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigOutputBucketName}/*
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"

  SubnetENIPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: HasPrivateSubnets
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
            Resource: !Split
              - ","
              - !Sub
                - "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${Joined}"
                - Joined: !Join
                    - !Sub ",arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/"
                    - !Ref PrivateSubnetIds
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"

  SecurityGroupENIPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: HasSecurityGroups
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
            Resource: !Split
              - ","
              - !Sub
                - "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/${Joined}"
                - Joined: !Join
                    - !Sub ",arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/"
                    - !Ref SecurityGroupIds
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"

Outputs:
  ExecRoleName:
    Description: Name of the SageMaker HyperPod execution role
    Value: !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
  ExecRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker HyperPod execution role
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerHyperPodExecRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Three-tier VPC (web, application, database) spanning three Availability Zones.
  The web tier is public behind an Internet Gateway with a single shared route
  table; each Availability Zone hosts its own NAT Gateway in the web subnet, and
  the application and database subnets in that zone route their default traffic
  through the NAT Gateway of the same zone.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - production
    Description: Environment name applied to all resource tags.

Resources:

  ##########################################################################
  # VPC and Internet Gateway
  ##########################################################################

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  ##########################################################################
  # Web tier subnets (one per Availability Zone) - public
  ##########################################################################

  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/20
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Web
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: 10.0.16.0/20
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Web
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  WebSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: 10.0.32.0/20
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Web
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ##########################################################################
  # Application tier subnets (one per Availability Zone) - private
  ##########################################################################

  AppSubnet1:

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select

        - Key: Name

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: 10.0.80.0/20
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ##########################################################################
  # Database tier subnets (one per Availability Zone) - private
  ##########################################################################

  DBSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: 10.0.96.0/20
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DBSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: 10.0.112.0/20
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DBSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: 10.0.128.0/20
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ##########################################################################
  # Web tier routing - one shared route table with a default route to the IGW
  ##########################################################################

  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-route-table'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Web
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  WebRouteToInternet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  ##########################################################################
  # NAT Gateways - one Elastic IP and one NAT Gateway in each web subnet
  ##########################################################################

  NatGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGatewayEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGatewayEIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ##########################################################################
  # Application tier routing - per-subnet route table via the AZ-local NAT GW
  ##########################################################################

  AppRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-route-table-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AppRouteToNatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1

  AppRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-route-table-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AppRouteToNatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2

  AppRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-route-table-3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AppRouteToNatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  AppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3

  ##########################################################################
  # Database tier routing - per-subnet route table via the AZ-local NAT GW
  ##########################################################################

  DBRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-route-table-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DBRouteToNatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DBRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  DBSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DBSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref DBRouteTable1

  DBRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-route-table-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DBRouteToNatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DBRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  DBSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DBSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref DBRouteTable2

  DBRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-route-table-3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DBRouteToNatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DBRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  DBSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DBSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref DBRouteTable3

Outputs:

  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the three-tier VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: The Availability Zones used by the subnets (one per tier position).
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Select
          - 0
          - !GetAZs ''
        - !Select
          - 1
          - !GetAZs ''
        - !Select
          - 2
          - !GetAZs ''
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZones'

  WebSubnetIds:
    Description: The IDs of the web tier subnets (one per Availability Zone).
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
        - !Ref WebSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebSubnetIds'

  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: The IDs of the application tier subnets (one per Availability Zone).
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref AppSubnet1
        - !Ref AppSubnet2
        - !Ref AppSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnetIds'

  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: The IDs of the database tier subnets (one per Availability Zone).
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref DBSubnet1
        - !Ref DBSubnet2
        - !Ref DBSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DbSubnetIds'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared IAM roles and instance profiles for Amazon EKS Quick Start stacks
Resources:
  CopyZipArtifactsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CopyZipArtifactsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3CopyZipArtifacts
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
  ResourceReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-ResourceReaderRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
  VPCRoleCreationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-VPCRoleCreationRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateVPCRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PolicyARN:
                      - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaENIManagementAccess
                      - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
  DeleteBucketContentsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-DeleteBucketContentsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeleteBucketContents
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: '*'
  CleanupLoadBalancersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CleanupLoadBalancersRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupLoadBalancers
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeRules
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteRule
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
                Resource: '*'
  CleanupSecurityGroupDependenciesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CleanupSecurityGroupDependenciesRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupSecurityGroupDependencies
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                Resource: '*'
  CleanupLambdaFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CleanupLambdaFunctionsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupLambdaFunctions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:ListTags
                  - lambda:TagResource
                  - lambda:UntagResource
                Resource: '*'
  ResolveCallerArnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-ResolveCallerArnRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResolveCallerArn
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - iam:GetUser
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:ListUsers
                Resource: '*'
  RegisterCustomResourceTypesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-RegisterCustomResourceTypesRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RegisterCustomResourceTypes
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeTypeRegistration
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                Resource: '*'
  ManageNodeSecurityGroupsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-ManageNodeSecurityGroupsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageNodeSecurityGroups
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                Resource: '*'
  CreateFargateProfilesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-CreateFargateProfilesRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateFargateProfiles
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:CreateFargateProfile
                  - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
                  - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
                  - eks:ListFargateProfiles
                  - eks:TagResource
                  - eks:UntagResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/eks-quickstart-FargateExecutionRole
  ResolveSSMParametersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-ResolveSSMParametersRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResolveSSMParameters
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: '*'
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-ControlPlaneRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSServicePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DescribeEC2Resources
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                Resource: '*'
  FargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-FargateExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy
  ManagedNodeInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-ManagedNodeInstanceRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SignalCloudFormation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'
  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: eks-quickstart-ManagedNodeInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeInstanceRole
  UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SignalCloudFormation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'
  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: eks-quickstart-UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Lab VPC with two web-tier and two app-tier subnets across two Availability Zones, a single shared route table, a web-tier security group, a gateway endpoint for S3, and interface endpoints for Kinesis Data Firehose and Kinesis Data Streams.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the lab VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  WebSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first web-tier subnet (Availability Zone 1).
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  WebSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second web-tier subnet (Availability Zone 2).
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  AppSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first app-tier subnet (Availability Zone 1).
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  AppSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second app-tier subnet (Availability Zone 2).
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  SharedRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-shared-rt'

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Web tier security group allowing inbound HTTPS from within the VPC CIDR range.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow inbound HTTPS from within the VPC.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-sg'

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref SharedRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ReadAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: '*'

  FirehoseInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-firehose'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  KinesisStreamsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the lab VPC.
    Value: !Ref Vpc
  WebSubnet1Id:
    Description: The ID of the first web-tier subnet (Availability Zone 1).
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet1
  WebSubnet2Id:
    Description: The ID of the second web-tier subnet (Availability Zone 2).
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet2
  AppSubnet1Id:
    Description: The ID of the first app-tier subnet (Availability Zone 1).
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet1
  AppSubnet2Id:
    Description: The ID of the second app-tier subnet (Availability Zone 2).
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet2
  WebSecurityGroupId:
    Description: The ID of the web-tier security group.
    Value: !Ref WebSecurityGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Shared per-account IAM roles for EKS cluster deployments driven by CloudFormation custom resources'

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-shared
    Description: Prefix for all resource names
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 30
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'

Resources:
  # Lambda Execution Roles
  CopyAssetsLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-lambda-copy-assets-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CopyAssetsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                Resource:
                  - arn:aws:s3:::*
                  - arn:aws:s3:::*/*

  ReadResourcesLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-lambda-read-resources-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess

  CreateVpcRoleLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-lambda-create-vpc-role-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateVpcRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:UntagRole
                Resource: arn:aws:iam::*:role/*

  DeleteS3ContentsLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-lambda-delete-s3-contents-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeleteS3ContentsPolicy

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:ListObjects
                  - s3:ListObjectsV2
                Resource:
                  - arn:aws:s3:::*
                  - arn:aws:s3:::*/*

  CleanupLoadBalancersLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-lambda-cleanup-lb-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags

                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups

                  - ec2:DescribeTags

Description: "Creates a self-contained IAM user and group with a Secrets Manager secret for Minesweeper testing."

Parameters:
  ID:
    Type: String
    Default: "999hadvhgchjesr"
    Description: "Unique identifier for Minesweeper resources."

Resources:
  Secret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "minesweeper-secret-${ID}"
      Description: "Minesweeper user secret"
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username":"minesweeper-user"}'
        GenerateStringKey: "password"
        PasswordLength: 15
        ExcludeCharacters: '|;,."<>%`'
        RequireEachIncludedType: true

  IAMGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub "minesweeper-${ID}"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "MinesweeperFullAccess"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ec2:*"
                  - "cloudformation:*"
                  - "secretsmanager:*"
                Resource: "*"

  IAMUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    DependsOn: Secret
    Properties:
      UserName: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:minesweeper-secret-${ID}:SecretString:username}}'
      Groups:
        - !Ref IAMGroup
      LoginProfile:
        Password: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:minesweeper-secret-${ID}:SecretString:password}}'
        PasswordResetRequired: false

Outputs:
  UserArn:
    Description: "ARN of the created IAM user"
    Value: !GetAtt IAMUser.Arn

      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-MinesweeperUserArn"

Description: "DynamoDB table and IAM managed policy for application data storage"

Parameters:
  App:
    Type: String
    Description: "Name of the application"
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
  Env:
    Type: String
    Description: "Target environment name (e.g. dev, test, prod)"
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
  Name:
    Type: String
    Description: "Workload name"
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: "AWS::DynamoDB::Table"
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${App}-${Env}-${Name}-bs-dynamodb"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: "bs"
          AttributeType: "N"
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: "bs"
          KeyType: "HASH"

  DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy"
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${App}-${Env}-${Name}-bs-dynamodb-policy"
      Description: !Sub "Full CRUD access to the ${App}-${Env}-${Name}-bs-dynamodb DynamoDB table and its local secondary indexes"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "DynamoDBTableCrudAccess"
            Effect: "Allow"
            Action:
              - "dynamodb:BatchGetItem"
              - "dynamodb:BatchWriteItem"
              - "dynamodb:CreateTable"
              - "dynamodb:DeleteItem"
              - "dynamodb:DeleteTable"
              - "dynamodb:DescribeStream"
              - "dynamodb:DescribeTable"
              - "dynamodb:GetItem"
              - "dynamodb:PutItem"
              - "dynamodb:Query"
              - "dynamodb:Scan"
              - "dynamodb:UpdateItem"
              - "dynamodb:UpdateTable"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt "DynamoDBTable.Arn"
              - !Sub "${DynamoDBTable.Arn}/index/*"

Outputs:
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: "Name of the DynamoDB table"
    Value: !Ref "DynamoDBTable"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${App}-${Env}-${Name}-bs-dynamodb-table-name"

  DynamoDBCrudPolicyArn:
    Description: "ARN of the IAM managed policy granting CRUD access to the DynamoDB table"
    Value: !Ref "DynamoDBCrudPolicy"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${App}-${Env}-${Name}-bs-dynamodb-policy-arn"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Transit Gateway and RAM Resource Share infrastructure for multi-account network transit

Parameters:
  ReferenceFunctionsStackName:
    Type: String
    Default: ReferenceFunctions
    Description: Name of the stack containing reference functions.
  CompanyName:
    Type: String
    Default: Camelz
    Description: Company name.
  SystemName:
    Type: String
    Default: Prototype
    Description: System name.
  AccountName:
    Type: String
    Default: Core
    Description: Account name.
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: Core
    Description: Environment name.
  TransitGatewayAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: Account ID of the Transit Gateway account. Leave empty if deploying in the Transit Gateway account.
  TransitGatewayASN:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534
    Description: BGP ASN for the Transit Gateway.
  AutoAcceptSharedAttachments:
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable
    Description: Enable or disable auto accept shared attachments.
  DnsSupport:
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable
    Description: Enable or disable DNS support.
  VpnEcmpSupport:
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable
    Description: Enable or disable VPN ECMP support.
  TransitGatewayResourceShareName:
    Type: String
    Default: Core-TransitGatewayResourceShare
    Description: Name of the RAM resource share for the Transit Gateway.
  Organization:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: AWS Organizations organization ID to share the Transit Gateway with.
  AllowExternalPrincipals:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Allow external principals for the resource share.
  OrganizationAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: Organization account ID.
  JumpstartAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: Jumpstart account ID.
  ManagementAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: Management account ID.
  LogAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: Log account ID.
  RecoveryAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: Recovery account ID.
  BuildAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: Build account ID.
  CoreAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: Core account ID.
  ProductionAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: Production account ID.
  StagingAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: Staging account ID.
  UATAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: UAT account ID.
  QAAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: QA account ID.
  TestingAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: Testing account ID.
  DevelopmentAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: Development account ID.

Conditions:
  IsPrimaryTransitAccount: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, ""]
    - !Equals [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, !Ref "AWS::AccountId"]
  IsSpokeAccount: !Not [!Condition IsPrimaryTransitAccount]
  OrganizationProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Organization, ""]]
  OrganizationAccountProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationAccount, ""]]
  JumpstartAccountProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref JumpstartAccount, ""]]
  ManagementAccountProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ManagementAccount, ""]]
  LogAccountProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LogAccount, ""]]
  RecoveryAccountProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RecoveryAccount, ""]]
  BuildAccountProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BuildAccount, ""]]
  CoreAccountProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CoreAccount, ""]]
  ProductionAccountProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ProductionAccount, ""]]
  StagingAccountProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StagingAccount, ""]]
  UATAccountProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref UATAccount, ""]]
  QAAccountProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref QAAccount, ""]]
  TestingAccountProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TestingAccount, ""]]
  DevelopmentAccountProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DevelopmentAccount, ""]]
  HasIndividualAccounts: !Or
    - !Condition OrganizationAccountProvided
    - !Condition JumpstartAccountProvided
    - !Condition ManagementAccountProvided
    - !Condition LogAccountProvided
    - !Condition RecoveryAccountProvided
    - !Condition BuildAccountProvided
    - !Condition CoreAccountProvided
    - !Condition ProductionAccountProvided
    - !Condition StagingAccountProvided
    - !Condition UATAccountProvided
    - !Condition QAAccountProvided
    - !Condition TestingAccountProvided
    - !Condition DevelopmentAccountProvided
  OrganizationEmpty: !Equals [!Ref Organization, ""]
  AllowExternalPrincipalsIfExternal: !And
    - !Condition OrganizationEmpty
    - !Condition HasIndividualAccounts
  AllowExternalPrincipalsParamIsTrue: !Equals [!Ref AllowExternalPrincipals, "true"]
  HasAnyPrincipal: !Or
    - !Condition OrganizationProvided
    - !Condition HasIndividualAccounts

Resources:
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Condition: IsPrimaryTransitAccount
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayASN
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: !Ref AutoAcceptSharedAttachments
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: !Ref DnsSupport
      VpnEcmpSupport: !Ref VpnEcmpSupport
      Description: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway"
        - Key: CompanyName
          Value: !Ref CompanyName
        - Key: SystemName
          Value: !Ref SystemName
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: AccountName
          Value: !Ref AccountName

  TransitGatewayResourceShare:
    Type: AWS::RAM::ResourceShare
    Condition: IsPrimaryTransitAccount
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref TransitGatewayResourceShareName
      AllowExternalPrincipals: !If
        - AllowExternalPrincipalsIfExternal
        - true
        - !If
          - AllowExternalPrincipalsParamIsTrue
          - true
          - false
      Principals: !If
        - HasAnyPrincipal
        - - !If [OrganizationProvided, !Ref Organization, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
          - !If [OrganizationAccountProvided, !Ref OrganizationAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
          - !If [JumpstartAccountProvided, !Ref JumpstartAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
          - !If [ManagementAccountProvided, !Ref ManagementAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
          - !If [LogAccountProvided, !Ref LogAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
          - !If [RecoveryAccountProvided, !Ref RecoveryAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
          - !If [BuildAccountProvided, !Ref BuildAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
          - !If [CoreAccountProvided, !Ref CoreAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
          - !If [ProductionAccountProvided, !Ref ProductionAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
          - !If [StagingAccountProvided, !Ref StagingAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
          - !If [UATAccountProvided, !Ref UATAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
          - !If [QAAccountProvided, !Ref QAAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
          - !If [TestingAccountProvided, !Ref TestingAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
          - !If [DevelopmentAccountProvided, !Ref DevelopmentAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      ResourceArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transit-gateway/${TransitGateway}"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref TransitGatewayResourceShareName
        - Key: CompanyName
          Value: !Ref CompanyName
        - Key: SystemName
          Value: !Ref SystemName
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayReference:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Condition: IsSpokeAccount
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: "${ReferenceFunctionsStackName}-TransitGatewayReferenceFunctionArn"
      TransitGatewayAccount: !Ref TransitGatewayAccount
      TransitGatewayResourceShareName: !Ref TransitGatewayResourceShareName
      Organization: !Ref Organization
      EnvironmentName: !Ref EnvironmentName
      CompanyName: !Ref CompanyName
      SystemName: !Ref SystemName
      AccountName: !Ref AccountName

Outputs:
  TransitGateway:
    Description: Transit Gateway ID
    Value: !If
      - IsPrimaryTransitAccount
      - !Ref TransitGateway
      - !GetAtt TransitGatewayReference.TransitGatewayId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TransitGateway"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Amazon Bedrock Guardrail, its published version, and version tracking SSM parameter for the AWS pricing assistant. The guardrail restricts AI interactions to AWS pricing and infrastructure design topics, blocks profanity and sensitive PII, and stores the active guardrail version in Parameter Store.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-pricing-assistant
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 3-40 characters of lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens, and must start and end with a letter or number.
    Description: Name of the project. Used to name the Bedrock guardrail and to tag all created resources.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment. Used in resource naming, tagging, and the SSM parameter path.

Resources:
  PricingAssistantGuardrail:
    Type: AWS::Bedrock::Guardrail
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-guardrail"
      Description: !Sub "Guardrail for the ${ProjectName} (${Environment}) assistant. Restricts interactions to AWS pricing and infrastructure design topics and blocks harmful content, profanity, and sensitive PII."
      BlockedInputMessaging: "I can only help with AWS pricing and infrastructure design questions. Please ask about AWS services, costs, architecture, or optimization."
      BlockedOutputsMessaging: "I can only respond to questions about AWS pricing and infrastructure design. Please rephrase your request to focus on AWS services or architecture."
      ContentPolicyConfig:
        FiltersConfig:
          - Type: SEXUAL
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: VIOLENCE
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: HATE
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: PROMPT_ATTACK
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: INSULTS
            InputStrength: MEDIUM
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: MISCONDUCT
            InputStrength: MEDIUM
            OutputStrength: NONE
      TopicPolicyConfig:
        TopicsConfig:
          - Name: OffTopicGeneralConversation
            Definition: "General small talk, chit-chat, or requests for information on subjects unrelated to AWS pricing, AWS services, or cloud infrastructure design, including but not limited to sports, entertainment, politics, travel, history, and personal advice."
            Examples:
              - "Who won the game last night?"
              - "Tell me a joke."
              - "What movies should I watch this weekend?"
              - "Can you give me advice about my personal life?"
            Type: DENY
          - Name: Weather
            Definition: "Any question or request about weather conditions, forecasts, temperature, climate, or meteorological information that is unrelated to AWS services or cloud infrastructure design."
            Examples:
              - "What is the weather in Seattle tomorrow?"
              - "Will it rain this weekend?"
              - "What is the forecast for New York City?"
            Type: DENY
          - Name: Cooking
            Definition: "Any question or request about recipes, cooking techniques, ingredients, meal planning, restaurants, or food preparation that is unrelated to AWS services or cloud infrastructure design."
            Examples:
              - "Give me a recipe for chocolate cake."
              - "How do I bake sourdough bread?"
              - "What should I cook for dinner tonight?"
            Type: DENY
      WordPolicyConfig:
        ManagedWordListsConfig:
          - Type: PROFANITY
      SensitiveInformationPolicyConfig:
        PiiEntitiesConfig:
          - Type: EMAIL
            Action: BLOCK
          - Type: PHONE
            Action: BLOCK
          - Type: US_SOCIAL_SECURITY_NUMBER
            Action: BLOCK
          - Type: CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD_NUMBER
            Action: BLOCK
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Component
          Value: guardrail

  PricingAssistantGuardrailVersion:
    Type: AWS::Bedrock::GuardrailVersion
    Properties:
      GuardrailIdentifier: !Ref PricingAssistantGuardrail
      Description: !Sub "Published version of the ${ProjectName} guardrail for the ${Environment} environment."

  GuardrailVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DependsOn:
      - PricingAssistantGuardrailVersion
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/pricing-assistant/${Environment}/guardrail-version"
      Description: !Sub "Active Amazon Bedrock guardrail version for the ${ProjectName} in the ${Environment} environment."
      Type: String
      Value: "2"
      Tags:
        project: !Ref ProjectName
        environment: !Ref Environment
        component: guardrail

Outputs:
  GuardrailId:
    Description: The unique identifier of the Amazon Bedrock guardrail.
    Value: !Ref PricingAssistantGuardrail

  GuardrailArn:
    Description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon Bedrock guardrail.
    Value: !GetAtt PricingAssistantGuardrail.GuardrailArn

  GuardrailVersion:
    Description: The published version of the Amazon Bedrock guardrail.
    Value: !GetAtt PricingAssistantGuardrailVersion.Version

  GuardrailVersionParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Parameter that stores the active guardrail version.
    Value: !Ref GuardrailVersionParameter

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates an IAM user and group for sending email via Amazon SES SMTP.
  It creates an access key, converts it to SES SMTP credentials using a Lambda-backed
  custom resource, and stores the SMTP username and password as SecureString parameters
  in SSM Parameter Store.

Parameters:
  IAMUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: SMTPUser
    Description: The name of the IAM user to create for SES SMTP.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '[\w+=,.@-]+'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IAM username.
  AccessKeyRotationVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1'
    Description: Increment this value to trigger an update of the SMTP credentials.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    Description: Number of days to retain Lambda logs.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
      - 0
  KMSKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >
      (Optional) ARN of a customer-managed KMS key to encrypt the SSM parameters.
      If not provided, the default AWS-managed key for SSM is used.

Conditions:
  UseCustomKMS: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref KMSKeyArn
      - ''

Resources:
  IAMGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${IAMUsername}-group'

  IAMPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${IAMUsername}-ses-smtp-policy'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ses:SendEmail
              - ses:SendRawEmail
            Resource: '*'
      Groups:
        - !Ref IAMGroup

  IAMUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref IAMUsername

  UserToGroupAddition:
    Type: AWS::IAM::UserToGroupAddition
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Ref IAMGroup
      Users:
        - !Ref IAMUser

  IAMAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref IAMUser

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-SESConv'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SESConvRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaSSMParameterStorePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LambdaLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${LambdaLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/ses/smtp/${IAMUsername}/username'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/ses/smtp/${IAMUsername}/password'
              - !If
                - UseCustomKMS
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - kms:Encrypt
                    - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  Resource: !Ref KMSKeyArn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SESConv'
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import base64
          import hmac
          import hashlib
          import json
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info('Received event of type: %s', event['RequestType'])
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
                      props = event['ResourceProperties']
                      username_param = props['UsernameParamName']
                      password_param = props['PasswordParamName']
                      try:
                          ssm.delete_parameter(Name=username_param)
                      except ssm.exceptions.ParameterNotFound:
                          pass
                      try:
                          ssm.delete_parameter(Name=password_param)
                      except ssm.exceptions.ParameterNotFound:
                          pass
                      return {
                          'PhysicalResourceId': event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'none')
                      }
                  else:
                      props = event['ResourceProperties']
                      secret = props['SecretAccessKey']
                      access_key_id = props['AccessKeyId']
                      username_param = props['UsernameParamName']
                      password_param = props['PasswordParamName']
                      kms_key = props.get('KMSKeyArn', '')

                      version = bytes([0x04])
                      message = b'SendRawEmail'
                      signature = hmac.new(secret.encode('utf-8'), message, hashlib.sha256).digest()
                      smtp_password = base64.b64encode(version + signature).decode('utf-8')

                      ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

                      put_kwargs = {
                          'Name': username_param,
                          'Value': access_key_id,
                          'Type': 'SecureString',
                          'Overwrite': True
                      }
                      if kms_key:
                          put_kwargs['KeyId'] = kms_key
                      ssm.put_parameter(**put_kwargs)

                      put_kwargs = {
                          'Name': password_param,
                          'Value': smtp_password,
                          'Type': 'SecureString',
                          'Overwrite': True
                      }
                      if kms_key:
                          put_kwargs['KeyId'] = kms_key
                      ssm.put_parameter(**put_kwargs)

                      return {
                          'PhysicalResourceId': username_param,
                          'Data': {
                              'SMTPUsername': access_key_id,
                              'SMTPPassword': smtp_password
                          }
                      }
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.exception('Error processing request')
                  raise e

  SESSMTPCredentials:
    Type: Custom::SESSMTPCredentials
    DependsOn:
      - LambdaFunction
      - IAMAccessKey
