AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Cognito OAuth 2.0 client credentials authentication layer for an Amazon Bedrock
  AgentCore Gateway. Creates the user pool, hosted domain, resource server scopes and
  confidential app client, stores the client credentials in AWS Secrets Manager through
  a Lambda backed custom resource and publishes the connection details as SSM String
  parameters and stack outputs for a separate gateway stack.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Project configuration
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
          - RequireSymbols
    ParameterLabels:
      ProjectName:
        default: Project name
      RequireSymbols:
        default: Require symbols in passwords

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._/-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      1-40 characters, must start with a letter or a number and may only contain
      letters, numbers, dots, underscores, slashes and hyphens.
    Description: >-
      Project name used to build the Secrets Manager secret name
      (ProjectName/cognito/client-secret).

  RequireSymbols:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: >-
      Set to true to require at least one symbol character in user pool passwords,
      or false to allow passwords without symbol characters.

Conditions:
  RequireSymbolsInPassword: !Equals [!Ref RequireSymbols, "true"]

Resources:

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentcore-gateway-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: !If [RequireSymbolsInPassword, true, false]
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Component: agentcore-gateway-auth

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub
        - "agentcore-${RegionName}-${StackIdFragment}"
        - RegionName: !Ref "AWS::Region"
          StackIdFragment: !Select
            - 4
            - !Split
              - "-"
              - !Select
                - 2
                - !Split
                  - "/"
                  - !Ref "AWS::StackId"

  GatewayResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: agentcore-gateway
      Name: agentcore-gateway
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to the agentcore gateway
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to the agentcore gateway
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to the agentcore gateway

  GatewayClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: GatewayResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentcore-gateway-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - agentcore-gateway/read
        - agentcore-gateway/write
        - agentcore-gateway/admin
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  ClientSecretFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Execution role for the Lambda function that copies the Cognito app client
        credentials into AWS Secrets Manager.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cognito-client-secret-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*"
              - Sid: ReadAppClientSecret
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*"
              - Sid: CreateClientSecret
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ManageClientSecret
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
                  - secretsmanager:RestoreSecret
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/cognito/*"

  ClientSecretFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Reads the Cognito app client secret and stores the client ID, client secret
        and user pool ID as a JSON secret in AWS Secrets Manager.
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ClientSecretFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 256
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import urllib.request

          import boto3

          LOG = logging.getLogger()
          LOG.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
          sm = boto3.client("secretsmanager")


          def respond(event, status, data=None, reason="See CloudWatch Logs"):
              props = event.get("ResourceProperties", {})
              body = json.dumps({
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason,
                  "PhysicalResourceId": event.get("PhysicalResourceId") or props.get("SecretName") or "secret",
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "Data": data or {},
              }).encode("utf-8")
              req = urllib.request.Request(event["ResponseURL"], data=body, method="PUT",
                  headers={"content-type": "", "content-length": str(len(body))})
              try:
                  urllib.request.urlopen(req)
              except Exception:
                  LOG.exception("Could not signal CloudFormation")


          def handler(event, context):
              LOG.info("Event: %s", json.dumps(event))
              props = event.get("ResourceProperties", {})
              name = props.get("SecretName")
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      try:
                          sm.delete_secret(SecretId=name, ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery=True)
                      except sm.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          LOG.info("Secret %s not found", name)
                      respond(event, "SUCCESS")
                      return
                  pool = props["UserPoolId"]
                  client = cognito.describe_user_pool_client(
                      UserPoolId=pool, ClientId=props["ClientId"])["UserPoolClient"]
                  payload = json.dumps({
                      "clientId": props["ClientId"],
                      "clientSecret": client["ClientSecret"],
                      "userPoolId": pool,
                      "tokenEndpoint": props.get("TokenEndpoint", ""),
                      "scopes": props.get("Scopes", ""),
                  })
                  try:
                      sm.describe_secret(SecretId=name)
                      sm.put_secret_value(SecretId=name, SecretString=payload)
                  except sm.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                      sm.create_secret(Name=name, SecretString=payload,
                          Description="Cognito client credentials for the AgentCore gateway")
                  respond(event, "SUCCESS", {"SecretName": name})
              except Exception as err:
                  LOG.exception("Failed")
                  respond(event, "FAILED", reason=str(err))

  ClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn:
      - GatewayResourceServer
      - UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ClientSecretFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientId: !Ref GatewayClient
      SecretName: !Sub "${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret"
      TokenEndpoint: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"
      Scopes: "agentcore-gateway/read agentcore-gateway/write agentcore-gateway/admin"

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/discovery-url
      Type: String
      Description: OIDC discovery document URL for the AgentCore gateway user pool
      Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Component: agentcore-gateway-auth

  ClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/client-id
      Type: String
      Description: Client ID of the confidential app client used for the client credentials flow
      Value: !Ref GatewayClient
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Component: agentcore-gateway-auth

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-id
      Type: String
      Description: ID of the Cognito user pool used by the AgentCore gateway
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Component: agentcore-gateway-auth

  UserPoolArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-arn
      Type: String
      Description: ARN of the Cognito user pool used by the AgentCore gateway
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Component: agentcore-gateway-auth

  HostedDomainUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/hosted-domain-url
      Type: String
      Description: Hosted domain URL of the Cognito user pool
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Component: agentcore-gateway-auth

Outputs:

  CognitoUserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool used by the AgentCore gateway.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CognitoUserPoolId"

  CognitoUserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito user pool used by the AgentCore gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CognitoUserPoolArn"

  CognitoUserPoolClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the confidential app client used for the client credentials flow.
    Value: !Ref GatewayClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CognitoUserPoolClientId"

  CognitoHostedDomain:
    Description: Cognito hosted domain prefix of the user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolDomain
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CognitoHostedDomain"

  CognitoHostedDomainUrl:
    Description: Hosted domain URL of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CognitoHostedDomainUrl"

  CognitoTokenEndpointUrl:
    Description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint used for the client credentials flow.
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CognitoTokenEndpointUrl"

  CognitoDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OIDC discovery document URL of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CognitoDiscoveryUrl"

  CognitoCustomScopes:
    Description: Custom OAuth 2.0 scopes defined on the agentcore-gateway resource server.
    Value: "agentcore-gateway/read agentcore-gateway/write agentcore-gateway/admin"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CognitoCustomScopes"

  ClientSecretName:
    Description: Name of the Secrets Manager secret holding the client ID, client secret and user pool ID.
    Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ClientSecretName"

  CognitoParameterPrefix:
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path prefix holding the Cognito values consumed by the gateway stack.
    Value: "/protein-agent/cognito/"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CognitoParameterPrefix"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito identity bootstrap for multi-tenant SaaS operations application

Parameters:
  TenantApplicationCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Host for tenant application callback URL (e.g., tenant.example.com)
  AdminApplicationCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Host for admin application callback URL (e.g., admin.example.com)
  SiloedTenantRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: authenticated-siloed-user-role
    Description: Name for the siloed tenant IAM role

Resources:
  PooledUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: custom:tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: custom:userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailMessage: !Sub "Your username is {username} and temporary password is {####}. Please sign in at https://${TenantApplicationCallbackHost}"
          EmailSubject: "Welcome to SaaS Operations"

  PooledUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${TenantApplicationCallbackHost}"
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${TenantApplicationCallbackHost}"
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
      IdTokenValidity: 12
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours

  PooledUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub "pooledtenant-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}"
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledUserPool

  PooledIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref PooledUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt PooledUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true

  AuthenticatedPooledUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: authenticated-pooled-user-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              ForAnyValue:StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud:
                  - !Ref PooledIdentityPool
                  - !Ref OperationsIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated

  AuthenticatedPooledUserRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AuthenticatedPooledUserRolePolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref AuthenticatedPooledUserRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: TenantItemAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:Scan
              - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product/index/*"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order/index/*"
            Condition:
              ForAllValues:StringLike:
                dynamodb:LeadingKeys:
                  - !Sub "$${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}*"
          - Sid: TenantAdminAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:*
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping/index/*"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails/index/*"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping/index/*"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings/index/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: TenantAdmin
          - Sid: SystemAdminAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:*
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*/index/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: SystemAdmin

  PooledIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PooledIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedPooledUserRole.Arn
      RoleMappings:
        !Sub "${PooledUserPool.ProviderName}:${PooledUserPoolClient}":
          IdentityProvider: !Sub "${PooledUserPool.ProviderName}:${PooledUserPoolClient}"
          Type: Token
          AmbiguousRoleResolution: AuthenticatedRole
          PrincipalTags:
            tenantId: custom:tenantId
            userRole: custom:userRole

  OperationsUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: OperationUsers-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: custom:tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: custom:userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: custom:apiKey
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailMessage: !Sub "Your username is {username} and temporary password is {####}. Please sign in at https://${AdminApplicationCallbackHost}"
          EmailSubject: "Welcome to SaaS Operations Admin"

  OperationsUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsOperationUsersPoolClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationsUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${AdminApplicationCallbackHost}"
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${AdminApplicationCallbackHost}"
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
        - custom:apiKey
      IdTokenValidity: 12
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours

  OperationsUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub "operationsusers-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}"
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationsUserPool

  OperationsUserPoolGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: SystemAdmins
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationsUserPool
      Precedence: 0

  OperationsIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: OperationsUser-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref OperationsUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt OperationsUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true

  OperationsIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref OperationsIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedPooledUserRole.Arn
      RoleMappings:
        !Sub "${OperationsUserPool.ProviderName}:${OperationsUserPoolClient}":
          IdentityProvider: !Sub "${OperationsUserPool.ProviderName}:${OperationsUserPoolClient}"
          Type: Token
          AmbiguousRoleResolution: AuthenticatedRole
          PrincipalTags:
            tenantId: custom:tenantId
            userRole: custom:userRole

  SiloedTenantRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref SiloedTenantRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated

  SiloedTenantRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: SiloedTenantRolePolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref SiloedTenantRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: SiloedTenantItemAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:*
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-$${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-$${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}/index/*"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-$${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-$${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}/index/*"
          - Sid: TenantAdminAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:*
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping/index/*"

              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings/index/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:

          - Sid: SystemAdminAccess

              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*/index/*"
            Condition:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'DynamoDB table with optional GSIs, auto scaling, backups, and alarms'

Parameters:
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: 'The name of the partition key'
    MinLength: 1
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: 'S'
    AllowedValues: ['S', 'N', 'B']
    Description: 'The type of the partition key'
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Optional name for the DynamoDB table'
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Optional name for the sort key'
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: 'N'
    AllowedValues: ['S', 'N', 'B']
    Description: 'The type of the sort key'
  Attribute1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Optional extra attribute 1 name (used as GSI1 hash key)'
  Attribute1Type:
    Type: String
    Default: 'S'
    AllowedValues: ['S', 'N', 'B']
    Description: 'Type for attribute 1'
  Attribute2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Optional extra attribute 2 name (used as GSI1 range key)'
  Attribute2Type:
    Type: String
    Default: 'S'
    AllowedValues: ['S', 'N', 'B']
    Description: 'Type for attribute 2'
  Attribute3Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Optional extra attribute 3 name (used as GSI2 hash key)'
  Attribute3Type:
    Type: String
    Default: 'S'
    AllowedValues: ['S', 'N', 'B']
    Description: 'Type for attribute 3'
  GSI1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Optional name for GSI1'
  GSI2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Optional name for GSI2'
  TTLAttributeName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Optional TTL attribute name'
  StreamViewType:
    Type: String
    Default: 'DISABLED'
    AllowedValues: ['DISABLED', 'NEW_IMAGE', 'OLD_IMAGE', 'NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES', 'KEYS_ONLY']
    Description: 'Stream view type; DISABLED to disable streams'
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: 'PROVISIONED'
    AllowedValues: ['PROVISIONED', 'PAY_PER_REQUEST']
    Description: 'Billing mode for the table'
  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: 'Read capacity units for provisioned mode'
  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: 'Write capacity units for provisioned mode'
  GSIReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: 'Read capacity units for GSIs in provisioned mode'
  GSIWriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: 'Write capacity units for GSIs in provisioned mode'
  MinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: 'Minimum capacity for auto scaling'
  MaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: 'Maximum capacity for auto scaling'
  TargetUtilization:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 20
    MaxValue: 90
    Description: 'Target utilization percentage for auto scaling'
  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: 'Enable point-in-time recovery'
  EnableSSE:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: 'Enable server-side encryption with AWS managed KMS key'
  BackupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0
    Description: 'Backup retention in days; set to 0 to disable backups'
  AlertNotificationTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Optional SNS topic ARN for alarms and backup notifications'

Conditions:
  HasTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, '']]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  HasAttribute1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute1Name, '']]
  HasAttribute2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute2Name, '']]
  HasAttribute3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute3Name, '']]
  HasGSI1: !And
    - !Condition HasAttribute1
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1Name, '']]
  HasGSI1Range: !And
    - !Condition HasGSI1
    - !Condition HasAttribute2
  HasGSI2: !And
    - !Condition HasAttribute3
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2Name, '']]
  HasTTL: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TTLAttributeName, '']]
  StreamsEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StreamViewType, 'DISABLED']]
  UseProvisionedCapacity: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, 'PROVISIONED']
  UseOnDemand: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, 'PAY_PER_REQUEST']
  EnablePITR: !Equals [!Ref PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled, 'true']
  EnableSSE: !Equals [!Ref EnableSSE, 'true']
  EnableBackups: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BackupRetentionDays, '0']]
  HasAlertTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn, '']]
  HasBackupNotifications: !And
    - !Condition EnableBackups
    - !Condition HasAlertTopic

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !If [HasTableName, !Ref TableName, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI1
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute1Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute1Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI1Range
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute2Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute2Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI2
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute3Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute3Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - UseProvisionedCapacity
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - !If
          - HasGSI1
          - IndexName: !Ref GSI1Name
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute1Name
                KeyType: HASH
              - !If
                - HasGSI1Range
                - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute2Name
                  KeyType: RANGE
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
            ProvisionedThroughput: !If
              - UseProvisionedCapacity
              - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref GSIReadCapacityUnits
                WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref GSIWriteCapacityUnits
              - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI2
          - IndexName: !Ref GSI2Name
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute3Name
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
            ProvisionedThroughput: !If
              - UseProvisionedCapacity
              - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref GSIReadCapacityUnits
                WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref GSIWriteCapacityUnits
              - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      SSESpecification: !If
        - EnableSSE
        - SSEEnabled: true
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: !If
        - EnablePITR
        - PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      StreamSpecification: !If
        - StreamsEnabled
        - StreamViewType: !Ref StreamViewType
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      TimeToLiveSpecification: !If
        - HasTTL
        - AttributeName: !Ref TTLAttributeName
          Enabled: true
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  ScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: UseProvisionedCapacity
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoScalingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                Resource: '*'

  TableReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: UseProvisionedCapacity
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxCapacity
      MinCapacity: !Ref MinCapacity
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${DynamoDBTable}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  TableWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: UseProvisionedCapacity
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxCapacity
      MinCapacity: !Ref MinCapacity
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${DynamoDBTable}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  TableReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: UseProvisionedCapacity
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-read-scaling-policy'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TableReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  TableWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: UseProvisionedCapacity
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-write-scaling-policy'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TableWriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  BackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Condition: EnableBackups
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vault'
      Notifications: !If
        - HasBackupNotifications
        - SNSTopicArn: !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
          BackupVaultEvents:
            - BACKUP_JOB_STARTED
            - BACKUP_JOB_COMPLETED
            - BACKUP_JOB_FAILED
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  BackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableBackups
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBBackupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:CreateBackup
                  - dynamodb:ListBackups
                  - dynamodb:DescribeBackup
                  - dynamodb:DeleteBackup
                  - dynamodb:RestoreTableFromBackup
                Resource: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - backup:StartBackupJob
                  - backup:DescribeBackupJob
                  - backup:ListBackupJobs
                  - backup:ListRecoveryPointsByBackupVault
                  - backup:DescribeRecoveryPoint
                  - backup:DeleteRecoveryPoint
                  - backup:StartRestoreJob
                  - backup:DescribeRestoreJob
                  - backup:ListRestoreJobs
                  - backup:ListBackupVaults
                  - backup:DescribeBackupVault
                  - backup:GetBackupPlan
                  - backup:ListBackupPlans
                  - backup:GetBackupSelection
                  - backup:ListBackupSelections
                Resource: '*'

  BackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Condition: EnableBackups
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-plan'
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: DailyBackup
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref BackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 * * ? *)'
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 1440
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref BackupRetentionDays

  BackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Condition: EnableBackups
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
        SelectionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-selection'

  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ReadThrottleEvents'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm for DynamoDB read throttle events'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WriteThrottleEvents'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm for DynamoDB write throttle events'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ThrottledRequests'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm for DynamoDB throttled requests'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserErrors'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm for DynamoDB user errors'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SystemErrors'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm for DynamoDB system errors'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  DynamoDB storage layer for the AWS account-vending automation tool. Creates
  eight provisioned tables (names suffixed with the required Stage parameter)
  and configures Application Auto Scaling for the accountInfo table, both of its
  global secondary indexes, and the taskStatus table.

Parameters:
  Stage:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Deployment stage identifier that is appended to every DynamoDB table name
      (for example: dev, test, prod).
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 30
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Stage must be 1-30 characters and contain only letters, numbers, hyphens,
      and underscores.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  CbInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-cbInfo-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  AccountInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: gsiRequestId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: requestId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: KEYS_ONLY
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
        - IndexName: gsiAccountId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: accountId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TaskStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-taskStatus-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES

  NipapCfnTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-nipapCfn-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  OpsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-ops-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: layer
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: layer
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  DxInterfaceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-dxInterface-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: vlan
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: vlan
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  ClaStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-claStatus-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  ConfigRulesComplianceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-configRulesCompliance-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role used by Application Auto Scaling to adjust DynamoDB capacity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  DynamoDbAutoScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'talr-dynamodb-autoscaling-${Stage}'
      Description: >-
        Allows Application Auto Scaling to adjust the provisioned capacity of
        the account-vending DynamoDB tables and indexes.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-dynamodb-autoscaling-policy-${Stage}'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBTableScaling
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}/index/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/talr-taskStatus-${Stage}'
              - Sid: CloudWatchAlarmManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scalable targets - accountInfo table (read / write)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  AccountInfoTableReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: AccountInfoTable
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}'
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDbAutoScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoTableWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: AccountInfoTable
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}'
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDbAutoScalingRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scalable targets - accountInfo GSI gsiRequestId (read / write)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  AccountInfoGsiRequestIdReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: AccountInfoTable
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiRequestId'
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDbAutoScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoGsiRequestIdWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: AccountInfoTable
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiRequestId'
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDbAutoScalingRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scalable targets - accountInfo GSI gsiAccountId (read / write)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  AccountInfoGsiAccountIdReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: AccountInfoTable
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiAccountId'
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDbAutoScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoGsiAccountIdWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: AccountInfoTable
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiAccountId'
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDbAutoScalingRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scalable targets - taskStatus table (read / write)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  TaskStatusTableReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: TaskStatusTable
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${TaskStatusTable}'
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDbAutoScalingRole.Arn

  TaskStatusTableWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: TaskStatusTable
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${TaskStatusTable}'
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDbAutoScalingRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Target tracking scaling policies - accountInfo table (read / write)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  AccountInfoTableReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}-read-target-tracking'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoTableReadScalableTarget

        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization

    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy

      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}-write-target-tracking'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoTableWriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  AccountInfoGsiRequestIdReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}-gsiRequestId-read-target-tracking'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoGsiRequestIdReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization

  AccountInfoGsiRequestIdWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}-gsiRequestId-write-target-tracking'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoGsiRequestIdWriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:

        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Target tracking scaling policies - accountInfo GSI gsiAccountId
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  AccountInfoGsiAccountIdReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}-gsiAccountId-read-target-tracking'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Secure, highly available network foundation for a containerised Streamlit
  application. Creates a VPC (DNS support and DNS hostnames enabled) with two
  public and two private subnets spread across the first two Availability
  Zones, a shared Internet Gateway, one NAT Gateway per Availability Zone,
  VPC flow logs delivered to a CloudWatch log group retained for seven days,
  and an ECS cluster with Container Insights enabled.

Parameters:

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (for example 10.0.0.0/16).
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (for example 10.0.0.0/24).
    Description: CIDR block for the first public subnet (first Availability Zone).

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (for example 10.0.1.0/24).
    Description: CIDR block for the second public subnet (second Availability Zone).

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (for example 10.0.2.0/24).
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet (first Availability Zone).

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (for example 10.0.3.0/24).
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet (second Availability Zone).

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway (shared by both public subnets)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Elastic IPs for the NAT gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGatewayEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT gateways - one per Availability Zone
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-2'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public routing - shared route table, default route via the IGW
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless AI Campaign Orchestration Platform

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: AICampaignOrchestrator
    Description: Name of the project
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0
    Description: Bedrock model ID for generative steps
  SenderEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: no-reply@example.com
    Description: Sender email address for campaign notifications
  SenderPhoneNumber:
    Type: String
    Default: '+15555555555'
    Description: Sender phone number for SMS campaigns
  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable OpenSearch Serverless semantic search
  OpenSearchCollectionName:
    Type: String
    Default: campaign-vectors
    Description: Name of the OpenSearch Serverless collection

Conditions:
  IsSemanticSearchEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableSemanticSearch, 'true']

Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for AI Campaign Orchestrator data stores
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow AWS Services to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
                - s3.amazonaws.com
                - dynamodb.amazonaws.com
                - states.amazonaws.com
                - logs.amazonaws.com
                - sns.amazonaws.com
                - apigateway.amazonaws.com
                - aoss.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'

  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  CampaignAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-campaign-assets-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-CustomerProfiles'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ChannelRateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-ChannelRateLimits'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: channel
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: channel
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  MessageDeliveryTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-MessageDeliveryTracking'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: timestamp
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: timestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  AlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-CampaignAlerts'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-LambdaExecutionRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CustomerProfilesTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt ChannelRateLimitsTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt MessageDeliveryTrackingTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref AlertTopic
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref CampaignStateMachine
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - !If
                - IsSemanticSearchEnabled
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - aoss:APIAccessAll
                  Resource: !GetAtt OpenSearchCollection.Arn
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  StepFunctionsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-StepFunctionsExecutionRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-CampaignStateMachine'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  StateMachineLogGroupResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-StateMachineLogPolicy'
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {
                "Service": "states.amazonaws.com"
              },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:PutLogEvents"
              ],
              "Resource": "${StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}"
            }
          ]
        }

  ParseInstructionFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-ParseInstruction'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 512
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CUSTOMER_PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          CHANNEL_RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref ChannelRateLimitsTable
          MESSAGE_DELIVERY_TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref MessageDeliveryTrackingTable
          CAMPAIGN_ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
          SENDER_EMAIL: !Ref SenderEmail
          SENDER_PHONE_NUMBER: !Ref SenderPhoneNumber
          ALERT_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref AlertTopic
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !Ref CampaignStateMachine
          OPENSEARCH_ENDPOINT: !If [IsSemanticSearchEnabled, !GetAtt OpenSearchCollection.CollectionEndpoint, '']
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              print("Parsing instruction:", json.dumps(event))
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps('Instruction parsed')
              }

  SegmentCustomersFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-SegmentCustomers'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 512
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CUSTOMER_PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          CHANNEL_RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref ChannelRateLimitsTable
          MESSAGE_DELIVERY_TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref MessageDeliveryTrackingTable
          CAMPAIGN_ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
          SENDER_EMAIL: !Ref SenderEmail

          ALERT_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref AlertTopic

      Code:

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              print("Segmenting customers:", json.dumps(event))
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps('Customers segmented')
              }

  PredictChannelFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-PredictChannel'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 300

      Environment:
        Variables:

          CAMPAIGN_ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket

      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "AI Campaign Orchestration Pipeline",
            "StartAt": "ParseInstruction",
            "States": {
              "ParseInstruction": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${ParseInstructionFunctionArn}",
                "Next": "SegmentCustomers"
              },
              "SegmentCustomers": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${SegmentCustomersFunctionArn}",
                "Next": "PredictChannel"
              },
              "PredictChannel": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${PredictChannelFunctionArn}",
                "Next": "SafetyCheck"
              },
              "SafetyCheck": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${SafetyCheckFunctionArn}",
                "Next": "AdaptContent"
              },
              "AdaptContent": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${AdaptContentFunctionArn}",
                "Next": "DeliverMessage"
              },
              "DeliverMessage": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${DeliverMessageFunctionArn}",
                "Next": "RecordResults"
              },
              "RecordResults": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${RecordResultsFunctionArn}",
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }
        - ParseInstructionFunctionArn: !GetAtt ParseInstructionFunction.Arn

        Enabled: true

Description: Serverless URL shortener with DynamoDB, Lambda, and API Gateway

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener-table
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table for the URL shortener.
  FunctionNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Prefix for Lambda function names.
  PythonRuntime:
    Type: String
    Default: python3.12
    Description: Python runtime for the Lambda functions.
  ApplicationUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://short.example.com
    Description: Base URL used to build shortened links.
  MinShortIdLength:
    Type: Number
    Default: 12
    MinValue: 12
    MaxValue: 16
    Description: Minimum length of generated short identifiers.
  MaxShortIdLength:
    Type: Number
    Default: 16
    MinValue: 12
    MaxValue: 16
    Description: Maximum length of generated short identifiers.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment tag value.
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Service tag value.
  Owner:
    Type: String
    Default: owner
    Description: Owner tag value.

Resources:
  URLShortenerTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: short_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: short_id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${FunctionNamePrefix}-lambda-execution-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt URLShortenerTable.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  CreateFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${FunctionNamePrefix}-create"
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref TableName
          APPLICATION_URL: !Ref ApplicationUrl
          MIN_SHORT_ID_LENGTH: !Sub "${MinShortIdLength}"
          MAX_SHORT_ID_LENGTH: !Sub "${MaxShortIdLength}"
